column12: NANO-COMPOSITE HYDROGEL FOR RADIOSENSITIZATION AFTER BREAST-CONSERVING SURGERY FOR BREAST CANCER AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: A nano-composite hydrogel for radiosensitization after breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer and a preparation method therefor. The nano-composite hydrogel comprises a hydrogel loaded with mesoporus gold nanoparticles M@AuNPs. The preparation method is as follows: The starting materials include a modified chitosan solution, a modified hyaluronic acid solution, and M@AuNPs. M@AuNPs are dispersed in the modified hyaluronic acid solution and the modified chitosan solution is isovolumetrically mixed with the modified hyaluronic acid solution to give the hydrogel. The injectable hydrogel has a structure uniformly encapsulating outer-layer modified gold nanoparticles, and is capable of implementing immunotherapy by means of the targeted sustained-release of therapeutic drugs and meanwhile achieving ray energy accumulation due to the higher atomic number of the gold nanoparticles, thereby effectively killing tumor cells at the tumor bed position. The strategy effectively reduces the radiation dose in the whole breast radiotherapy, and is beneficial to protecting normal tissues of the breast outside the tumor bed.

column12: Preparation and application of ROS (reactive oxygen species) response type nanoparticles containing thioketal bonds
column13: The invention relates to preparation and application of ROS (reactive oxygen species) responsive nanoparticles containing thioketal bonds, which can effectively solve the problems of poor biocompatibility, poor water solubility, uncontrollable release and the like of curcumin. Chitosan oligosaccharide is modified by 4-carboxyphenylboronic acid, and then thioketal diacid is cross-linked to obtain the ROS responsive polymer. The polymer, curcumin and glucose oxidase are self-assembled in a solution to construct ROS-responsive nanoparticles. According to the nanoparticles prepared by the invention, due to the introduction of ROS-sensitive thioketal bonds and boric acid ester bonds, the controlled release of curcumin at a tumor part is realized under the stimulation of a tumor microenvironment. In addition, the encapsulated glucose oxidase can catalyze over-expressed glucose at tumor tissues to generate hydrogen peroxide, the ROS concentration of tumor cells is increased, the drug release efficiency is enhanced, and the treatment effect of the drug on breast cancer is effectively improved.

column12: Preparation method of STING agonist and MR1 antibody co-loaded MCC nano drug delivery system for enhancing tumor immunotherapy
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly discloses a preparation method of an MCC nano drug delivery system co-carrying an STING agonist and an MR1 antibody and used for enhancing tumor immunotherapy. Carboxymethyl chitosan is used as a hydrophilic saccharide skeleton, and conjugated linoleic acid hydrophobically modifies the carboxymethyl chitosan through an EDC mediated reaction; the preparation method comprises the following steps: grafting D-mannose activated by acetic acid and a conjugated linoleic acid-carboxymethyl chitosan polymer to obtain an MCC nano-carrier; through ultrasonic emulsification, the MCC nano-carrier encapsulates the STING agonist and the MR1 antibody to obtain the MCC nano-drug release system. The nano drug release system is transdermally delivered into the body of a tumor patient, the MCC nano particles can reach the tumor part under the targeted guidance of mannose groups, the targeted immune cells release the STING agonist so as to positively activate the immune response reaction, and meanwhile, the MR1 antibody released by the MCC nano particles can inhibit the immune escape phenomenon of the tumor cells so as to activate the immune response reaction. And the immune response reaction is reversely activated, so that the bidirectional synergistic activation of tumor immunity is finally realized.

column12: Fish scale composite hydrogel for drug loading and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a fish scale composite hydrogel for drug loading and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: alternately treating fish scales by adopting high-frequency and low-frequency sound waves, respectively extracting fish scale collagen and hydroxyapatite by adopting a hot-pressing method and an ionic liquid method, and then cross-linking acrylic acid modified beta-cyclodextrin with a peptide calcium chelate to prepare the fish scale composite hydrogel. According to the method, high-frequency and low-frequency sound waves are used for alternately treating the fish scales, a gluing structure of collagen and hydroxyapatite is dissociated through cooperation of the cavitation effect and mechanical vibration, and the extraction efficiency is improved while collagen denaturation is avoided; the prepared fish scale composite hydrogel has a jellyfish structure: a stable gel core layer structure is formed by coating a hydroxyapatite-chitosan cross-linked network with beta-cyclodextrin; the branched whisker structure formed by covalent linkage of the acrylic acid modified beta-cyclodextrin and the collagen realizes gradient controlled release of the drug, and the strong adhesiveness of the whisker can accurately locate the drug release part, thereby providing an innovative solution for the fields of drug delivery and tissue engineering.

column12: Multi-layer sustained-release microsphere with anti-wrinkle effect as well as preparation method and application of multi-layer sustained-release microsphere

column12: Pathogenic affinity pathway of infectious or parasitic organisms for nanogram and picogram dosimetry prophylaxis or cure
column13: The sustenance of life is driven by recognition of and access to energy sources. This process has remained unchanged over billions of years, guiding cellular nutrition through molecular recognition, akin to the food pyramid. At the atomic or nanoscale, chemotaxis enables organisms to identify ingestible matter and is driven by their need for fuel, rather than from the sustenance itself. Chemotaxis, one of nature's most potent yet invisible organic forces, operates independently of molecular charge dynamics to locate and identify microscopic sustenance. Infectious organisms, such as pathogenic microbes and parasites, depend on chemotactic pathways to locate nutrition across all scales. This invention leverages this phenomenon by “baiting” these pathways with nutritive matter that encapsulates biocidal agents that are harmless to humans but lethal to infectious organisms once ingested. These nutritive biocidal agents could be employed as topical, oral, injectable, or aerosolized formulations, as well as hydrogel or slow-release implants.

column12: AZITHROMYCIN NASAL SPRAY FORMULATION
column13: The present invention discloses a novel stable, single-phase aqueous suspension for nasal administration designed to treat bacterial sinusitis. The composition comprises azithromycin dihydrate as the active ingredient and utilizes a suspending agent system to prevent phase separation during storage. Embodiments include formulations with sorbitan monolaurate or a combination of chitosan and sorbitan monolaurate for suspension stability. The invention offers several advantages, including localized delivery of azithromycin to the site of infection, potentially reducing systemic exposure and associated side effects compared to oral formulations.

column12: Antibacterial repair-promoting composite nano-enzyme and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of antibacterial nano materials, and particularly relates to an antibacterial repair-promoting composite nano enzyme and a preparation method thereof. The composite nano-enzyme comprises a main matrix and a core matrix, wherein the main matrix comprises the following raw materials: carboxymethyl chitosan, Fe-CDs monatomic nano-enzyme, modified CeO2 nano-particles, lysine, silk fibroin and glutaraldehyde; the core matrix is prepared from the following raw materials: PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)), dichloromethane, glutathione, vitamin E, sodium hyaluronate, glycine and Tween-80. According to the method, bacteria are directly killed through active oxygen generated through Fe-CDs nano enzyme catalysis, the level of the active oxygen is adjusted by CeO2 through redox circulation, healthy tissue is protected, and balance of a repaired microenvironment is maintained; the sustained release function of the PLGA microcapsule ensures the sustained release of the repair promoting factor, and the application effect of the material in wound healing is integrally improved.

column12: Adipose-derived stem cell composition for wound repair as well as preparation method and application of adipose-derived stem cell composition
column13: The invention provides an adipose-derived stem cell composition for wound repair as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of stem cells. The method comprises the following steps: adding fetal calf serum, dexamethasone, penicillin, streptomycin, collagen, magnetic particles and a P substance into a DMEM culture medium to prepare a culture medium, performing low-frequency magnetic field culture and separation on adipose-derived stem cells to obtain a stem cell solution, performing embedding to obtain stem cell microspheres, freeze-drying supernate to obtain a paracrine culture substance, and performing freeze-drying on the paracrine culture substance to obtain the adipose-derived stem cells. The adipose-derived stem cell composition for wound repair is prepared by mixing the adipose-derived stem cell with stem cell microspheres, hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, carboxymethyl chitosan, hyaluronic acid, glycerol and stem cell microspheres, has better effects of implanting into damaged tissues, releasing nutrient substances, promoting neovascularization, regulating oxidative stress and inducing anti-inflammatory response, is beneficial to wound repair, and has a good application prospect. The gel can be converted into a gel phase at the skin epidermis temperature of 35-37 DEG C, components are stabilized, and sustained and controlled release is realized.

column12: Water-retention slow-release fertilizer and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of fertilizers, and discloses a water-retaining slow-release fertilizer and a preparation method thereof. The nitrogen fertilizer is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30 to 40 parts of nitrogen fertilizer, 15 to 20 parts of chitosan, 1 to 2 parts of urease inhibitor, 3 to 5 parts of maleic anhydride grafted compatilizer, 100 parts of acetic acid solution, 20 to 25 parts of acrylamide, 1 to 2 parts of 2-mercaptobenzoic acid, 0.4 to 0.6 part of ammonium persulfate, 0.4 to 0.6 part of tetramethylethylenediamine, 4 to 6 parts of calcium carbonate powder, 10 to 15 parts of talcum powder and 0.3 to 0.5 part of nitrification inhibitor. According to the invention, chitosan and acrylamide are copolymerized and prepared into the hydrogel, and the three-dimensional network structure contains a large amount of hydroxyl groups, so that the water absorption and holding capacity of the polymer can be greatly improved. The nitrogen fertilizer is wrapped by a three-dimensional network structure of the polymer, is gradually hydrolyzed when encountering water, and cooperates with the urease inhibitor grafted on the polymer and a coating film formed on the surface, so that an efficient slow-release and controlled-release effect is achieved.

column12: Sodium alginate oligosaccharide plant growth regulator slow-release agent and preparation method thereof

Sodium alginate oligosaccharides are provided at various stages of plant growth.

column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a liposome drug delivery system of targeted microglial cells Cx43 as well as a preparation method and application of the liposome drug delivery system. column12: Thermosensitive propolis gel solution and preparation method thereof
column13: The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, respectively preparing a propolis extracting solution, a polyvinyl alcohol solution and a chitosan solution, then uniformly mixing the polyvinyl alcohol solution and the chitosan solution, then adding the propolis extracting solution to obtain a mixed solution, and finally, filtering the mixed solution, standing at low temperature, compounding at ultrahigh pressure, and cooling to obtain the temperature-sensitive propolis gel solution. And carrying out gelation on the propolis gel solution, so as to obtain the temperature-sensitive propolis gel solution. column12: Oral colon-targeted silicon nano-drug and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an oral colon-targeted silicon nano-drug and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of drug targeted delivery. According to the oral colon targeting delivery system based on biodegradable nano-silica, entrapment of drug molecules can be synchronously achieved in the preparation process, and the targeting effect of the system on inflammatory endothelial cells and macrophages is enhanced through surface modification of hyaluronic acid. In order to ensure the stability of the delivery system in the gastrointestinal tract and avoid the influence of strong acid environment, enzyme and the like in the stomach on the protein, the surface of the delivery system is further modified with chitosan and sodium alginate through electrostatic interaction. A novel neurotrophic factor MANF is used as a model protein, the MANF protein is successfully delivered to a colon part by constructing an oral colon targeting delivery system, and it is proved that the MANF protein can improve ulcerative colitis injury through oral administration on the animal level.

column12: Rapid photo-crosslinking drug sustained release type multifunctional hydrogel corneal contact lens and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a rapid photo-crosslinking drug sustained release type multifunctional hydrogel corneal contact lens and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing quaternized chitosan, an acrylate monomer, methacrylic acid, a crosslinking agent and an initiator into a reaction mixed solution according to a ratio; (2) transferring the reaction mixed solution into a mold, carrying out an ultraviolet irradiation free radical polymerization reaction, after the reaction is finished, demolding, taking out hydrogel, washing, and carrying out freeze drying treatment to obtain freeze-dried hydrogel; and (3) immersing the freeze-dried hydrogel into a drug monomer solution until the hydrogel is completely swelled. The corneal contact lens prepared by the method disclosed by the invention can be polymerized in one step and rapidly prepared, has proper water content of a finished product, has excellent light transmission and mechanical properties, can effectively load traditional Chinese medicine antibacterial drugs and prolong the release time of the drugs, has a remarkable curative effect in treatment of bacterial keratitis, and is suitable for popularization and application. As a therapeutic corneal contact lens, the corneal contact lens has a wide market application prospect.

column12: Absorbable bone wax as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses absorbable bone wax as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the absorbable bone wax comprises the following steps: 1) mixing nano black phosphorus with a Tris-HCl solution of polydopamine, and reacting to obtain polydopamine modified nano black phosphorus; 2) in an ice bath environment, dropwise adding a sodium beta-glycerophosphate pentahydrate solution into the chitosan solution to obtain chitosan hydrogel; 3) under an ice bath condition, blending the nano black phosphorus modified by the polydopamine with the chitosan hydrogel to obtain a blended solution; and (4) blending a medicine for promoting fracture healing into the blended solution to obtain the absorbable bone wax. column12: Drug balloon catheter and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of drug delivery, and particularly relates to a drug balloon catheter and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a medicine balloon catheter. The medicine balloon catheter comprises a balloon catheter body, a medicine storage layer and a medicine coating, wherein the outer surface of the balloon catheter body is sequentially coated with the medicine storage layer and the medicine coating. The medicine storage layer comprises one or more layers; when the drug balloon catheter is used for delivery, drugs on the outermost layer enter blood vessels preferentially and are continuously absorbed and metabolized and eliminated along with the half-life period and elimination kinetics of the drugs, and the anti-proliferation effect of the drugs is achieved. The first layer of the microspheres in the storage layer preferentially enters tissues and reaches saturation concentration, so that most of the microspheres are attached to the blood vessel wall, the modification of chitosan increases the contact between the PLGA microspheres and the blood vessel wall, a large amount of medicine is released after the structure of the storage layer collapses, and the released large amount of medicine enters the blood vessel to play a role.

column12: Chitosan-hyaluronic acid hydrogel loaded with umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell derived exosome and preparation method of chitosan-hyaluronic acid hydrogel
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to chitosan-hyaluronic acid hydrogel (UCMSCs-exo-coated CS-HAhydrogel) loaded with an umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell derived exosome and a preparation method of the chitosan-hyaluronic acid hydrogel (UCMSCs-exo-coated CS-HAhydrogel) loaded with the umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell derived exosome. The UCMSCs-exo-coated CS-HA hydrogel prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention can be used for remarkably promoting the repair of a full-thickness skin defect wound surface of a C57BL/6 mouse. The CS and the HA are effectively combined to construct a CS-HAhydrogel drug delivery system so as to promote the in-vitro utilization rate of the exosome and promote the healing of the wound surface. The CS-HAhydrogel has various biological activities, can be used as a drug carrier for drug delivery and controlled release, improves the curative effect and safety of drugs, and has wide application in the field of biomedicine.

column12: Hydrogel material for artificial restoration of black land and restoration method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation, and discloses a hydrogel material for artificially remedying black land and a remediation method thereof.The hydrogel material for artificially remedying black land is prepared from, by weight, 50%-70% of polymer matrix, 5%-15% of multifunctional cross-linking agent, 15%-30% of nutrition slow-release agent and 1%-5% of biological active agent; the multifunctional cross-linking agent is used for enhancing the mechanical strength and stability of the hydrogel; the polymer matrix comprises one of sodium alginate, chitosan and a chitosan derivative; the nutrient sustained-release agent comprises main nutrient elements such as nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium required by plant growth, trace elements and a growth regulator. According to the artificial restoration method for the black land, by applying the specific hydrogel material, the physical and chemical properties of soil can be improved, healthy development of a soil ecosystem can be promoted, and effective technical support is provided for sustainable agricultural production.

column12: Devices and methods for repairing damage to a tissue
column13: An example device for repairing a tissue is described herein. The device can include a flexible carrier layer, and a support member including a plurality of micro-protrusions extending therefrom. The support member can be at least partially integrated with the flexible carrier layer. Additionally, the flexible carrier layer can be configured to cover at least a portion of the tissue, and the micro-protrusions can be configured to mechanically interface with the tissue.

column12: Method for enhancing permeability of transdermal drug delivery by using biological material
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine and drug delivery, and discloses a method for enhancing the permeability of transdermal drug delivery by using a biological material, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a multifunctional nano-carrier containing a high-molecular polymer core and a functional shell layer; s2, mixing the multifunctional nano-carrier with a matrix material; s3, carrying out surface modification on the nano-carrier, and adding a targeting ligand or a penetration enhancer; s4, applying an intelligent responsive material which is a temperature-sensitive material or a pH-sensitive material and is used for controlling drug release when the temperature or the pH changes; and S5, adding a reinforcing agent into the matrix material, wherein the reinforcing agent is selected from hyaluronic acid, chitosan or other natural polysaccharides. Through a multi-layer nano-carrier, targeted ligand modification, an intelligent response material and a biodegradable microneedle, transdermal absorption, targeting and controlled release of the drug are improved, and the problems of insufficient absorption and poor targeting of a traditional system are solved.

column12: Hydrogel wound dressing with slow-release effect and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a hydrogel wound dressing with a slow-release effect and a preparation method of the hydrogel wound dressing, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. The hydrogel wound dressing comprises hydrogel and sustained-release particles loaded in the hydrogel, wherein the sustained-release particles comprise a wall material and a core material loaded in the wall material; wherein the wall material comprises modified rhizoma menispermi and chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, and the modified rhizoma menispermi is obtained by sequentially performing high-temperature carbonization, ultrasonic enzymolysis treatment and drying on rhizoma menispermi. The preparation method comprises the following steps: sequentially carrying out high-temperature carbonization, ultrasonic enzymolysis treatment and drying on rhizoma menispermi to obtain modified rhizoma menispermi, then taking the modified rhizoma menispermi and chitosan quaternary ammonium salt as components of a wall material, and loading a core material in the wall material to obtain the sustained-release particles. And finally, loading the sustained-release particles into the hydrogel to obtain the hydrogel wound dressing with a relatively strong sustained-release effect. In addition, the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt has an antibacterial property, so that the hydrogel wound dressing also has a certain antibacterial property.

column12: Visual nano composite material for magnetic resonance imaging for treating osteosarcoma and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a visual nano composite material for magnetic resonance imaging for treating osteosarcoma, and belongs to the technical field of nano materials. The nano composite material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by mass: a gadolinium contrast agent, a modified natural polymer, a medicine component, a cross-linking agent, a stabilizer and a photoinitiator, the modified natural polymer comprises modified polylactic acid and modified chitosan; the medicine components comprise the Apatinib and the GSK-J4, and the mass ratio of the Apatinib to the GSK-J4 is (2 to 5) to (0.5 to 1); the gadolinium contrast agent comprises DOTA, glutamic acid and gadolinium ions, and the molar ratio of DOTA to glutamic acid to gadolinium ions is 1: (4-6): (2-3). The efficient, safe and multifunctional nano composite material is developed through a fine formula design, an innovative preparation process and a synergistic effect of functional components, and the material not only can provide high-quality magnetic resonance imaging, but also can realize targeted delivery and controlled release of drugs, and provides a new possibility for treatment of osteosarcoma.

column12: Intelligent response type chitosan gel system and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to intelligent response type chitosan gel and a preparation method thereof. After the intelligent response drug-loaded hydrogel system is injected into a human body, gel is formed in situ, the lubricating capacity of the hydrogel system is enhanced through introduction of lipidosome, and friction force in an articular cavity is reduced. Therefore, the intelligent gel can delay the progress of arthritis through the synergistic effect of lubrication, oxidation resistance and inflammation resistance.

column12: Preparation method and application of anti-cell aging film

column12: Compound controlled-release microelement fertilizer capable of efficiently reducing cadmium content of rice and preparation method of compound controlled-release microelement fertilizer
column13: The invention discloses a compound controlled-release micro-element fertilizer capable of efficiently reducing the cadmium content of rice and a preparation method, and the compound controlled-release micro-element fertilizer comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 41-45% of chitosan glutaraldehyde cross-linked compound coated manganese fertilizer, 23-26% of thin water-based polyacrylate coated iron fertilizer and 31-34% of thick water-based polyacrylate coated zinc fertilizer. According to the cadmium reduction rules of zinc, iron, manganese and other micro-element fertilizer materials in different periods of rice, by utilizing the relatively strong water absorption and permeability of a chitosan glutaraldehyde cross-linked compound coating material and the weak water absorption and permeability of a water-based polyacrylate coating material, and according to the different release rules of the three coating materials, the cadmium reduction of the three coating materials is realized. column12: Anti-inflammatory alginic acid derivative/chitosan/gelatin nano-composite fiber medical dressing and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional medical dressings, and particularly relates to an anti-inflammatory alginic acid derivative/chitosan/gelatin nano-composite fiber medical dressing and a preparation method thereof. In order to prepare the nano composite fiber suitable for the easily infected wound surface, the invention adopts an alginic acid penicillanic acid derivative (RA-OSA-APA) prepared by oxidation-reductive amination reaction as a raw material. A water-soluble cosolvent such as polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) is used as a spinning aid, and the RA-OSA-APA/PVA/CS/GT electrospun nano composite fiber is developed through a multi-layer electrostatic spinning technology. Compared with traditional dressings, the material can control exudate, is better in air permeability, has good drug controlled release property, excellent cytocompatibility and antibacterial activity, and can be used as a multifunctional medical dressing to be applied to easily infected wounds.

column13: The invention discloses a sustained-release pharmaceutical composition containing olopatadine hydrochloride and a preparation method of the sustained-release pharmaceutical composition, and relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations. Comprising the following components: olopatadine hydrochloride, a lubricant, plant polysaccharide, other plant source extracts, a controlled-release framework material, an adhesive, a filler, water-soluble red date powder, food-grade chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, barley grass powder, rice meal and inulin. The other plant source extracts are extracted from the following raw materials: grape seeds, carrots, green tea, stevia rebaudiana, broccoli, peppermint leaves, chamomile leaves, black cumin, petasites tatewakianus, basil leaves, fresh ginger, oat, apples, mung beans and onions. column12: Application of gamma-ray response degradable hydrogel as biomedical material
column13: The invention discloses an application of gamma-ray response type injectable hydrogel as a biomedical material. column12: Bionic nano-carrier for crossing blood brain barrier and application of bionic nano-carrier
column13: The invention discloses a bionic nano-carrier for improving blood brain barrier crossing efficiency by taking lysosome escape as a strategy. The bionic nano-carrier disclosed by the invention can generate charge reversal in brain endothelial cell lysosome and realize lysosome escape, shows excellent blood brain barrier penetrability, solves the problem of low blood brain barrier crossing efficiency of an existing nano-carrier, and provides an effective basis for brain drug delivery and brain disease diagnosis and treatment.

column12: Drug controlled release system based on natural polysaccharide, preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a drug controlled release system based on natural polysaccharide, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of material synthesis and biological medicine. The drug controlled release system comprises hydrogel generated by carrying out Schiff base reaction on amino groups on deoxy-6-arginine grafted chitosan and aldehyde groups on dialdehyde functionalized polyethylene glycol, and diabetes treatment drugs loaded in the hydrogel. The drug controlled release system prepared by the invention realizes slow release of metformin on the surface of a wound through swelling of gel, so that inflammation is inhibited for a long time, and meanwhile, inhibition on bacteria is realized under the action of 6-deoxy-6-arginine grafted chitosan. The drug controlled release system is simple to prepare and high in biocompatibility, and can be widely applied to the field of biological medicines.

column12: Slow-release transdermal absorption drug dressing and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a sustained-release transdermal absorption drug dressing and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical dressings. The sustained-release transdermal absorption drug dressing is composed of a polysaccharide soluble needle tip material, a gel substrate material and sustained-release synergistic drug carrying microspheres, the gel substrate material is prepared from silk fibroin, graphene oxide, chitosan and rosmarinic acid; the sustained-release synergistic drug-loaded microspheres are prepared from nano-hydroxyapatite, sodium alginate, tannic acid, calcium chloride and traditional Chinese medicine components, the sustained-release transdermal absorption drug dressing is a drug-loading gel soluble microneedle dressing, has a double-layer drug-loading structure and a double sustained-release way, significantly improves the drug-loading capacity, enables sustained-release synergistic drug-loading microspheres to penetrate through a cuticle to reach a focus part by using a drug delivery mode that a microneedle is inserted into the skin, and meanwhile, slowly delivers traditional Chinese medicine components in a substrate, so that the drug-loading capacity is greatly improved. The transdermal absorption amount of the medicine is enhanced, and an excellent osteoarthritis treatment effect is realized.

column12: AN ADHESIVE ORAL DISC FOR SUSTAINED RELEASE OF CANNABINOIDS
column13: The present invention relates to an adhesive oral disc for sustained release of cannabinoids. The disc comprises one or more cannabinoids and being composed of at least a mucosal contacting layer having a mucosal contacting surface operable to be 5 fixed to the gingiva of a person in need of alleviation or treatment of a medical condition, where the mucosal contacting layer comprising one or more mucoadhesive polymers allowing the adhesive oral disc to adhere to the gingiva for an extended period of time. Further, the disc comprises a non-mucoadhesive module fused to the mucosal contacting layer, where the non-mucoadhesive module comprising a solid 10 tablet composition allowing the non-mucoadhesive module to dissolve within an extended period of time upon adhesion of the adhesive oral disc to the gingiva. The invention is particularly useful for alleviation or treatment of ulcers.

column12: Carboxymethyl chitosan inhalation dry powder entrapping PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) nano influenza vaccine and preparation method of carboxymethyl chitosan inhalation dry powder
column13: The invention discloses carboxymethyl chitosan inhalation dry powder entrapped with a PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) nano A-influenza vaccine and a preparation method of the carboxymethyl chitosan inhalation dry powder. The inhalation dry powder is composed of a carrier material carboxymethyl chitosan and PLGA nanoparticles entrapped in the carrier material, in addition, the PLGA nanoparticles are internally coated with a influenza A vaccine; the preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing drug-loaded nanoparticles by adopting an emulsification-solvent evaporation method, and then preparing nanoparticle-loaded dry powder by adopting a spray drying method; the product is inhalation nanoparticle dry powder, the problems of poor bioavailability, poor patient compliance and potential safety hazards caused by traditional oral administration and injection are solved, meanwhile, the PLGA nanoparticles are similar to cell components in size, antigens can be delivered to lymph nodes in multiple effective modes to enhance immunogenicity, presentation of APCs to the antigens can be promoted, and the immunogenicity is improved. And moreover, the sustained-release effect is achieved, and the toxic and side effects of the medicine are reduced while the medicine effect is improved.

column12: Drug carrier composition for thalassemia and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological pharmacy, and particularly relates to a medicine carrier composition for thalassemia and a preparation method of the medicine carrier composition. The drug carrier composition is prepared from phosphatidic acid, lecithin, (2, 3-dioleoxy propyl) trimethyl ammonium chloride, distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine-polyethylene glycol 2000, folic acid-polyethylene glycol-active ester, cholesterol, a stabilizer and an antioxidant. According to the lipidosome constructed by the invention, the membrane stability is enhanced through precise combination of phosphatidic acid, lecithin, cholesterol and distearoyl phosphatidyl ethanolamine-polyethylene glycol 2000. Through targeted modification of folic acid-PEG-active ester and positive electricity introduction of chitosan, the active targeting ability and the drug loading efficiency are improved, rejection reaction is reduced through immunoregulation, liposome is protected from enzymatic degradation, and the utilization efficiency and the biocompatibility are greatly improved under the synergistic effect.

column12: IN-SITU CRYO-IMMUNE ENGINEERING FOR CANCER IMMUNOTHERAPY
column13: Cancer immunotherapy deploys the host's immune system to recognize and attack cancerous tumors. However, the efficacy is greatly restricted by the immunosuppressive (i.e., immunologically cold) tumor microenvironment (TME). In-situ cryo-immune engineering (ICIE) strategy turns the TME from immunologically “cold” into “hot”. In particular, after the ICIE treatment, the ratio of the CD8+ cytotoxic T cells to the immunosuppressive regulatory T cells is increased in primary tumors and distant tumors without freezing. The ICIE treatment causes “frostbite” of tumor with cold-responsive nanoparticles that target cancer cells. This rapidly releases both anticancer drug(s) and PD-L1 silencing siRNA into the cytosol. This ICIE treatment leads to potent immunogenic cell death, which promotes maturation of dendritic cells and activation of CD8+ cytotoxic T cells and memory T cells. Collectively, ICIE enables an efficient and durable way to leverage the immune system for combating cancer and its metastasis.

column12: FORMULATION AND METHOD FOR TREATMENT OF URINARY SYSTEM DISORDERS

A preparation method of mercaptan-modified chitosan nano-microspheres comprises the following steps: adding chitosan into a diluted hydrochloric acid solution, and fully dissolving; activating carboxyl in cysteine by using an EDC/NHS coupling agent; mixing the treated chitosan and cysteine, and magnetically stirring at room temperature for 20-30 hours to obtain a reaction solution; removing unreacted cysteine in the reaction liquid to obtain a mercaptan modified chitosan conjugate; the mercaptan modified chitosan nano-microsphere carrier is prepared by using an electrostatic spraying technology. The mercaptan-modified chitosan is used for preparing the drug delivery carrier, the mucosa penetrating performance of the chitosan is improved, and through tests, the mercaptan-modified chitosan can become a delivery system of DNA fragments, plasmids, fluorescent probes, artificial vesicles, antigens and even wider active substances.

column12: Injectable intelligent controlled-release hydrogel and application thereof in treatment of bone injury
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medicine, and relates to wound dressing, in particular to injectable intelligent controlled-release hydrogel and application thereof in treatment of bone injury, the hydrogel takes an oxidized hyaluronic acid aqueous solution and a carboxymethyl chitosan aqueous solution as matrixes, a hydrogel base material is prepared through a chemical reaction, Pht-coated ZIF-8-coated PDA is loaded in the hydrogel base material, and the hydrogel base material is prepared through an injection method. The preparation method of the Pht (at) ZIF-8 (at) PDA comprises the following steps: firstly, encapsulating Pht in ZIF-8 nanoparticles to obtain Pht (at) ZIF-8 nanoparticles; then, the surfaces of the Pht (at) ZIF-8 nano particles are wrapped with PDA (Personal Digital Assistant); wherein Pht is phloretin, ZIF-8 is a zinc-based zeolite imidazole skeleton, and PDA is polydopamine. After the hydrogel is subjected to near-infrared photothermal treatment, intelligent on-demand release and high-efficiency transportation of Pht and Zn < 2 + > are realized, so that medicines can more effectively permeate into bone tissues and are more accurately subjected to targeted administration, meanwhile, the bone repair effect can be further improved, and the repair of critical-size bone defects is realized.

column12: Formula of anti-radiation selenized chitosan oligosaccharide and preparation method of anti-radiation selenized chitosan oligosaccharide
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical biology, and particularly relates to a formula and a preparation method of anti-radiation selenized chitosan oligosaccharide. Active substances in spinach, walnuts, flaxseeds, spina date seeds, mulberries and sea-buckthorn are extracted, the plant extracts are rich in antioxidants and other beneficial components, and potential harm of radiation to a human body can be reduced. L-arginine, saccharin calcium, nicotinamide and other cosolvents are adopted, and the substances are generally used in medicine and food industries, so that the extraction efficiency and the product stability are improved. Furthermore, the plant extract is combined with sodium selenite by using a selenylation microcapsule technology, so that the beneficial components can be stabilized and protected. The selenized microcapsules can control release, and continuous release and absorption of the selenized microcapsules in vivo are ensured.

column12: Pharmaceutical composition for treating gynecological inflammation and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating gynecological inflammation and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The preparation method comprises the following steps: performing water extraction and alcohol extraction on radix sophorae flavescentis, cortex phellodendri, fructus forsythiae and fructus ligustri lucidi to obtain a traditional Chinese medicine water extract and a traditional Chinese medicine alcohol extract, reacting the traditional Chinese medicine water extract with silver salt and copper salt to obtain a traditional Chinese medicine water extract-metal ion complex, and mixing the traditional Chinese medicine water extract-metal ion complex with the traditional Chinese medicine alcohol extract, sodium taurodeoxycholate, azone and berberine to obtain the nano drug delivery micelle. And adding the mixture into hydrogel of chitosan, poloxamer P407 and poloxamer P188 to prepare the pharmaceutical composition for treating gynecologic inflammation. The composition prepared by the invention has an extremely good treatment effect and low toxicity, so that the cost is reduced, the treatment effect on gynecological diseases such as chronic pelvic inflammation, chronic cervicitis, vaginitis, induced abortion complications and the like is improved, and the composition has a wide application prospect.

column12: Pine needle volatile oil sustained-release microcapsule and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a pine needle volatile oil sustained-release microcapsule and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: adding beta-cyclodextrin into distilled water, heating and stirring to dissolve the beta-cyclodextrin, cooling to a specified temperature after the solution is clarified, slowly adding pine needle volatile oil into the beta-cyclodextrin solution, stirring at the specified temperature, and then refrigerating in a refrigerator at 4 DEG C overnight to precipitate. And carrying out vacuum suction filtration, washing the obtained precipitate with absolute ethyl alcohol for three times, then washing with deionized water for one time, and carrying out freeze drying to obtain the single-layer microcapsule. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan quaternary ammonium salt in a 1% acetic acid solution, and fully stirring to obtain a clear chitosan quaternary ammonium salt solution; and mixing the single-layer microcapsule solution with a chitosan quaternary ammonium salt solution, carrying out ultrasonic treatment to uniformly emulsify the mixture, then carrying out constant-temperature oscillation, centrifugation, filtration and washing, adding a sodium alginate solution with the same amount as the chitosan quaternary ammonium salt, and repeating the steps to obtain the double-layer microcapsule. The process is simple to operate, green and environment-friendly, and automatic production can be realized. After the prepared single-layer microcapsule is placed in an indoor environment for 77 days, the volatile oil retention rate of the microcapsule can reach 70.8%; the volatile oil retention rate of the double-layer microcapsule can reach 59.8% after the double-layer microcapsule is baked in an oven at 100 DEG C for 80 minutes. Therefore, the prepared microcapsule has good slow-release performance, can effectively improve the problems of short fragrance retention time, easy volatilization, easy oxidative degradation and the like of the pine needle volatile oil, and provides theoretical support for research of the pine needle volatile oil slow-release microcapsule.

column13: The invention discloses a water-soluble auxiliary agent. column12: Chitosan-sodium carboxymethyl cellulose composite microsphere as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical biopolymer materials, and particularly relates to a chitosan-sodium carboxymethyl cellulose composite microsphere as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Sodium carboxymethylcellulose and chitosan are adopted as microsphere shell materials, carboxyl on sodium carboxymethylcellulose easily reacts with amino on chitosan, the stability of chitosan in an acid medium can be improved, and the mechanical strength is improved; meanwhile, hydroxyl and carboxyl on the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose have a relatively strong affinity effect on cations, and the chitosan contains polar groups such as hydroxyl and amino and also has certain adsorbability on the cations, so that the obtained composite microspheres can selectively adsorb cationic drugs and have relatively high drug adsorption performance; the material can be used as a drug controlled-release carrier material and an adsorbent. The method utilizes an electrostatic spraying or dropwise adding method, and is simple and convenient to operate, environment-friendly, capable of being continuously operated, mild in condition and low in cost.

column12: Chitosan-pyridylaldehyde schiff base film and preparation method thereof as well as chitosan-secondary aminopyridine film and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biomedical materials, and particularly relates to a chitosan-pyridylaldehyde schiff base film and a preparation method thereof, and a chitosan-secondary aminopyridine film and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of a chitosan-pyridylaldehyde Schiff base film, which comprises the following steps: mixing an acid solution of chitosan, a diluent and pyridylaldehyde to carry out condensation reaction, forming a film from an obtained solution containing a chitosan-pyridylaldehyde Schiff base product, and sequentially drying, washing and re-drying to obtain the chitosan-pyridylaldehyde Schiff base film. According to the preparation method, chitosan is modified, a chitosan-pyridylaldehyde schiff base film is prepared, and then a chitosan-secondary aminopyridine film is prepared. When the two modified chitosan films are used for adsorption and controlled release of iodine, compared with a chitosan film, the adsorption and complexing ability of the modified chitosan films to iodine is greatly improved, the content of iodine in the film after iodine adsorption is increased, and the controlled release time of iodine is prolonged.

column12: Bi-crosslinking hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses bi-crosslinking hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of biomedical engineering. Adding a certain amount of nano-hydroxyapatite into the oxidized sodium alginate solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain a first solution for later use; adding a certain amount of carboxymethyl chitosan into the alendronate sodium solution and the phenyl (2, 4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl) lithium phosphate solution, then adding a certain amount of methacrylated gelatin, and fully mixing to obtain a second solution for later use; mixing the first solution and the second solution in equal volume, waiting for 1 minute, and performing ultraviolet radiation to form gel, so as to obtain the double-crosslinking hydrogel. column12: Preparation method and application of drug-loaded interpenetrating network hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a drug-loaded interpenetrating network hydrogel. Comprising the following steps: firstly, taking cellulose acetate and tetraethyl orthosilicate as precursors, preparing cellulose acetate/SiO2 composite nanofibers through an electrostatic spinning technology, and then obtaining the porous carbon nanofibers through a series of hydrolysis, pre-oxidation, carbon thermal reaction and carbon thermal reduction. And finally, by taking the porous carbon nanofiber grafted chitosan as a skeleton, compounding acrylic acid with the nanofiber in an interpenetrating network structure form to obtain the porous carbon nanofiber grafted chitosan/polyacrylic acid interpenetrating network hydrogel. The porous carbon nanofiber grafted chitosan/polyacrylic acid interpenetrating network hydrogel is expected to be widely applied to drug sustained release.

column12: Coated double-load pesticide controlled-release granule as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide preparation, and particularly relates to coated double-load pesticide controlled-release granules as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The granule comprises an inner core layer and a dual-network hybrid gel layer, the dual-network hybrid gel layer comprises a water-soluble substance and a magnetic substance, and the water-soluble substance comprises carboxymethyl cellulose and chitosan quaternary ammonium salt. The granules prepared by the invention are low in cost, have good pesticide controlled release performance, still can achieve the same effect as commercial pesticides under a reduction condition, can promote plant growth, and provide a new technical support for creation of efficient green pesticide preparations.

column12: NATURAL-POLYPHENOLS-BASED MULTI-STAGE POROUS HYDROGEL SUSTAINED RELEASE DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM AND ITS PREPARATION METHOD
column13: This invention discloses a natural polyphenols-based, multi-stage porous hydrogel sustained release drug delivery system, which relates to the field of drug delivery. It consists of the hydrogel matrix and the supramolecular filler, which is a complex of natural bio-based polymers and metal ions. The natural bio-based polymer can be natural polyphenols, dopamine or its derivatives, polysaccharide biomass, or protein biomass. The hydrogel matrix can be chitosan, carboxymethyl chitosan, sodium alginate, carboxymethyl cellulose, hyaluronic acid, collagen, gelatin, or agarose. The metal ion can be one of the cations of Al, Fe, Zn, Mn, Ni, Co, or V. By this invention, the supramolecular filler based on natural bio-based polymer can form in situ in the hydrogel, to regulate the pores of the hydrogel and interact with different drugs, thus adjusting the drug release rate.

column12: Hemorrhage management system
column13: An embodiment includes a wound dressing comprising: a shape memory polymer (SMP) foam, including open cells, having first and second states; and a hydrogel (HG) included within the cells; wherein (a) in a first position a composite, including the SMP foam and the HG, is configured to be located proximate a hemorrhagic tissue with the SMP foam in the first state; (b) in a second position the composite is configured to be expanded to the second state against the hemorrhagic tissue when the SMP foam is plasticized at 37° C. depressing a glass transition temperature (Tg) of the SMP foam to below 25° C. Other embodiments are described herein.

column12: Drug sustained-release temperature-sensitive hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of drug sustained-release temperature-sensitive hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: step 1, grafting a hydroxybutyl group on chitosan to prepare hydroxybutyl chitosan; and 2, selecting the swelled drug-loaded microspheres or platelet-rich plasma, and uniformly mixing the swelled drug-loaded microspheres or platelet-rich plasma with the hydroxybutyl chitosan to obtain the drug sustained-release temperature-sensitive hydrogel. The drug sustained-release temperature-sensitive hydrogel prepared by the invention has temperature responsiveness, is in a liquid state under a low-temperature condition, and can be delivered to an affected part through injection or a microcatheter; a gel state can be formed under the condition close to the body temperature, the gel reaches the heat balance temperature with the human body at the focus position, phase change is conducted on solid in the gel state, and then local retention of the loaded microspheres is achieved.

column12: Method for improving astragalus mongholicus embedding rate
column13: The invention provides a method for improving the embedding rate of astragalus membranaceus, and belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out superfine grinding on the traditional Chinese medicinal material astragalus membranaceus, carrying out deacetylation modification treatment on chitosan, then carrying out double-layer embedding on superfine powder by using sodium alginate and deacetylated chitosan, and carrying out ultrasonic spraying-vacuum freeze drying to obtain the astragalus membranaceus embedding powder. The milkvetch root sustained-release microcapsule prepared by the method disclosed by the invention solves the problems of poor drug stability, high irritation, short biological half-life period, fast in-vivo metabolic degradation, limited bioavailability and short curative effect duration after traditional Chinese medicinal materials are subjected to superfine grinding, and the embedding rate of the microcapsule is remarkably improved; the drug concentration of the core material and the surface integrity of the wall material are improved, and the loss of active ingredients is avoided, so that the drug quality is more stable, more efficient and longer.

column12: PREPARATION METHOD FOR ABSORBABLE VASCULAR STENT COATING FOR INFANT NARROW BLOOD VESSEL
column13: The present invention provides a method for preparing a drug-loaded micelle for an absorbable vascular stent coating for an infant narrow blood vessel, comprising the following steps: S1: dissolving a drug to be encapsulated in an appropriate amount of an emulsifier, then adding chitosan-polydioxanone amphiphilic block copolymer andfully mixing to prepare a drug-copolymer solution; S2: adding drop by drop the drug-copolymer solution obtained in S1 to a pre-prepared emulsifier aqueous solution, and continuously stirring until a stable drug-carrying micelle solution is formed; S3: subjecting the micelle solution of S2 to reduced pressure evaporation, so as to remove the emulsifier and then stirring, and sequentially performing centrifugal separation, filtration and dialysis on the product to obtain a drug-carrying micelle. Also specifically disclosed is that the drug-loaded micelle is sprayed on the surface of an absorbable vascular stent to prepare a drug-loaded coating, thereby significantly improving the biocompatibility thereof, and by means of the pH value of the pH-responsive drug-loaded micelle changing with the depredation of the scaffold framework and the blank top layer, achieving the purpose of drug sustained release.

column12: GRAPHENE-BASED DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE FOR MUCOSAL AND TRANSMUCOSAL ADMINISTRATION
column13: The present invention relates to a device for mucosal and transmucosal drug delivery providing a controlled release of active pharmaceutical ingredients. The drug delivery device of the invention comprises at least one drug reservoir, said drug reservoir comprising at least one active pharmaceutical ingredient loaded on graphene and/or its derivatives, such as graphene oxide, and a microcontroller able to deliver electrical current and able to connect to an electronic device, wherein the release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient from said drug reservoir is controlled by said microcontroller. The device can also comprise a biosensor system to collect biometric information in order to interact with the drug delivery in a closed-loop system.

column12: Chitosan sodium alginate hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a chitosan sodium alginate hydrogel preparation method, which comprises: S1, preparing five clean small beakers, sequentially adding SA, deionized water and glacial acetic acid into each beaker, uniformly stirring with a glass rod, adding CS, and continuously uniformly stirring; s2, respectively adding 0.32 mL of glutaraldehyde, 0.96 mL of glutaraldehyde, 1.28 mL of glutaraldehyde, 1.60 mL of glutaraldehyde and 2.12 mL of glutaraldehyde, uniformly stirring, reacting at room temperature for 24 hours, and taking out after a sample is gelatinized; and S3, putting into a clean culture dish, uniformly cutting the hydrogel into four blocks, putting into a refrigerator for low-temperature preservation, and putting into a freeze dryer for freeze drying after a period of time. The chitosan/sodium alginate hydrogel prepared by the invention has the advantages of high crosslinking strength, high drug loading and high drug release, and is of great significance to further research on the controlled release performance of the hydrogel; and a simple and efficient preparation method is provided for preparation of the high-strength hydrogel.

column12: Phospholipid drug-loading system for delivering erythema and preparation and application of phospholipid drug-loading system
column13: The invention provides a phospholipid drug delivery system for delivering erythema as well as preparation and application of the phospholipid drug delivery system. The preparation method of the phospholipid drug delivery system comprises the following steps: dissolving erythema and phospholipid in an ethanol solution to obtain an organic phase; dissolving chitosan in an acetic acid solution, adding a surfactant, fully dissolving, and uniformly mixing to obtain a water phase; under a stirring state, slowly injecting the organic phase into the water phase to obtain the phospholipid drug delivery system for delivering the erythema. Wherein in the phospholipid drug delivery system, the mass percentage content of erythema is 0.06%-0.09%, the volume percentage content of the surfactant is 1.7%-5%, the mass percentage content of phospholipid is 1%-3%, the mass ratio of the chitosan to the phospholipid is 1: 20-1: 10, and the volume ratio of the organic phase to the water phase is 1: 49-4: 46. The phospholipid drug-loading system prepared by the invention is high in encapsulation efficiency and good in stability.

column13: Wound healing is a process by which these wounds on the skin of a subject heal and eventually close. column12: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS TO PROMOTE BRAIN HEALTH
column13: The present disclosure provides a composition comprising an active ingredient that is encapsulated in suspension of particles comprising a biodegradable polymer containing an effective amount of the active ingredient, wherein the particles are configured to bypass the blood brain barrier, wherein the nutraceutical agent is synthetic D-beta hydroxybutyrate, and wherein targeted delivery is to the brain. It further provides a method for promoting healing of the brain after a traumatic brain injury comprising neuroinflammation and a method for promoting brain health. It further provides a pharmaceutical composition for use in reducing risk of brain damage due to an acquired brain injury in a subject susceptible to, or otherwise at risk of, the acquired brain injury, said composition comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier and a formulation comprising a therapeutic amount of an API, wherein the API is a synthetic D-beta-hydroxybutyrate, wherein the treatment comprises targeted delivery to the olfactory region of the nasal cavity of the subject by administering the composition intranasally (a) before the subject participates in an event where an acquired brain injury is a known risk; (b) after the subject participates in the event for use in treating symptoms of the acquired brain injury of the subject comprising neuroinflammation; or both, wherein the treatment is neuroprotective.

column12: Saline-alkali soil conditioner with controlled release and plant growth promotion functions and preparation method of saline-alkali soil conditioner
column13: The invention discloses a microcapsule type saline-alkali soil conditioner with sustained and controlled release and plant growth promotion functions and a preparation method of the microcapsule type saline-alkali soil conditioner. The alkaline earth conditioner is composed of a capsule shell and a content located in the capsule shell. Wherein the raw materials for forming the capsule shell are chitosan oligosaccharide and a cross-linking agent; the content comprises a functional organic acid and an active divalent cation material. The capsule shell is a cross-linked netted polymer film which is formed by chitosan oligosaccharide and a cross-linking agent through a covalent cross-linking effect and has a sustained and controlled release function. Functional organic acids, active divalent cation materials and the like are coated in the microcapsules, and the microcapsules can generate acid-base neutralization, ion replacement and bridging effects with saline-alkali soil colloids, so that the pH and ESP of the soil are reduced in a long-acting manner, and the soil structure is improved. column12: Preparation method and application of temperature-sensitive chitosan-based microcapsule based on double emulsion-single condensation

column12: Multifunctional carboxymethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides multifunctional carboxymethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a quaternized carboxymethyl chitosan solution, an aldehyde modified hyaluronic acid solution, an adipic dihydrazide acid solution and a calcium chloride solution; wherein the mass ratio of the quaternized carboxymethyl chitosan to the aldehyde modified hyaluronic acid to the adipic dihydrazide acid to the calcium chloride is 6: 18: (1-3): 1; and naturally cooling and molding the mixed solution at 25-37 DEG C to obtain the multifunctional carboxymethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid hydrogel. column12: Phenylboronic acid modified chitosan-based microneedle patch and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a phenylboronic acid modified chitosan-based microneedle patch and a preparation method thereof. The micro-needle patch is prepared by attaching a mixed gel micro-needle to the back patch, wherein the mixed gel micro-needle is prepared by mixing a glucose response part, insulin and polymer hydrogel. The method comprises the following steps: dispersing a glucose response part in a diluted hydrochloric acid solution, adding insulin, adding polymer hydrogel, and mixing to obtain a precursor of microneedle mixed gel; injecting into a microneedle mold, centrifuging in a centrifugal machine, and drying to constant weight to obtain a mixed gel microneedle; the chitosan-based microneedle patch is attached to a back patch to prepare the chitosan-based microneedle patch. The preparation method of the microneedle patch is simple and convenient, and the safety of raw materials is high. The drug has sensitive glucose concentration responsiveness and a long-acting controllable release process, the treatment process is painless and minimally invasive, the risk of hypoglycemia is effectively avoided, the bioavailability of the drug is improved, and the treatment risk and side effects caused by subcutaneous injection of insulin can be reduced.

column12: Temperature-sensitive sustained-release gel type drug delivery system and application thereof in subcutaneous implant
column13: The invention relates to a temperature-sensitive sustained-release gel type drug delivery system and application thereof in subcutaneous implants. A hypoglycemic drug glimepiride (GLM) is prepared into a temperature-sensitive slow-release gel type subcutaneous implant for in-vivo hypoglycemic research. According to the invention, a third-generation sulfonylurea hypoglycemic drug glimepiride is loaded on graphene oxide (GO) and wrapped in a temperature-sensitive material hydroxybutyl chitosan (HBC) to prepare a sustained-release gel type subcutaneous implant drug delivery system. Compared with a traditional glimepiride oral administration mode, the novel administration system can reduce the administration frequency of the medicine, so that the medicine can be continuously and slowly released, the stable blood concentration is maintained, and a series of adverse reactions such as the liver first-pass effect and gastrointestinal tract damage are avoided. And the medicine can be directly implanted in a specific position in a subcutaneous injection manner to exert the medicine effect, and does not need to be implanted or taken out through an operation.

column12: Preparation method and application of composite hydrogel based on bioadhesive nanoparticles
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of composite hydrogel based on bioadhesive nanoparticles. Bioadhesive nanoparticles BNP based on PLA-HPG react with carboxymethyl chitosan, and reversible Schiff base bonds are formed through aldehyde groups on the surface of BNP and amino groups of carboxymethyl chitosan, so that BNP and macromolecules are crosslinked, and the composite hydrogel which has a porous network structure and contains the bioadhesive nanoparticles is formed. The composite hydrogel has good biocompatibility and injectability, the BNP and a porous structure in the composite hydrogel enable the hydrogel to simultaneously deliver water-insoluble and water-soluble drugs, and the composite hydrogel has a slow release effect, can be applied to abdominal cavity drug delivery, skin drug delivery and the like, greatly expands the application value of the BNP, and has a huge potential application prospect.

column12: Thermosensitive modified chitosan hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses temperature-sensitive modified chitosan hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The temperature-sensitive modified chitosan hydrogel is chitosan jointly modified by hydroxybutyl and polyphenol. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, by taking 1, 2-epoxybutane as an etherifying agent, introducing hydroxybutyl on a chitosan molecular chain; secondly, in the polyphenol part, free amino groups of hydroxybutyl chitosan and carboxyl groups of gallic acid are subjected to condensation reaction to introduce polyphenol groups; the polyphenol modified chitosan aqueous solution is in a solution flowing state at low temperature and can be injected for use, and when the temperature rises to about 37 DEG C, thermo-sensitive hydrogel can be formed. Due to the introduction of polyphenol groups, the oxidation resistance and tissue adhesion capacity of the material are improved. The polyphenol modified chitosan component prepared by the method is high in safety and good in biocompatibility, and has a wide application prospect in the fields of drug delivery, tissue engineering, cell culture and the like.

column13: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of medicines, and in particular, to a composite scaffold material, a preparation method therefor and use thereof. The fiber framework material is coated with positively charged biocompatible materials and negatively charged biocompatible materials alternately, by means of electrostatic attraction. The composite scaffold material of the present disclosure overcomes the defects of traditional scaffold materials, such as poor hydrophilicity, biocompatibility, histiocyte adhesion ability, and biological induction activity. Therefore the composite scaffold material has a wide range of industrial uses.

column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly discloses a drug-loadable embolism microsphere and a preparation method thereof.The drug-loadable embolism microsphere contains an amphiphilic structure, and the amphiphilic structure is a polymer containing a hydrophobic chain segment and a hydrophilic chain segment at the same time; a hydrophilic chain segment in the amphiphilic structure is from at least one of polyethylene glycol, alginate and chitosan, and a hydrophobic chain segment is from at least one of polyoxypropylene, polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid and polycaprolactone; the amphiphilic structure is derived from an amphiphilic macromonomer of a carbon-carbon double bond functional group, and due to the introduction of a hydrophobic structure of the amphiphilic macromonomer, the microsphere can resist swelling caused by excessive water absorption, and can keep a stable physical size without shrinkage after adsorbing a hydrophobic drug; and the hydrophobic property of the microspheres can improve the adsorption capacity and release rate of the drug, and compared with mainstream drug-loading embolism microspheres, the microsphere has better anti-deformation performance and drug delivery performance.

column12: CS-g-PNVCL microgel and preparation method of stable Pickering emulsion of CS-g-PNVCL microgel
column13: The invention discloses a CS-g-PNVCL microgel and a preparation method of a stable Pickering emulsion of the CS-g-PNVCL microgel, and relates to the technical field of materials, chitosan and N-vinyl-caprolactam are used as raw materials to prepare flexible microgel particles, the whole preparation process of the CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles is simple, the raw materials are few, and the raw material cost is low; compared with the prior art, the CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles prepared by the method have the advantages that toxicity polymerization is not increased, the obtained CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles have good biocompatibility, the defects of inorganic particles and biomacromolecules are effectively avoided, and the CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles have better applicability in the fields of food science, drug controlled release, interface catalysis and the like. According to the CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles prepared through the preparation method of the CS-g-PNVCL microgel particles, the stable Pickering emulsion can be prepared through the method, no extra stabilizer needs to be added in the preparation process, water and an oil phase can be mixed into the Pickering emulsion only by adding the prepared material, and the Pickering emulsion can stably exist for 60 days or longer.

column12: Muco-adhesive, controlled release formulations of levodopa and/or esters of levodopa and uses thereof
column13: The invention provides an oral solid formulation comprising (a) a controlled release component comprising a core comprising levodopa, wherein the core is coated with a layer of a muco-adhesive polymer and externally coated with a layer of an enteric polymer; and (b) an immediate release component comprising carbidopa and levodopa.

column12: Photo-crosslinking GSH/ROS response targeting chitosan-based drug carrier and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of stimulation response drug carriers, and particularly relates to a photo-crosslinking GSH/ROS response targeting chitosan-based drug carrier and a preparation method and application of the photo-crosslinking GSH/ROS response targeting chitosan-based drug carrier. Dissolving the synthesized coumarin bis/mono-sulfur derivative photosensitive monomer in DMSO, activating by EDC.HCl and NHS, slowly adding glycyrrhetinic acid modified chitosan dissolved in deionized water under ultrasound, dialyzing the obtained product, and freeze-drying; and dropwise adding a drug dissolved in DMSO into an aqueous solution of a freeze-dried product, continuously stirring, carrying out irradiation reinforcement polymerization under 365nm ultraviolet irradiation, and drying the organic solvent by distillation to obtain the photo-crosslinking GSH/ROS response targeting chitosan-based drug carrier with good biocompatibility and environmental responsiveness.

column12: A DRUG DELIVERY COMPOSITION FOR TREATING MYOCARDIAL INFRACTION (MI)
column13: A drug delivery composition for healing myocardial infarction (MI) is disclosed. The drug delivery composition includes a plurality of core-shell structured microbubbles and a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) solution. The plurality of core-shell structured microbubbles is dispersed in the PVA solution. Each core-shell structured microbubble of the plurality of core-shell structured microbubbles includes a core and a shell surrounding the core. The core includes liquid perfluorohexane (PFH). The shell includes poly(D,L-lactide-co-glycolide)-heparin-polyethylene glycol-cyclic arginine glycine aspartate-platelet (PLGA-HP-PEG-cRGD- platelet), basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF), at least one stabilizing agent, and at least a fluorescent label.

column12: Drug-loaded liposome hydrogel containing oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid vesicles
column13: The invention discloses a drug-loaded liposome hydrogel containing oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid vesicles, and belongs to the technical field of sustained-release system preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: polymerizing conjugated linoleic acid to prepare oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid, then self-assembling OCLA into oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid vesicles, and loading OCLAVs into a drug to prepare the drug-loaded oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid vesicles; and then the drug-loaded oligomeric conjugated linoleic acid vesicles are included in a chitosan hydrogel system to prepare the drug-loaded liposome hydrogel. Therefore, the OCLAVs and CS hydrogel are used as a double-layer drug release barrier, and the encapsulation and slow release effects of the drug are improved. The drug-loaded liposome hydrogel disclosed by the invention is good in biocompatibility, simple in preparation process and easily available in raw materials, can be used for embedding both hydrophobic drugs and hydrophilic drugs, and can be used for relieving the burst release effect of chitosan hydrogel.

column12: Oral prolonged drug delivery platforms
column13: In an embodiment, a pH-responsive drug delivery composition for prolonged drug delivery to a mucosal surface is provided. At acidic pH, the matrix self-seal and forms entity that protects the peptide/drug inside. Upon contact with fluids at neutral pH, the platform forms swollen gel-like matrix that can protect their cargoes, opens and adheres to mucosal surfaces and release their cargoes over extended period of time (e.g., up to one week). In some embodiments, the composition includes a polymer matrix comprising two or more layers and/or polymers, an agent, and one or more of a protease inhibitor and an absorption enhancer; and an enteric coating or capsule encapsulating the polymeric matrix. column12: Maleoyl chitosan macromolecular cross-linking agent and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biological material preparation, and discloses a maleoyl chitosan macromolecular cross-linking agent and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) adding chitosan and maleic acid into deionized water, heating, stirring and ultrasonically dispersing to obtain a solution A; (2) adding maleic acid, 1-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)-3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide into deionized water, and stirring and dissolving in an ice bath to obtain a solution B; (3) slowly dripping the solution A into the solution B under an ice bath condition, and reacting at a certain temperature to obtain a faint yellow reaction solution marked as a solution C; (4) dropwise adding the solution C into an excessive polar solvent to separate out a precipitate, and freeze-drying to obtain a maleyl chitosan macromolecular cross-linking agent which is relatively high in substitution degree and good in water solubility under neutral and alkaline conditions; the polymer can be used as a cross-linking agent in free radical copolymerization of various monomers containing double bonds, and high polymer materials with different properties such as green, nontoxic, good biocompatibility and biodegradability gel drug carriers and the like are prepared.

column12: Rosmarinic acid-chitosan-polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel dressing as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a rosmarinic acid-chitosan-polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel dressing as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the chitosan and polyvinyl alcohol-based hydrogel composite material is prepared. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan in acetic acid at room temperature, and dissolving polyvinyl alcohol in deionized water; and then mixing and stirring the chitosan solution and the polyvinyl alcohol solution. Adding tetraethoxysilane into the mixture, stirring, then adding rosmarinic acid, and blending, so as to obtain the rosmarinic acid-chitosan-polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel dressing. The swelling rate of the composite hydrogel can reach 130%, the accumulative release amount of rosmarinic acid in the composite hydrogel can reach 60%, and the composite hydrogel has an obvious effect of promoting healing of mouse wounds and has excellent moisture retention, adhesion and chemical stability. The hydrogel has the characteristics of simple process, long period of validity, environmental friendliness and the like, and can be used as a biomedical material in the fields of wound dressing, drug sustained release, soft tissue repair and the like.

column12: Two-stage microparticle-based therapeutic delivery system and method
column13: A system for delivery of a therapeutic agent to a site in mucosal tissue is provided. The system includes a porous, mucoadhesive polymeric matrix having a first and a second opposed surfaces. The matrix is formed by a composition including chitosan. The composition may also include any or all of a hydration promotor, a microparticle adhesion inhibitor, and a microparticle aggregation inhibitor. A plurality of microparticles having an average diameter between 500 nm and 2000 nm are embedded within the matrix. The microparticles contain a therapeutic agent and have a coating around the therapeutic agent. The first surface of the matrix is configured to be attached to the site in the mucosal tissue and the matrix is configured to provide controlled release of the microparticles through the first surface. The coating of the microparticles includes chitosan so as to provide controlled release of the agent from the microparticles.

column12: THIOLATED CHITOSAN AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
column13: The invention discloses a thiolated chitosan and a preparation method thereof, which is chitosan co-modified by hydroxybutyl and sulfhydryl.
