An aqueous solution of the thiolated chitosan of the invention is in a solution state at low temperature, and can be flow-injected. When the temperature rises to around 37° C., a hydrogel can be formed. Due to the introduction of sulfhydryl, the antioxidant ability and tissue adhesion ability of the material are increased. The thiolated chitosan prepared according to the method may have wide application prospects in an aspect such as tissue engineering, drug delivery systems, cell culture, cosmetics, etc.

column12: Chitosan/dialdehyde sodium alginate/dopamine magnetic hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to chitosan/dialdehyde sodium alginate/dopamine magnetic hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method of the chitosan/dialdehyde sodium alginate/dopamine magnetic hydrogel comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a chitosan solution, a dopamine hydrochloride solution, a dialdehyde sodium alginate solution and a sodium periodate solution with deionized water respectively; then uniformly mixing a chitosan solution with a dopamine hydrochloride solution, dropwise adding dialdehyde sodium alginate and a sodium periodate solution, uniformly mixing, finally adding ferroferric oxide nanoparticles, uniformly mixing, and cross-linking at 37 DEG C to obtain the black hydrogel. column12: TWO-DIMENSIONAL (2D) NANOCOMPOSITE, PREPARATION METHOD, AND USE THEREOF
column13: A nanocomposite includes an oxygen vacancy-containing BiOX particle and a coating, where the coating is a biocompatible material. Under near-infrared (NIR) irradiation, the nanocomposite has a photothermal conversion efficiency of greater than or equal to 10%. Under NIR irradiation, the nanocomposite degrades 1,3-diphenylisobenzofuran (DPBF) at a rate of higher than or equal to 0.1 mmol/h. BiOX may be BiOF, BiOCl, BiOBr, BiOI, or BiOAt. A preparation method and a use of the nanocomposite are further provided. The nanocomposite is a bismuth oxyhalide nanomaterial with different numbers of oxygen vacancies and can be used for the photothermal therapy (PTT) of a tumor and for the integrated tumor diagnosis and treatment. The nanocomposite leads to an excellent therapeutic effect under the guidance of multi-modality imaging, and has excellent computed tomography (CT) imaging and photoacoustic imaging (PAI) performance.

column12: Method of corneal transplantation or corneal inlay implantation with cross-linking
column13: A method of corneal implantation with cross-linking is disclosed herein. In one or more embodiments, the method includes the steps of: (i) prior to implantation, treating an implant formed from donor corneal tissue or a tissue culture grown corneal stroma with a solution of sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), Triton X-100, benzalkonium chloride (BAK), Igepal, genipin, 100% glycerol, or alcohol for making the implant acellular, and for killing any bacteria, viruses, or parasites prior to implantation; (ii) implanting the implant into a recipient cornea; (iii) applying laser energy to the implant so as to modify the refractive power of the implant while being monitored using a Shack-Hartmann wavefront system so as to achieve a desired refractive power for the implant; and (iv) applying a cross-linking solution and irradiating the implant to cross-link the implant to prevent an immune response to the implant and/or rejection of the implant by a patient.

column12: High-protein low-GI composite grain composition as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a high-protein low-GI composite grain composition and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of foods.The preparation method comprises the steps that pea protein powder and a white kidney bean extract are subjected to secondary enzymolysis, then fermented through lactobacillus plantarum, saccharomyces cerevisiae and lactobacillus bulgaricus and freeze-dried, enzymolysis fermentation protein peptide powder is obtained, and the high-protein low-GI composite grain composition is prepared. Embedding the protein particles with sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, sodium alginate and water-soluble chitosan to obtain sustained-release protein particles; the preparation method comprises the following steps: grinding a mixed colloid of oat flour and rice bran powder into fine powder, mixing the fine powder with wheat amylose, adjusting the moisture content, and performing twin-screw extrusion and spray drying to obtain low-GI puffed powder; and uniformly mixing the slow-release protein particles, the low-GI puffed powder and the prebiotic sweetening agent to obtain the high-protein low-GI composite cereal composition. column13: The invention provides a rhubarb charcoal-chitosan-silk fibroin composite material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The rhubarb charcoal-chitosan-silk fibroin composite material comprises a rhubarb charcoal-loaded silk fibroin/chitosan porous scaffold. A hydrogel support is prepared from chitosan and a silk fibroin solution, then rhubarb carbon nano-particles are loaded, and the injectable self-repairing tissue-adhesion rhubarb carbon hydrogel material for wound repairing is constructed by combining a chemical cross-linked network and a nano-enhanced structure. The rhubarb charcoal-chitosan-silk fibroin composite material for external and internal treatment of diabetic wounds is a novel traditional Chinese medicine hydrogel material with excellent physical and chemical properties, a drug sustained release function and tissue inductivity, meets the requirements of clinical wound healing, and meanwhile, can improve the healing effect of internal organs (such as internal organs and external organs) of a body in a skin absorption administration mode. Therefore, the treatment effect of treating both the inside and the outside is achieved.

column12: Method for controlled release of oral insulin based on starch film coated chitosan hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a method for controlled release of oral insulin based on starch film coated chitosan hydrogel, and belongs to the field of polysaccharide application and development. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing hydrogel by cross-linking chitosan with citric acid, then carrying out ultrasonic treatment to assist swelling of the chitosan hydrogel, and increasing an insulin diffusion process so as to improve the loading capacity. Then, through a starch film coating method, the gastric juice stability after the insulin-loaded chitosan hydrogel is orally taken is improved, meanwhile, the burst release problem of the insulin-loaded chitosan hydrogel is solved, and the release and digestion of insulin in the stomach can be effectively reduced; furthermore, based on the digestion characteristic of the starch coating film in intestinal juice, the hydrogel digested by the starch coating film is promoted to release insulin which is absorbed by small intestine epithelial cells to enter body fluid circulation, and the purpose of controlling blood sugar by oral administration of insulin is achieved. The structure of the hydrogel and the starch film can be adjusted by controlling the molecular weight of the chitosan, the raw materials for preparing the starch film, the addition amount of glycerol and other parameters, and controllable release of insulin is achieved.

column12: Rectum gel based on hydroxybutyl chitosan and graphene oxide as well as preparation method and application of rectum gel
column13: The invention relates to the field of rectal drug delivery system preparation, in particular to a preparation method and application of novel rectal gel based on hydroxybutyl chitosan and graphene oxide. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly preparing HBC through a homogeneous synthesis method, then preparing GO through an improved Hummers method, carrying an anti-cancer model drug PYM on the surface of the GO to obtain GO-coated PYM, and finally crosslinking the GO-coated PYM with HBC to obtain HBC/GO-coated PYM. By introducing the nano material GO, the defects of the in-situ temperature-sensitive gel are overcome, the drug loading capacity and the mechanical strength are improved, the drug release capacity and the bioavailability are improved, and the in-situ temperature-sensitive gel has an obvious slow release effect. The invention provides a new method for solving the problems of insufficient mechanical strength, low drug loading capacity, low bioavailability and the like of in-situ temperature-sensitive gel for rectal administration.

column12: Lacrimal ductule plug capable of slowly releasing fluorometholone and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a lacrimal ductule plug capable of slowly releasing fluorometholone. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing fluorometholone, polyhydroxybutyrate, chitosan and trilysine in a solvent, and uniformly mixing, wherein the mass ratio of fluorometholone to polyhydroxybutyrate to chitosan to trilysine is (0.02-1): (15-50): (10-50): (0.1-3); (2) carrying out cross-linking reaction at 40-45 DEG C for 10-20 hours, cooling and drying to obtain a mixture; and (3) carrying out plasma treatment on the mixture obtained in the step (2) for 10 seconds to 3 minutes under the pressure of less than 5 pa, and then curing and forming to obtain the lacrimal ductule plug for slowly releasing fluorometholone. According to the invention, fluorometholone, polyhydroxybutyrate, chitosan and trilysine are taken as raw materials for cross-linking reaction, and then plasma treatment is adopted to prepare the fluorometholone sustained-release lacrimal ductule plug, so that the number of times of using antibiotic drugs can be reduced or the antibiotic drugs do not need to be used, and the fluorometholone sustained-release lacrimal ductule plug is good in patient compliance, good in comfort, good in biocompatibility, short-term in degradation and small in side effect; the water swelling performance is good, and falling is not prone to occurring.

column12: Sulfur-containing silicon-based organic-inorganic hybrid hydrogel, preparation method and application
column13: The invention discloses sulfur-containing silicon-based organic-inorganic hybrid hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological and new medicine preparation.The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing tetrasulfide bond bridged mesoporous silica nanoparticles; then, oxidized dextran and quaternary ammonium salt carboxymethyl chitosan are prepared; and finally, preparing the sulfur-containing silicon-based organic-inorganic hybrid hydrogel by using mesoporous silica nanoparticles bridged by oxidized dextran, quaternary ammonium salt carboxymethyl chitosan and tetrasulfide bonds. The hydrogel has better mechanical property and antibacterial property, and can also be used as a drug carrier to realize stimulation response drug release at a tumor site in a traumatic acid environment, so that a slow release environment is provided for postoperative trauma and the postoperative recovery process of tumor is promoted. The problems that in the prior art, under the tumor postoperative acid environment, hydrogel is poor in mechanical performance, the structure is prone to being damaged, hydrogel intelligent response medicine release cannot be achieved, and the medicine release performance is poor are solved.

A first ISV specifically binds to a first BMP2 receptor, e.g. BMPR1a; and a second ISV specifically binds to a second BMP2 receptor, e.g. BMPR2. In some embodiments the first and second ISV are joined by a cleavable linker that is susceptible to proteases selectively expressed in monocytic cells or macrophages, relative to skeletal stem cells.

column12: METHOD FOR CONVERTING BIODEGRADABLE POLYMERS INTO HUMUS WITH A LOW RELEASE AMOUNT OF CO2 AND USE THEREOF
column13: The present invention relates to biodegradable polymers, particularly to a method for converting biodegradable polymers into humus with a low release amount of CO2 and use thereof. A composite material system is formed from the biodegradable polymers and the materials that can slowly release nutrient nitrogen or nutrients nitrogen and phosphorus, in which the mass ratio of carbon to nitrogen in the composite material system is (1-35):1. The materials of the present invention can promote the biodegradable polymers to be converted into soil humus or compost humus, rather than to be converted into greenhouse gas CO2, which is to be emitted into the atmosphere. Therefore, the method is of great significance for energy conservation and emission reduction, green and efficient utilization of biodegradable polymers and efficient and green utilization of biodegradable polymers wastes.

column12: POLYMER-BASED FILM, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: A polymer film has a loofah-like structure. It has a fibrous framework structure formed by three-dimensional interwoven and interconnected polymer fibers and a three-dimensional interconnected network pore structure distributed in the fibrous framework structure. The polymer is an organic polymer and the fibrous framework structure is integrally formed by the polymer. The film has a volume porosity of from 50% to 95%. The film is obtained by means of a combination method for atomization pretreatment and non-solvent phase separation. The film can be used in the fields of gas filtration, liquid filtration, oil-water separation, adsorption materials, catalysis, pharmaceutical sustained release materials, anti-adhesion coatings, oil delivery and oil spill interception.

column12: - / Orally cyclodextrin-curcumin encapsulated chitosan/alginate nanoparticles and use thereof in treating colitis
column13: The present invention relates to orally administrable nanoparticles of cyclodextrin-curcumin encapsulated chitosan/alginate and a use thereof in treating colitis, wherein curcumin (Cur) is added to ring-shaped β-cyclodextrin (CD) to form a water-soluble Cur-CD conjugate and then the Cur-CD conjugate is encapsulated by chitosan/alginate nanoparticles (CANPs). The generated Cur-CD-CANPs have unimodal size distribution and a negatively charged surface. The efficiency of encapsulation of Cur-CD-CANPs is 81.5 ± 7.4 % at an average diameter of 89.7 nm. In addition, as a result of an in vivo experiment, it is shown that oral administration of Cur-CD-CANPs has excellent therapeutic effects in DSS-induced colitis, compared to free CUR. According to a change in the body weight, a degree of bloody excrement, the length of the large intestine, and a result of histopathology, it is shown that the oral administration of Cur-CD-CANPs has excellent effects in treating DSS-induced colitis. Accordingly, the Cur-CD-CANPs of the present invention can be useful as a drug delivery system for oral administration in order to treat ulcerative colitis (UC).

column12: Preparation method and application of environment-sensitive chlorantraniliprole sustained-release agent
column13: The invention discloses a chlorantraniliprole (CAP) sustained-release suspending agent which is simple in process and environment-friendly as well as a preparation method and application of the chlorantraniliprole (CAP) sustained-release suspending agent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a chitosan solution and a DMF (Dimethyl Formamide) solution of CAP, and adding an alkaline solution for co-precipitation to obtain the slow-release agent. The product is milky white in appearance, the particle size in suspended particles is smaller than 70 microns, the drug loading capacity can reach 15-35%, the encapsulation efficiency is larger than 70%, the storage stability is good, and drug release shows obvious pH and temperature sensitivity. In view of the fact that intestinal juice in the lepidoptera pests is alkaline, the CAP is high in release rate and long in slow release time (gt) in a solution with the pH value of 9.0; 10d), the cumulative drug release rate is high (gt; compared with a traditional commercial agent, the insecticidal composition has a longer lasting period on plutella xylostella, so that the insecticidal composition has potential targeting property on lepidoptera pests and has good application potential in the aspect of preventing and treating the lepidoptera pests. In addition, the method shows a good prevention and treatment effect on flower breeding powdery mildew coccid.

column12: FORMULATION AND METHOD FOR TREATMENT OF URINARY SYSTEM DISORDERS
column13: The invention provides a formulation and method for the treatment of urinary system disorders, wherein the formulation comprises a controlled release drug delivery system for intravesicular administration to a patient. Controlled release microparticles in the formulation are comprised of a pharmacologically active agent and a controlled release carrier, where the microparticles are buoyant in urine. column12: PH-responsive sodium carboxymethyl cellulose/magnesium oxide/folic acid coupled chitosan targeting nanoparticles as well as preparation method and application of pH-responsive sodium carboxymethyl cellulose/magnesium oxide/folic acid coupled chitosan targeting nanoparticles
column13: The invention discloses a pH response type sodium carboxymethyl cellulose/magnesium oxide/folic acid coupled chitosan targeting nanoparticle as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of nanoparticles capable of realizing swelling of different degrees by utilizing pH sensitivity aiming at a weakly acidic tumor microenvironment. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing magnesium oxide doped carboxymethyl cellulose into nanoparticles by adopting a reversed-phase microemulsion method and using iron ions Fe < 3 + > as a cross-linking agent, and then preparing the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose/magnesium oxide nanoparticles and folic acid coupled chitosan into the double-layer composite nanoparticles with a core-shell structure by adopting an electrostatic self-assembly method. The prepared nanoparticle is a pH-sensitive drug carrier with a cavity structure, cell death is caused by the fact that the nanoparticle swells to different degrees under different pH conditions, the size is increased, a cell or lysosome structure is damaged, and the preparation process is simple in process and easy to operate.

column12: METHODS, SYSTEMS, AND DEVICES FOR GENERATING DEFINED FIBER CONSTRUCTS
column13: Systems, devices, and methods for generating fiber constructs via electrospinning are disclosed herein. The system for generating fiber constructs includes an ejection device and a collector. The collector contains a collection surface with patterns formed by conductive trace(s). The conductive trace(s) is arranged such that the resulting electric field lines are either undisturbed electrostatic field lines or blurred electrostatic field lines aligned around each conductive trace. Methods of generating fiber constructs using the system via electrospinning includes applying an electrostatic charge to the ejection device or a component thereof. The formed fiber construct has a grammage that is at least 5% higher than a grammage of a fiber construct formed on an un-patterned collector under the same conditions. The electrospun fiber constructs may be used for forming engineered tissues or implants, wound dressings, drug delivery formulations, and implant or device coatings.

column12: Absorbable implants for plastic surgery
column13: Absorbable implants for breast surgery that conform to the breast parenchyma and surrounding chest wall have been developed. These implants support newly lifted breast parenchyma, and/or a breast implant. The implants have mechanical properties sufficient to support a reconstructed breast, and allow the in-growth of tissue into the implant as it degrades. The implants have a strength retention profile allowing the support of the breast to be transitioned from the implant to regenerated host tissue, without significant loss of support. Three-dimensional implants for use in minimally invasive mastopexy/breast reconstruction procedures are also described, that confer shape to a patient's breast. These implants are self-reinforced, can be temporarily deformed, implanted in a suitably dissected tissue plane, and resume their preformed three-dimensional shape. The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column12: Preparation method of high-load oral paclitaxel capsule for colon slow release
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-load oral paclitaxel capsule for colon slow release, and belongs to the field of porous starch drug loading. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dropwise adding an ethanol solution of paclitaxel into a water phase, and drying to obtain amorphous paclitaxel microspheres; (2) redissolving the paclitaxel microspheres prepared in the step (1) into an ethanol solution, dispersing the porous starch into the ethanol solution for adsorption, then performing solvent volatilization in a drying oven, washing with the ethanol solution to remove unadsorbed paclitaxel, and centrifuging to obtain a precipitate, namely the paclitaxel-loaded porous starch; and (3) dispersing the paclitaxel-loaded porous starch prepared in the step (2) into a chitosan solution, dropwise adding the solution into a phytic acid solution, and stirring for 4 hours to obtain the coated capsule. column12: Alkoxy ether dendronized chitosan microgel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an alkoxy ether dendronized chitosan microgel and a preparation method and application thereof.According to the alkoxy ether dendronized chitosan microgel, chitosan modified by alkoxy ether dendronized primitives is used as a raw material, and by means of the excellent morphology control function of liquid drop microfluidics, the alkoxy ether dendronized chitosan microgel is prepared; the alkoxy ether dendronized chitosan microgel with uniform size distribution is prepared by combining Schiff base chemical crosslinking. The microgel has excellent biocompatibility of chitosan, pH responsiveness brought by Schiff base dynamic chemical bonds and temperature responsiveness of alkoxy ether dendronized primitives, has an environment shielding effect, and can envelope and protect bioactive substances such as protein and cells. By using a microfluidic technology, cells can be encapsulated by the microgel in the preparation process, and the microgel can be used as a cell culture substrate material, so that the cell activity can be maintained, and the cells can be controllably split and released by regulating the pH value. The obtained microgel can be applied to cell matrix materials and can also be applied to other tissue engineering and drug controlled release fields.

column13: The invention provides EPS (Expandable Polystyrene) composite acid skin-refreshing gel as well as a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a lactic acid bacteria fermentation extract and a sodium alginate aqueous solution, putting the mixture into an ultrasonic oscillator, and treating for 15-20 minutes under the conditions that the temperature is 40-45 DEG C and the power is 110-120W to obtain a lactic acid bacteria fermentation extract-sodium alginate aqueous solution; salicylic acid, capryloyl salicylic acid, glycolic acid, mandelic acid, citric acid, lactic acid, chitosan and purified water are mixed and stirred for 8-12 min under the conditions that the temperature is 30-35 DEG C and the rotating speed is 750-850 rpm, and a composite acid chitosan water solution is obtained; (2) injecting the lactobacillus fermentation extract-sodium alginate aqueous solution obtained in the step (1) into the composite acid chitosan aqueous solution by using a needle tube, and keeping stirring in the injection process; and adding menthol and sodium hyaluronate, putting the mixture into a homogenizer, homogenizing for 20-30 minutes at 3-5 MPa, then homogenizing for 5-10 minutes at 8-12 MPa, and sterilizing to obtain the traditional Chinese medicine composition. column12: Paclitaxel nanoemulsion inhalation preparation for targeted therapy of lung cancer and preparation method of paclitaxel nanoemulsion inhalation preparation
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a paclitaxel nano preparation, which is characterized in that the plasma half-life period of paclitaxel is prolonged, and the toxicity of paclitaxel is reduced. The paclitaxel nano preparation is composed of paclitaxel, poloxamer, chitosan, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, an emulsifier and other pharmaceutic adjuvants. The inner water phase is composed of a poloxamer aqueous solution, after the poloxamer aqueous solution and the paclitaxel-containing PLGA organic phase form primary emulsion, the primary emulsion is injected into a chitosan-containing PVA solution to form multiple emulsion, stirring is performed at the room temperature to volatilize an organic solvent, insoluble substances are removed through centrifugation, and washing and freeze drying are performed to obtain the paclitaxel-containing poloxamer hydrogel. According to the preparation method of the paclitaxel nano preparation, paclitaxel is dissolved in an organic phase containing PLGA, a hydrophobic environment is provided, the stability of paclitaxel is improved, the half-life period of plasma is prolonged, and the dosage of paclitaxel is reduced. The invention provides a targeted drug delivery inhalation preparation for treating lung cancer, which prolongs the half-life period of the drug and reduces the continuous damage of high-dose drugs to human bodies.

column13: The invention relates to antibacterial, adhesive and self-healing hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Wherein quaternary ammonium salt and catechol are modified in a hydrogel network in situ, so that the hydrogel is endowed with antibacterial activity; the aldehyde group and amino in chitosan or gelatin can form a dynamic bond (Schiff base) to endow the hydrogel with self-healing performance; the mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles loaded in the matrix material can be used as nano cross-linking points of the hydrogel to form abundant hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds and pi-pi bonds with the hydrogel matrix, so that the mechanical property, brittle fracture resistance, adhesion and self-healing property of the hydrogel are further improved; as the mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles can be used as a drug carrier and have a photothermal conversion effect, the release of the drug can be regulated and controlled by controlling the intensity of near-infrared light, so that the controllable release of the drug is realized.

column12: Size transformation type nano drug delivery carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly discloses a size transformation type nano drug delivery carrier and a preparation method and application thereof.The nano drug delivery carrier is a compound formed by an azobenzene compound and water-soluble chitosan or chitosan derivatives through electrostatic interaction or hydrogen bond or covalent bond combination; the nano drug delivery carrier can stably exist in blood circulation of a living body, and can respond to reducing substances in a focus microenvironment to generate nitrogen-nitrogen double bond reductive cleavage, so that the change of the size of the nano drug delivery carrier is realized. The large initial size of the nano drug delivery carrier can guarantee that the carrier obtains long circulation time to promote focus enrichment, nitrogen-nitrogen double bonds in azobenzene are reduced and then converted into carriers with small particle sizes, tissue permeation can be enhanced, so that drugs are delivered to the deep part of focus tissues to exert curative effects, and the drug delivery carrier is simple in chemical composition, good in stability and suitable for industrial production. The traditional Chinese medicine composition has small toxic and side effects and good application value.

column12: Astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid gel transdermal drug delivery preparation and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of pharmaceutical preparations, in particular to an astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid gel transdermal drug delivery preparation which is prepared from the following raw materials: astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid and a water-soluble gel matrix, and the water-soluble gel matrix comprises carboxymethyl chitosan. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid by an injection method; and (2) weighing the water-soluble gel matrix according to the prescription amount, adding the water-soluble gel matrix into water for overnight swelling, adjusting the pH value to be neutral by using triethanolamine, adding the prepared astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid, and uniformly stirring to obtain the astragaloside dihydric alcohol plastid gel. Under the combined action of carboxymethyl chitosan, carbomer and other components, the retention rate of astragaloside on the skin can be effectively increased, and the healing rate can be effectively increased in the early stage of wound healing.

column12: PROCESS FOR THE PREPARATION OF LIPIDATED PROTEINACEOUS STRUCTURES
column13: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of a conjugate, comprising a biological molecule, an enzymatic tag, a hydrophilic spacer, a linker and a lipophilic moiety using enzymatic coupling.

column12: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR PROTECTING AGAINST MICROBIAL HAZARDS
column13: An antimicrobial material that includes an antimicrobial layer comprising an antimicrobial agent entrapped within a polymer matrix is provided. The polymer matrix is water stable, and an exposed surface of the antimicrobial layer exhibits sustained-release antimicrobial properties for at least 7 days. A composition for forming the antimicrobial material is also provided, as well as, a method of making the antimicrobial material.

column12: A Composition for the Delivery of Biologically Active Agents and Uses Thereof
column13: The invention relates generally to a composition for rapid and sustained delivery of one or more biologically active agents, and uses thereof, wherein the composition comprises short biocompatible polymer fibres (SPF) having an average length in the range of from about 1 pm to about 3 mm, and an average diameter in the range of from about 15 nm to about 5 μm, wherein the SPF are loaded with one or more biologically active agents, and wherein, when administered, the composition provides rapid and sustained release of the one or more biologically active agents from the SPF.

column12: Chitosan nanofibers containing bioactive compounds
column13: The invention relates to self-assembled nanofibers of chitosan and bioactive compounds for use as nutraceuticals or drugs. Suitable bioactive compounds include molecules of a low molecular size with acid or lactone groups, aromatic rings and hydroxyls. The nanofibers are absorbed, without degradation, in the small intestine, containing and protecting the bioactive compounds until they reach target organs. The nanofibers also cross the blood-brain barrier, allowing the compounds to reach the brain where they act as a controlled release system. If the bioactive compounds are neuroprotectors, the nanofibers can treat or prevent neurodegenerative diseases, strokes and other diseases related to aging or associated with oxidative stress. The invention also relates to a method for obtaining the nanofibers involving mixing chitosan with the bioactive compounds and allowing self-assembly. The invention further relates to a dosage form containing the nanofibers, particularly for oral administration.

column12: Crosslinked corn porous starch loaded curcumin composite gel microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a crosslinked corn porous starch loaded curcumin composite gel microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The composite gel microsphere is prepared by the following steps: adding a curcumin/cross-linked porous starch compound into a carboxymethyl cellulose solution, adding zinc oxide, and uniformly mixing and stirring in a water bath; dropwise adding into a ferric chloride or calcium chloride solution to form gel microspheres, transferring the gel microspheres into a chitosan solution, stirring, and carrying out outer-layer film wrapping treatment, so as to obtain the hydrogel microspheres. The curcumin/cross-linked porous starch compound is formed by adding cross-linked corn porous starch into a curcumin alcoholic solution for adsorption; the cross-linked corn porous starch is obtained by adding a cross-linking agent into a corn porous starch suspension; the corn porous starch suspension is obtained by preparing corn porous starch through pulsed electric field assisted enzymolysis. The stability of curcumin can be effectively improved, the effect of directionally releasing curcumin to the small intestine or colon is achieved, and the curcumin drug delivery system is very effective.

column12: Preparation method of nano-fiber membrane based on controlled-release embedding of flavor substances
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a nanofiber membrane based on controlled release embedding flavor substances. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, adding a polyvinyl alcohol solution into a chitosan solution, then dropwise adding a synergistic flavoring substance, and sealing, stirring and dissolving to obtain a shell solution; the mass concentration of the synergistic flavoring substance in the shell layer solution is 0.5 to 1.5 g/100mL; mixing the zein solution with the gelatin solution, and adding a flavor substance to obtain a core layer solution; the concentration of the flavor substance in the core layer solution is 12-15g/100mL; and finally, the shell layer solution and the core layer solution are subjected to coaxial electrostatic spinning to obtain the nanofiber membrane. The content of the flavor substance in each unit square centimeter of the nanofiber membrane is 0.006 to 0.0075 g. The invention provides an edible nanofiber membrane capable of precisely controlling the controlled release of flavor substances in unit area, and solves the problems of non-uniform distribution of embedded substances and poor taste.

column12: Rapid separation type liposome composite sustained-release microneedle and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of microneedle drug delivery systems, and particularly relates to a rapid separation type lipidosome composite sustained-release microneedle and a preparation method thereof.The microneedle comprises a needle tip layer, a separation layer and a base layer, the separation layer is located between the needle tip layer and the base layer, lipidosome is dispersed in the needle tip layer, and the separation layer is located between the needle tip layer and the base layer. The needle point layer and the lipidosome of the needle point layer can carry drugs, and the drugs can be different drugs; the needle tip layer is prepared from glucan and chitosan; the liposome is prepared from phosphatidylcholine and cholesterol; the separation layer is prepared from a high-molecular polymer with a polar group and small-molecular sugar; the base layer is prepared from a high-molecular polymer material. The separated liposome composite microneedle has the advantages of good biocompatibility, controllable release, local targeting and good stability, and compared with a traditional separable soluble microneedle, the purposes of local slow release delivery of unstable drugs by using the microneedle and co-loading of different drugs are achieved.

column12: Chitosan-chondroitin sulfate nanoparticle and drug-loaded joint lubricant
column13: The invention provides chitosan-chondroitin sulfate nanoparticles and a drug-loaded joint lubricant, and belongs to the technical field of joint lubricants. In the invention, the chitosan has the advantages of good biocompatibility, blood compatibility, biodegradation, human metabolism and the like, can be used as a safe and reliable drug carrier for treating arthritis, and has good bactericidal performance. The chondroitin sulfate contains a large amount of hydrophilic sulfonic acid groups, so that the chitosan nano-particles can be endowed with excellent water lubrication performance, and the chitosan-chondroitin sulfate nano-particles have a good antifriction effect; the chondroitin sulfate has a cartilage repair function, can promote the growth of cartilage, and lays a good foundation for the drug-loading treatment and repair functions of the joint lubricant. column12: Method of Assuring Dissolution of Degradable Tools
column13: The use of degradable components has become a more common practice in subterranean operations for such applications as temporarily isolating zones or diverting flow. A major concern of operators in using degradable tools is the ability to ensure that the tool has completely degraded and is no longer blocking or obstructing flow. This issue can be resolved through the use of degradable components that include one or more chemical additives that are released upon the partial or full dissolution of the degradable component, and which can be used to facilitate in the dissolution of the degradable component. The degradable component can optionally include tracer elements that are released upon the partial or full dissolution of the degradable component, and which can be detected at the surface to ensure the desired degradation or removal of the degradable component as well as hydraulic access to that stage.

column12: CAMPTOTHECIN LOADED MODIFIED RELEASE MICROSPHERES FOR CANCER CHEMOTHERAPY
column13: Abstract: In this research, Chitosan microsphere loaded with drug Camptothecin have been prepared. This entrapment of drug causes controlled release of the highly potent naturally derived drug. In this research, the effect of change in drug: polymer ratio and amount of cross-linking agent used, on the drug release have been studied. The formulations prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent and those prepared with 20 ml cross-linking agent were evaluated for pH, drug entrapment, in vitro drug release, drug release kinetics study and stability testing. The cumulative drug release for the formulations, prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent, Fl, F2, and F3 was found to be 72.84%, 67.72% and 64.36% respectively. The percentage entrapment efficiency of formulation Fl, F2 and F3 was found to be 67.31%, 60.55% and 55.33% respectively. The drug release kinetics studies suggest that in the formulations prepared with 10 ml cross-linking agent Formulations Fl, F2 and F3 the best fit model was zero order release kinetics. The 'n' value of Korsmayer-peppas, which tells about the Fickian or non-Fickian diffusion mechanism, for the formulations Fl, F2 and F3 was found to be less than 0.45 and thus followed Fickian diffusion mechanism. All the formulations prepared either with 10 ml cross-linking agent or 20 ml cross linking agent had pH suitable for the use and were found to be stable and giving sustained drug release for around 10 hrs.

column12: Chitosan microemulsion for curcumin transdermal delivery and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a chitosan microemulsion for curcumin transdermal drug delivery and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) reacting long-chain alkyl tertiary amine with epoxy chloropropane to prepare epoxy long-chain alkyl quaternary ammonium salt; 2) dissolving the water-soluble chitosan derivative in a mixed solution of isopropanol and water, adding epoxy long-chain alkyl quaternary ammonium salt under an alkaline condition, and reacting to obtain an amphiphilic chitosan derivative; 3) dissolving the amphiphilic chitosan derivative in the water phase, adding the oil phase, uniformly stirring, and adding a cosurfactant to prepare a chitosan microemulsion; and 4) adding 0.1-3.5 mg/ml of curcumin into the chitosan micro-emulsion, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment until the curcumin is completely dissolved to obtain the drug-loaded chitosan micro-emulsion. The microemulsion has a stable nanometer size, can efficiently entrap drugs, and improves the transdermal permeability of the drugs. The microemulsion can effectively entrap curcumin to achieve a solubilizing effect, meanwhile, the stability of the curcumin is improved, the skin permeability of the curcumin is promoted, and finally the efficient percutaneous treatment effect is achieved.

column12: Preparation method of icariin sustained-release nanocapsule

column13: The invention relates to a temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. column12: Injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) oxidizing primary alcohol groups at two ends of Pluronic to obtain Pluronic (F127-CHO) with an aldehyde group at the end group; (2) adding F127-CHO into ultrapure water, and stirring in an ice-water bath to prepare an F127-CHO solution; (3) adding carboxymethyl chitosan into ultrapure water, stirring and dissolving to prepare a carboxymethyl chitosan solution; and (4) mixing the F127-CHO solution and the carboxymethyl chitosan solution with the same volume, stirring at low temperature and low speed for 10-30 minutes, and reacting at 37 DEG C for 12 hours to obtain the temperature-sensitive hydrogel. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, mild in reaction condition and low in raw material cost. The hydrogel prepared by the invention has excellent injectable, temperature-sensitive and self-healing properties, and can form gel in situ at a focus as a drug sustained-release carrier, so that the release period, the utilization rate and the treatment effect of the drug are improved.

column12: Chitosan materials from carbonic acid solution
column13: The present invention comprises chitosan materials and methods of using carbonic acid for aqueous solubilization of neutralized or pre-treated chitosan gels and provides, among other things, substantially acid salt free composition native final forms without requiring subsequent acid salt elution. The invention includes chitosan-based solid and semi-solid material forms, optionally reinforced with chitosan fibers, such as powders, fibers, films, matrices, sponges, implants, scaffolds, fillers, and hydrogels. Native final forms are produced from chitosan powder solubilized in an aqueous acidic solution, processed to form a high pH hydrated chitosan gel precipitate material that is then neutralized by water washing and re-solubilized substantially to chitosan solution using carbonic acid. Chitosan materials can be mixed in solution with one or more of other hydrophilic polymers to create compositional heterogeneity and pharmaceutical agents to achieve controlled release of the agent(s) from the final forms at the site of application.

column12: Tough chitosan hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses tough chitosan hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Chitosan dissolution and gelation characteristics are associated, and a stable covalent bond cross-linked network is formed by a chitosan solution by adopting an ultraviolet light cross-linking method. According to the method, acrylic acid or methacrylic acid containing unsaturated double bonds is selected as a solvent of chitosan, a reaction environment is provided for a chitosan-grafted acrylic acid photo-crosslinking agent, the obtained chitosan solution can be subjected to ultraviolet light crosslinking directly or after dialysis, and residual acrylic acid can be subjected to photopolymerization and be crosslinked with chitosan macromolecules to form tough chitosan hydrogel. According to the method, other natural polymers, functional additives or bioactive substances can be added in situ, the application field of the chitosan hydrogel is expanded, and the tough chitosan hydrogel can be applied to the fields of tissue scaffolds, sensors and drug sustained release.

column12: Nano-type leaf surface regulating agent capable of improving cadmium tolerance of rice and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nano-type leaf surface regulating agent capable of improving cadmium tolerance of rice and a preparation method thereof. The nano-type leaf surface regulating agent is prepared by loading reduced glutathione serving as an active ingredient with mesoporous silica nanoparticles and then packaging with chitosan, and the nano-type leaf surface regulating agent has the advantage of nano size, can prevent leaf settling resistance from entering rice leaves, has encapsulation performance and sustained release performance, can effectively prevent reduced glutathione from being oxidized, reduces the loss of active ingredients in the environment, prolongs the action time, improves the leaf spraying efficiency, and does not cause secondary pollution. column12: Encapsulation-free controlled protein release system
column13: The present disclosure provides a delivery system for controlled protein release without encapsulation. Identical, burst-free, extended release profiles for three different protein therapeutics were obtained with and without encapsulation in PLGA nanoparticles embedded within a hydrogel. Using both positively and negatively charged proteins, it was shown that short-range electrostatic interactions between the proteins and the PLGA nanoparticles are the underlying mechanism for controlled release. Moreover, tunable release was demonstrated by modifying nanoparticle concentration, nanoparticle size, or environmental pH. Additionally, the utility of this system was demonstrated in vivo for BDNF delivery in a rat model of stroke. These new insights obviate the need for encapsulation and offer promising, translatable strategies for more effective delivery of therapeutic biomolecules.

column12: Crosslinked chitosan/snail stock solution/PVA composite membrane and preparation method thereof

column12: Branched polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel, preparation and application thereof

column12: Sulfhydrylated chitosan and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses sulfhydrylated chitosan and a preparation method thereof. The sulfhydrylated chitosan is chitosan jointly modified by hydroxybutyl and sulfydryl. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, introducing hydroxybutyl on a chitosan molecular chain; secondly, in the sulfydryl part, free amino of hydroxybutyl chitosan and carboxyl of L-cysteine are subjected to condensation reaction to introduce sulfydryl; an aqueous solution of the sulfhydrylated chitosan is in a solution state at low temperature and can be subjected to flow injection, and when the temperature is raised to about 37 DEG C, hydrogel can be formed. Due to the introduction of sulfydryl, the oxidation resistance and tissue adhesion ability of the material are improved. The sulfhydrylated chitosan prepared by the method possibly has wide application prospects in the aspects of tissue engineering, drug delivery systems, cell culture, cosmetics and the like.

column12: PH/photo-thermal dual-stimulation response type composite drug carrier and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a pH/photo-thermal dual-stimulation response type composite drug carrier and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of drug carrier preparation. The method comprises the following steps: modifying the surfaces of bamboo charcoal nanoparticles with acid-sensitive chitosan (CS) and folic acid (FA) with a targeting function to obtain a composite drug carrier; and furthermore, loading an anti-cancer drug and constructing a pH/ photo-thermal dual-stimulation response type composite nano drug loading system. After being taken by tumor cells, the system is degraded in a subacid environment to trigger the release of an anti-cancer drug; and external near-infrared light irradiation causes a photothermal effect of the bamboo charcoal nanoparticles, and released heat can accelerate release of drugs. The synergism of the two can improve the drug release capability and anticancer efficiency of the nano drug-loading system.

column12: Ionic emulsifier chitosan nanoparticle modified quercetin oral sustained-release preparation and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to an ionic emulsifier chitosan nanoparticle modified quercetin oral sustained-release preparation and a preparation method thereof. column12: Fabrication and Evaluation of Gastro Retentive Tablet of Trandolapril in Treatment of Essential Hypertension
column13: Abstract: In the present invention we have formulated and evaluated the floating drug delivery system containing Trandolapril, an antihypertensive drug, using different polymers and also optimized the best formulation. Different excipients were tested for the IR compatibility with Trandolapril by the FTIR studies. Present Invention has also demonstrated the successful utilization of technique for FTIR to assess the compatibility of Trandolapril with the excipients used in the development of floating drug delivery system of Trandolapril. Based on the results of FT-IR studies, majority of the excipients were found to be compatible with Trandolapril which were then used in the preparation of Trandolapril floating tablets. Trandolapril tablets were prepared by wet granulation technique using HPMC, HPMC K4M and chitosan as polymers, stearic acid, citric acid, lactose and gas generating agent such as sodium bicarbonate were taken as independent variables. It was then evaluated by using USP II (Paddle) apparatus containing 0.1 N HCl as a dissolution media. The release mechanisms of Trandolapril from floating tablet were evaluated by the n value of KrosmeyerPeppas model. The n value of all formulations except "F4, F5 and F9" ranges from lowest 0.147 to highest 0.496 which is in the range of n = 0.5 which indicate the mechanism of release of Trandolapril is by Fickian diffusion. However, the n value of the F2 and F8 was 0 .6 0 3 and 0. 6 7 2 which is in the range of 0.5 < n< 1 .0 which indicate the mechanism of release of Trandolapril in by non Fickian transport. Then value of the best formulation is above 1.0, which indicated that, the mechanism of release of Trandolapril from the dosage form is followed the zero-order release kinetics. The optimized formula was following the zero-order release kinetics, which meet the condition of controlled drug delivery system. HPMC retarded the drug release as a function of polymer concentration. A combination of sodium bicarbonate and citric acid was found to achieve in vitro buoyancy.

column13: The present invention relates to a nanocomposite ocular device that can release drugs within a close distance to the ocular surface and provide controlled and sustained release of the drug at a constant rate. The device can achieve both optical and medical functions. The device comprises a drug, one or more reservoir domains, and a barrier layer configured to block the drug diffusion paths from the reservoir domain to the ocular surface in the eye of the subject, wherein the drug partitions between the reservoir domain and the barrier layer, and the equilibrium drug solubility in the reservoir domain is at least five folds higher than that in the barrier layer.

column12: Quick-setting spray drug carrier and use method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a quick-setting spray drug carrier and a use method and application thereof, and the quick-setting spray drug carrier comprises a film spraying agent solution and a film forming agent solution. The film spraying agent solution comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.1%-1% of sodium alginate, 0.1%-1% of agar, 0.1%-1% of chitosan and the balance of water. The film-forming agent solution comprises 10 g/100 mL of a calcium chloride solution. The quick-setting spray drug carrier provided by the invention comprises a film spraying agent solution and a film forming agent solution, the film spraying agent solution is prepared by proportioning three different biodegradable materials, the film spraying agent solution capable of quickly be set into a film can be prepared, and the film spraying agent solution can be mixed with other water-soluble or alcohol-soluble drugs. After spraying, a low-temperature calcium agent is added, so that a stable gel film can be quickly formed within 10s, and the problem of low agglutination speed of the existing gel medicine is solved.

column12: Preparation method of ibuprofen transdermal controlled-release nano material
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ibuprofen transdermal controlled-release nano material, which comprises the following steps: dropwise adding an ibuprofen-sodium hydroxide solution into a chitosan-glacial acetic acid solution, freezing the formed uniform solution, unfreezing the solution at room temperature, dialyzing the solution, and centrifugally freezing and drying the solution. The ibuprofen transdermal controlled-release nano-material prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention shows the morphology characteristic of a thin nanosheet structure, has a larger specific surface area, can improve the attachment site of a drug, increase the contact area with the skin, improve the drug loading capacity, prolong the drug release time, improve the drug curative effect and reduce the administration frequency; meanwhile, the ibuprofen sustained-release microsphere has good swelling property and drug controlled release performance, and is beneficial to control of in-vitro release and transdermal release of ibuprofen.

column12: Preparation of eel swimming bladder collagen-chitosan-composite sodium alginate hydrogel
column13: The invention provides a method for preparing an eel swimming bladder collagen-chitosan-composite sodium alginate hydrogel. The optimal conditions for extracting the collagen of the sea eel swimming bladder by the acid method through a single factor test and response surface optimization are as follows: the acetic acid concentration is 0.42 mol/L, the acidolysis time is 21h, and the liquid-material ratio is 58ml/g. The acid-soluble collagen separated from the sea eel swimming bladder can be used as a proper drug carrier system, is a good medicinal biological material, has a unique porous fiber structure, can be used for absorbing a large amount of water and supporting the skin surface, and has important effects on moisturizing and wrinkle resistance; the collagen can be used as a wound excipient or a drug carrier, has a healing promoting effect on a mouse skin wound, and has huge application potential in biomedical engineering and medicine.

column12: Double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with semi-interpenetrating network entrapped double-layer microspheres as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical dressings for repairing burn skin wounds, and provides a double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with double-layer microspheres entrapped by a semi-interpenetrating network. Acrylic acid is used as a pH-sensitive monomer. The pH/temperature dual-sensitive intelligent hydrogel takes methacrylic acid 2-ethyl ester and oligomeric (ethylene glycol) methyl ether methacrylate as temperature-sensitive monomers, and an anti-inflammatory drug gentamicin sulfate is entrapped; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a calcium alginate core sphere entrapped with bovine serum albumin through a high-voltage electrostatic instillation method, coating the surface of the core sphere with a chitosan shell layer entrapped with an antibacterial drug azithromycin to form a double-layer microsphere, and loading the double-layer microsphere into the hydrogel to obtain the hydrogel dressing capable of precisely and slowly releasing two drugs and one protein. According to the pH/temperature change of a wound surface microenvironment, the hydrogel can achieve accurate controlled release of drugs and improve the utilization rate of the drugs, and is a novel double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with a semi-interpenetrating network combined double-layer microsphere structure and good comprehensive performance.

column12: Intravascular stent coating material with drug sustained release, anti-coagulation and anti-calcification properties and preparation method of intravascular stent coating material
column13: The invention provides an intravascular stent coating material with drug sustained release, anti-coagulation and anti-calcification properties and a preparation method of the intravascular stent coating material. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a macromolecular carrier capable of effectively assembling an anti-calcification drug; compounding an anti-calcification functional component with the macromolecular carrier to prepare an intermediate carrier wrapping the anti-calcification component; preparing a coating on the surface of an intravascular stent in a spraying, spin-coating or dip-coating manner by taking the intermediate carrier as a cation carrier and taking modified chitosan and heparin molecules as polyelectrolyte components respectively; and defining a modified chitosan/intermediate carrier/heparin composite coating of a single cycle as one layer, and obtaining the target coating through spraying, spin coating or dip coating operation of 1-20 cycles. The coating obtained by the invention can be used for modifying an intravascular stent material, so that the intravascular stent has long-acting drug sustained release, anti-coagulation, anti-hyperplasia and anti-calcification properties, and the evolution of re-atherosclerosis and calcification in an implanted stent is effectively inhibited.

column12: Collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles. The collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles are characterized in that the collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles are spherical or sphere-like, and three kinds of micromolecular collagen polypeptides obtained through enzymolysis are wrapped in the inner side of the collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles. A preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) extracting collagen; (2) preparing the micromolecular collagen polypeptides by utilizing the collagen extracted in step (1); and (3) encapsulating the micromolecular collagen polypeptides prepared in step (2) to prepare the collagen polypeptide carboxymethyl chitosan nano sustained-release particles. The particles have the technical advantages that active ingredients can easily permeate into the deep layer of skin and diffuse, superimposed beautifying and health-care effects are achieved, and the active ingredients can be degraded in the skin and absorbed by cells as nutrition. The diameter of the encapsulated nano sustained-release particles is 100-900 nm after the nano sustained-release particles swell in normal saline, and the nano sustained-release particles can be used as a main functional component or additive of high-grade cosmetics, can prolong the shelf life of the cosmetics, can make the skin smooth, fine and elastic, and have the effects of wrinkle resistance, radiation resistance and infection resistance.

column12: Acacia Chundra Gum Stabilized Highly Faced Nanoparticles for Controlled Drug Delivery
column13: Abstract A relatively new but rapidly developed discipline is the nanomedicine and nanoparticles in drug delivery systems, in which substances in the nanoscale range are being used as diagnostic tools or to deliver therapeutic substances to particular site in controlled manner One of the most effective non-invasive methods to drug - delivery applications include polymer nanoparticles (NPs). Nanoparticles are selected on the basis of physicochemical characteristics of drugs when considering the uses of nanoparticles in drug delivery. use of nanoscience with bioactive natural substances is highly appealing and has recently expanded very quickly. For encapsulation and delivery of drug, natural polymers are appropriate choice and it has been studied extensively. The appropriate choice for drug encapsulation and delivery was studied extensively with natural polymers. In the pharmaceutical sector the research has drawn great attention. The primary objective of the proposed innovation is the production of nanoparticles for controlled drug release employing natural polymers. In this invention Kheri (Acacia chundra) gum is used as natural polymer to prepare nanoparticles for controlled drug release. In this proposed invention kheri gum- chitosan highly faced hexagonal and pentagonal nanoparticles are produced for controlled drug delivery. Prepared nanoparticles were evaluated for various parameters like particle size, surface potential, surface characteristics, shape and drug release pattern. Dual release pattern of medication was shown in the preparation of nanoparticles. Drug releases were firstly seen at around 45 min (55 to 66%), and sustained drug release was observed up to 7 hours (98 to 99 percent). Drug release behaviour is that there is only 2 to 6% drug release was observed between 45 minutes and 6 h. Based on the results obtained it can infer that produced nano formulations could be employed for disease management. Highly faced hexagonal and pentagonal nanoparticles prepared by Kheri gum and chitosan are able to deliver drug in sustained release manner and reduce patient compliance The invention proposed use of natural gum, kheri for the preparation of controlled release nanoparticles. 30kV X27 0 0.5pcn rau 1AaU Figure 1: SEM image of Acacia chundra gum -chitosan stabilized nanoparticles

column12: Preparation method of chitosan microspheres for cell immobilization and drug delivery
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of chitosan microspheres for cell immobilization and drug delivery, and relates to the field of preparation of chitosan microspheres. According to the method, chitin is deacetylated by combining a compound enzyme with a microwave induction process technology, the chitosan is subjected to heavy metal green chelation by adopting tetrasodium glutamate diacetate or citric acid, and the extraction and removal capabilities of a chelating agent on residual metal ions are further improved by further utilizing a carbonate dissolution promoting technology; and trace proteins and lipids in crude chitosan products are hydrolyzed and separated by selecting a proper biological enzyme, refined chitosan is obtained, enzymatic molecular modification is performed on the refined chitosan by using transglycosides or oxidase, and finally the chitosan microspheres are prepared by using a green and environment-friendly spray drying method. The prepared chitosan microspheres are smooth in shape and uniform in size, the particle size is 1-250 microns, the chitosan microspheres are of a core-shell structure, and the application range of chitosan in the fields of medicine, food and other industries is widened by utilizing chitosan immobilized enzyme.

column12: Preparation method of pH response type carboxymethyl chitosan/sodium alginate hydrogel ball
column13: The invention belongs to the field of high-molecular polymer hydrogel, and relates to a preparation method of a pH response type carboxymethyl chitosan/sodium alginate hydrogel ball. The preparation method of the hydrogel ball comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving carboxymethyl chitosan and sodium alginate in water under stirring at room temperature, carrying out filtering to remove insoluble substances, and performing ultrasonic degassing to respectively obtain transparent carboxymethyl chitosan and sodium alginate solutions; adding a certain amount of the carboxymethyl chitosan solution into the sodium alginate solution, carrying out quick stirring to form a uniform solution, and conducting degassing; and dropwise adding a mixed solution obtained in the previous step into a cross-linking agent by using a disposable syringe with a volume of 1 mL, conducting curing, taking out the hydrogel ball, and washing the hydrogel ball with water. According to the invention, release of protein in simulated gastric juice can be effectively reduced; a preparation process is simple, safe and non-toxic; raw materials are low in price; the hydrogel ball is stable in structure and good in pH response characteristics, and wide application prospects are achieved in the aspect of oral protein and water-soluble drug delivery.

column12: Preparation method and application of sustained and controlled release antibacterial chitosan-based composite membrane
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a sustained and controlled release antibacterial chitosan-based composite membrane. According to the invention, chitosan is used as a main membrane base material, and a plasticizer-glycerol and an emulsifier-Tween 80 are added according to a specific ratio, so that the chitosan has good membrane-forming property; and meanwhile, by adding the nanofiller-lignin nanoparticles and the soybean protein nanogel loaded with the antibacterial agent-potassium sorbate, the mechanical property and the antibacterial property of the composite membrane can be effectively improved, the moisture permeability and the air permeability of the composite membrane are reduced, and the sustained and controlled release effect of the antibacterial agent in different food systems is reflected. A new research thought and design scheme can be provided for development of food packaging, and the method has wide application prospects in the field of food packaging.

column12: Vapor phase antirust agent and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a vapor phase antirust agent. The vapor phase antirust agent comprises, by weight, 4-6 parts of chitosan, 1-2 parts of sulfosalicylic acid, 1-1.5 parts of benzotriazole, 1-1.5 parts of potassium tartrate, 1-3 parts of a surfactant, 4-6 parts of methyl piperazine, 1-2 parts of p-toluic acid, 1-2 parts of amino acid, 4-6 parts of triethanolamine, 8-10 parts of an auxiliary agent, 1-2 parts of p-toluidine, 2 parts of a drying agent and 40 parts of ethanol. The auxiliary agent is a mixture of diatomite, silica gel and triethylene glycol monomethyl ether. The antirust agent disclosed by the invention has the effects of contact rust prevention and vapor phase rust prevention, has a good antirust effect on metal devices such as steel, is long in lasting time, has slow-release and controlled-release effects, and is suitable for occasions requiring both water-based rust prevention and vapor phase rust prevention in a sealed space.

column12: Preparation method of novel chitosan-based dual-network hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of novel dual-network hydrogel. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving polyethylene glycol and maleimide acid in an organic solvent under the action of a dehydrating agent to prepare PEG-MI; then adding the PEG-M, chitosan, a hydrophilic monomer, a cross-linking agent and an photoinitiator into a beaker for dissolving, and conducting uniform stirring; and carrying out heating in a water bath for a period of time, forming a first network through a click reaction of amino and maleimide groups, performing irradiating under an ultraviolet lamp for a period of time, and forming a second network through photopolymerization, thereby obtaining the double-network hydrogel through a one-pot method. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate, mild in conditions and controllable in process. The chitosan-based dual-network hydrogel prepared by the method can efficiently adsorb heavy metal ions, colored dyes and other substances in water, has antibacterial activity, and has wide application prospects in the fields of environmental governance, drug sustained release, tissue engineering and the like.

column12: Preparation method of core-shell structure gastric retention hydrogel capable of realizing drug sustained release

column12: Glucose and enzyme double-response dressing for treating chronic wound surface of diabetes mellitus and preparation method thereof

column12: Three-dimensional reticular chitosan slow-release coating and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan-methacrylic anhydride/calcium carbonate (CSMA/CaCO3) hydrogel slow-release coating. The surface of the coating is of a porous net structure. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a chitosan solution dissolved in dilute acetic acid; (2) adding methacrylic anhydride (MA) into the chitosan solution obtained in the step (1), and grafting methacrylic anhydride on chitosan through a hydrothermal method under a high-temperature condition to prepare chitosan-methacrylic anhydride (CSMA); (3) performing neutralizing, and dialyzing the chitosan-methacrylic anhydride obtained in step (2); (4) adding a photoinitiator I2959 and a calcium chloride solution into the solution obtained in the step (3), and performing ultraviolet irradiation crosslinking to obtain slow-release hydrogel; and 5) introducing ammonium carbonate into the hydrogel obtained in the step (4) to prepare the glycan-methacrylic anhydride/calcium carbonate hydrogel slow-release coating. The method is simple in preparation process, mild and controllable in condition, good in repeatability, low in production cost and suitable for industrial production. The prepared porous network hydrogel sustained-release coating has the advantages of good biocompatibility, easiness in degradation, high load rate and the like, and has wide application prospects in the fields of medicine and chemical industry.

column12: Preparation method of semi-interpenetrating network antibacterial gel based on natural polymers
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing semi-interpenetrating network antibacterial gel based on natural polymers through click reaction of amino and anhydride in water, which comprises the following steps: firstly, modifying natural polymers such as natural products cellulose, chitosan and the like by quaternary ammonium salt to obtain a polymer with antibacterial activity; loading metal silver by using halloysite to prepare nano particles with antibacterial activity, then dissolving quaternary ammonium salt natural macromolecules, nano particles and a copolymer containing acid anhydride and amino in water to form a uniform solution, obtaining hydrogel by using a click reaction between amino and acid anhydride in water, soaking in water to remove non-crosslinked components, and freeze-drying to obtain the aerogel with antibacterial activity. column12: Adhesive and hemostatic injectable chitosan gel, and preparation method and applications thereof
column13: The invention discloses an adhesive and hemostatic injectable chitosan gel, and a preparation method and applications thereof. Chitosan is taken as a raw material; chitosan-hydrogenated caffeic acid is prepared by introducing a catechol functional group on the surface of the chitosan; then chitosan-hydrogenated caffeic acid-dibenzocyclooctyne is prepared by further introducing a dibenzocyclooctyne group; and a gel material, namely the adhesive and hemostatic injectable chitosan gel, is synthesized by utilizing an oxidative crosslinking effect of the catechol functional group and copper-free azide alkyne cycloaddition reaction of the dibenzocyclooctyne group and azidized polyethylene glycol. A catechol structural compound is grafted on the chitosan, so that the wet tissue adhesion, procoagulant performance and rapid hemostasis of the chitosan material can be enhanced; and by mixing multi-arm polyethylene glycol into a dressing structure, the mechanical property of the chitosan can be improved. The prepared gel has the potential as a novel biomaterial to achieve wide application in the field of biomedical science such as cells, tissue engineering and drug delivery.

column13: The disclosure discloses a tissue-engineered nerve transplant and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical fields of biomaterials and tissue engineering. column12: Preparation method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for skin wound repair
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for skin wound repair. The hydrogel is mainly composed of modified chitosan, internal carrier cells and a bioactive factor. Firstly, a hydrogel precursor solution is prepared through emulsion polymerization, the main component of the hydrogel precursor solution is poly-N-isopropylacrylamide graft modified chitosan macromolecules, and the hydrogel can be in a solution state in a room temperature environment and can be rapidly gelated in a human body physiological temperature environment. Through mixing with a cell suspension and a bioactive factor, the obtained composite solution can realize in-situ rapid gelation at a skin wound and defect part, realizes in-situ fixation of cells, not only can provide good support for a wound part, but also can promote adhesion, proliferation and differentiation of internal cells of the wound part. The hydrogel is simple to prepare, convenient to use, quick in response and good in biocompatibility, and can be applied to a plurality of biomedical related fields such as tissue repair, drug controlled release, cell culture and cancer treatment.

column12: Chitosan oral ulcer patch based on temperature-sensitive micro-capsule structure
column13: In order to solve the problems that the treatment effect of an oral ulcer patch is poor and the like, the chitosan oral ulcer patch based on the temperature-sensitive micro-capsule structure mainly comprises an adhesive layer composed of chitosan and a traditional Chinese medicine layer connected to the surface of the adhesive layer, the traditional Chinese medicine layer is composed of temperature-sensitive micro-capsules wrapped with traditional Chinese medicine volatile oil, and the temperature-sensitive micro-capsules are coated with temperature-sensitive micro-capsules. column12: Self-assembled gel acne-removing microneedle patch as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medical cosmetics, and relates to an acne-removing microneedle, in particular to a self-assembled gel acne-removing microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, standing and self-assembling a small molecule regulator and a polymer micelle carrying a hydrophobic drug to prepare chitosan-natural anion polysaccharide natural hydrogel with excellent mechanical properties; and secondly, constructing the acne-removing microneedle patch which is painless, efficient and controllable in administration and has antibacterial and repairing functions from the natural hydrogel by adopting a vacuum injection method. The self-assembled gel not only avoids the use of a chemical cross-linking agent, but also improves the utilization rate of the hydrophobic drug. After the constructed gel acne-removing microneedle acts on the skin, a needle body and a base can be rapidly separated, the hydrophobic drug can be controllably released, and the risk caused by pulling out the needle body again to a wound is avoided.

column12: Seeding type multifunctional gel mulching film capable of inhibiting growth of weeds and preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a seeding type multifunctional gel mulching film capable of inhibiting growth of weeds and preparation and application thereof. column12: Preparation and use method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for bone repair
column13: The invention relates to a preparation and use method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for bone repair. The hydrogel is mainly composed of modified chitosan, internally loaded cells and cell growth promoting factors. Firstly, a hydrogel precursor solution is prepared through emulsion polymerization, the main component of the hydrogel precursor solution is poly-N-isopropylacrylamide graft modified chitosan macromolecules, and the hydrogel can be in a solution state at the room temperature and achieve rapid gelation in the human physiological temperature environment. Through mixing with a cell suspension and the cell growth promoting factor, the obtained composite solution can realize in-situ rapid gelation at a bone tissue injury part and realize in-situ fixation of cells, so that not only can good support be provided for the injury part, but also adhesion, proliferation and differentiation of internal cells of the injury part can be promoted. The hydrogel is simple to prepare, convenient to use, quick in response and good in biocompatibility, so that the hydrogel can be applied to a plurality of biomedical related fields such as tissue repair, drug controlled release, cell culture and cancer treatment.

column12: Chitosan-coated solid lipid nanoparticles for promoting absorption of pentacyclic triterpenoids and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses chitosan-coated solid lipid nanoparticles for promoting absorption of pentacyclic triterpenoids and a preparation method thereof.
