column12: Chitosan composite sustained-release stent for bone tissue engineering and preparation method of chitosan composite sustained-release stent
column13: The invention discloses a chitosan composite sustained-release stent for bone tissue engineering and a preparation method of the chitosan composite sustained-release stent. The chitosan composite sustained-release stent is prepared from chitosan, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, montmorillonite and chitosan microspheres entrapped with EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate). The mass ratio of the chitosan to the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose to the montmorillonite to the EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate) entrapped chitosan microspheres is (5-50): (1-10): (1-10): (1-10). The chitosan composite sustained-release stent prepared according to the method has an obvious three-dimensional structure and good biodegradability and biocompatibility, and qualitative and quantitative tests prove that the chitosan composite sustained-release stent can effectively promote proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells and can be applied to the field of biomedical materials as a bone tissue engineering material.

column12: Biopolymer fiber wound dressing and preparation method thereof

column12: Potassium chloride sustained-release tablet prepared by using crab shell powder and derivatives thereof as auxiliary materials and preparation method
column13: Aiming at the problems of high production cost, complex process, poor sustained release effect, unstable performance, physiological toxicity and the like of the existing sustained and controlled release medicine, the invention provides a potassium chloride sustained-release tablet prepared from crab shell powder and derivatives thereof as auxiliary materials and preparation and evaluation methods of the potassium chloride sustained release tablet. The crab shell powder and a natural nano-porous material treated by acid or alkali are directly used as a sustained-release carrier, the potassium chloride sustained-release tablet which is economic and safe and meets the requirements of pharmacopeia is prepared by a simple solution adsorption method, the potassium chloride content range is 1.0%-60%, the release time is 24-96 hours, the chitosan-calcium carbonate potassium chloride sustained-release tablet and the porous calcium carbonate potassium chloride sustained-release tablet have the best effect, the loading capacity is about 20%, and the release amount meets the stipulation of the second method of the general rule 0931 of the second part of pharmacopoeia. The potassium chloride sustained-release tablet can be prepared by selecting the corresponding sustained-release carrier or the combined carrier according to the requirements on the content and the release rate of the potassium chloride or the sustained-release carrier in an actual application scene, and a novel safe and long-acting sustained-release system is created.

column12: Environment-friendly fishing abamectin sustained release preparation and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an environment-friendly fishing abamectin sustained-release preparation, and a preparation method thereof and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding abamectin raw powder into a sodium alginate aqueous solution, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain a mixed solution A; dissolving chitosan in 2wt% acetic acid to prepare a chitosan solution, adding calcium chloride while stirring, and adjusting the pH value to 5.4 by using a NaOH solution to obtain a mixed solution B; under stirring, titrating the mixed solution A into the mixed solution B at a constant speed through an injector, and after a cross-linking reaction is completed, performing filtering and drying to obtain the environment-friendly fishing abamectin sustained-release preparation. column13: A bifunctional starch-based composite nanoparticle, and a preparation method therefor and use thereof. column12: ELECTROACTIVE AND DEGRADABLE SUPRAMOLECULAR MICROGEL AND DRUG-LOADED SUPRAMOLECULAR MICROGEL, AND PREPARATION METHOD AND USE THEREOF
column13: Disclosed are an electroactive and degradable supramolecular microgel and drug-loaded supramolecular microgel, and a preparation method and a use thereof. The supramolecular microgel comprises chitosan, hydroquinone and an auxiliary material. The preparation method of the supramolecular microgel comprises formulating an aqueous phase comprising chitosan and hydroquinone and an organic phase comprising Span 80 in cyclohexane, and performing a water-in-oil reverse microemulsion polymerization process to synthesize the supramolecular microgel, wherein chitosan and hydroquinone undergo cross-linking by means of hydrogen bonding between amino and hydroxy groups, and chitosan and hydroquinone are present at a mass ratio of 1:0.33 to 3. The supramolecular microgel can be efficiently loaded with a drug such as doxorubicin hydrochloride and prepared as a drug-loaded supramolecular microgel. The drug-loaded supramolecular microgel can be degraded by both urea and lysozymes, achieving controlled release of the drug in a particular environment. The present invention provides a novel approach for the development of a multi-responsive drug delivery platform.

column12: Hydrophobic modified core-shell structure environment-friendly slow/controlled release temporary plugging agent and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum plugging, and particularly discloses a hydrophobic modified core-shell structure environment-friendly slow/controlled release temporary plugging agent and a preparation method thereof. The hydrophobic modified core-shell structure environment-friendly slow/controlled release temporary plugging agent comprises a shell and water-soluble temporary plugging particle nuclei, the water-soluble temporary plugging particle nuclei are coated with the shell, and the shell comprises a degradable framework and a hydrophobic wall material; and the composition of the degradable framework is modified polyurethane, and the hydrophobic wall material adopts paraffin. The water-soluble temporary plugging particles is preheated, toluene diisocynate, polyether polyol, chitosan, diethyltoluenediamine and epoxy resin are taken, uniformly stirred and mixed, and then sprayed on the surfaces of the water-soluble temporary plugging particles to form a layer of degradable framework; and molten paraffin is sprayed on the surface of the degradable framework, and a shell structure comprising the degradable framework and the paraffin is formed outside the water-soluble temporary plugging particle nuclei. The slow release time of the prepared slow/controlled release temporary plugging agent can be adjusted in a large range, the effect of adjusting the slow release performance is achieved, and meanwhile the core-shell structure enables the mechanical property of the temporary plugging agent to be greatly improved.

column12: Self-healing temperature-sensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a self-healing temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel is prepared from hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan and 3, 4-dihydroxyphenyl propionic acid through an amidation reaction, and the molar ratio of the reactant 3, 4-dihydroxyphenyl propionic acid to amino on the hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1:1-0.5:1. The method is mild in reaction condition, simple and safe to operate and easier to accept by researchers. The modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan hydrogel prepared by amidation reaction has self-healing property and temperature sensitivity. By controlling factors such as reaction time, molar ratio and solution concentration, sol-gel conversion temperature, self-healing time and efficiency of the hydrogel can be changed, and in addition, the hydrogel has low cytotoxicity and good biodegradability and has potential application value in the aspect of injectable drug sustained-release carriers.

column12: Carboxymethyl chitosan derivative and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a hexanoylated carboxymethyl chitosan derivative and a preparation method thereof. The carboxymethyl chitosan is a carboxymethyl chitosan derivative containing hexanoyl and is prepared from carboxymethyl chitosan and n-hexanoic anhydride through a hexacylation reaction, and the molar ratio of n-hexanoic anhydride serving as a reactant to a carboxymethyl chitosan glucosamine unit is 1:1-1:5. The method is mild in reaction condition, simple and safe to operate and easier to accept by researchers. The hexanoylated carboxymethyl chitosan obtained by the reaction is a natural high polymer material, has good water solubility, is safe and non-toxic, and can be used as a drug delivery carrier. In addition, the material has good temperature sensitivity and biocompatibility, and has wide application prospects in the fields of drug synthesis, adsorption materials, drug carrier materials, antibacterial materials and the like.

column12: Thrombus targeting long circulating polycation micelle, and preparation method and applications thereof
column13: The invention discloses a thrombus targeting long circulating polycation micelle, and a preparation method and applications thereof. Through an EDC/NSH esterification system, poly(2-ethyl-2-oxazoline) is used to graft chitosan so as to prepare the polyion micelle; modification is performed on chain ends by using arginine-glycine-aspartic acid sequence short peptide; and through the carrying of anticoagulant and antithrombotic drugs, the thrombus targeting long circulating polycation micelle can be obtained. Through the prepared thrombus targeting polyion micelle, the purposes of improving protein drug stability, targeting thrombus, prolonging the action time in vivo and reducing immunogenicity can be achieved. The preparation method is feasible and reliable in operation; the obtained carrier is high in drug loading; the drugs have obvious thrombus targeting performance and are long in action time in vivo; and therefore, theoretical basis can be provided for the research of a novel thrombus targeting delivery system.

column12: THREE-DIMENSIONAL CELL CULTURE PLATFORM AND USES THEREOF
column13: The present invention is directed to in vitro three-dimensional cell culture platforms for the growth of cells, including spheroids, tissues and organoids. The three-dimensional cell culture platforms of the present invention provide a surface interface formed by a cell supporting medium, which acts as a biological surface for cells to populate and grow. Specifically, the three-dimensional cell culture platforms comprise a cell supporting medium having at least one microwell formed therein, and one or more microwell spacers defining an entrance of the or each microwell, the entrance enabling the introduction of a cell culture medium into the or each microwell. Microfluidic devices comprising the cell culture platforms are also provided, together with methods for producing the cell culture platforms.

column12: Preparation method of chitosan/sodium alginate composite hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of chitosan/sodium alginate composite hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: mixing a chitosan water solution and a sodium alginate water solutionto obtain a mixed solution, adding a photoinitiator into the mixed solution, and conducting irradiating under ultraviolet light to obtain the chitosan/sodium alginate composite hydrogel. By adding sodium alginate, the brittleness of the chitosan hydrogel can be improved by utilizing sodium alginate with good plasticity and toughness, and the mechanical property of the gel is optimized; and the mechanical property of the hydrogel can be regulated and controlled by controlling the mixing ratio of the chitosan aqueous solution to the sodium alginate aqueous solution, and the breaking strength ofchitosan can be increased from 2 MPa to 6 MPa to the maximum extent. Meanwhile, the prepared chitosan/sodium alginate composite hydrogel has the antibacterial property of chitosan and the biological activity of sodium alginate. The hydrogel is loaded on the surface or inside an implant, and is expected to be widely applied to the fields of antibacterial dressings and drug controlled release.

column12: Preparation process of mesalazine enteric sustained-release tablets
column13: The invention discloses a preparation process of mesalazine enteric sustained-release tablets. The process comprises the following steps of: preparing an adhesive solution: mixing beta-cyclodextrin, chitosan and deionized water, magnetically stirring until the solution is uniform, then adding disodium hydrogen phosphate, and uniformly stirring and mixing for later use; slowly adding mesalazine andan adhesive into a rapid wet mixing granulator in a stirring state, immediately adding a thickening agent after the addition is completed, and keeping stirring until a proper soft material is formed;passing the soft material through an extruder, properly rounding, drying to obtain dry particles, and tabletting the particles through a double-layer tablet press to prepare tablets; and finally, putting the tablets into a film coating machine, and spraying a coating solution for enteric coating to obtain a high-purity mesalazine enteric sustained-release tablet preparation. The preparation process disclosed by the invention is simple and suitable for industrial production.

column12: A Degradable Vascular Stent Capable Of Avoiding Late Restenosis
column13: The present invention relates to a degradable vascular stent capable of avoiding late restenosis, comprising a base region formed by a polylactic acid based polymer; at least one storage region in which an active agent is stored; and an outer layer of a drug sustained release coating covered on the base region and/or the storage region. Before the mass of the polylactic acid based polymer is decreased by 10-20%, the active agent is retained in structural units of the polylactic acid based polymer. After the mass of the polylactic acid based polymer is decreased by 10-20%, the active agent is released from the storage region. The base region provides a supporting capacity for ensuring patency of blood vessels; the drug sustained release coating is used for drug release in an early stage; and the active agent only works in late degradation of the stent to avoid late restenosis.

column12: Nattokinase sustained-release microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses nattokinase sustained-release microspheres and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of foods or medicines. According to the nattokinase sustained-release microspheres disclosed by the invention, chitosan is used as an inner core auxiliary material, and nattokinase is solidified to an inner core through a cross-linking agent, so that the effects of enhancing the stability and the sustained release of enzymes are achieved. On the basis, mTG enzymes are used as the cross-linking agent, and casein is in cross-linking to the outer layers of the microspheres, so that the sandwich-shaped nattokinase sustained-release microspheres are formed, the gastric acid resistance of the nattokinase in the microspheres can be further improved, the action time of the nattokinase can be prolonged, and the antithrombotic effect of the nattokinase can be further improved. Two nattokinase-chitosan microspheres disclosed by the invention can be used as an oral preparation of the nattokinase, can be used as ingredients to be added to foods and beverages, and can also be used for producing nattokinase sustained-release microsphere powder or/concentrated solutions. Compared with pure zymoprotein, the nattokinase sustained-release microspheres disclosed by the invention as a functional factor additive can prolong the shelf life of foods with antithrombotic functions and improve the bioavailability of functional factors.

column12: Preparation method of pH-sensitive charge inversion type drug delivery system and drug delivery system obtained by same
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pH-sensitive charge inversion type drug delivery system and the drug delivery system obtained by the same. Nano-hydroxyapatite modified by adriamycin-loaded 3-(2-aminoethyl)-aminopropyltrimethoxysilane is used as an inner core of a positive charge, chitosan oligosaccharide modified by dimethylmaleic anhydride is used as a shell of a negative charge, and the positive charges and the negative charges are assembled by the electrostatic interaction to form the drug delivery system with the charge inversion characteristic, which is based on the modified nano-hydroxyapatite. According to the invention, nanoparticles with the positive charges and tumor cells with the negative charges are electrostatically bound to promote uptake of the tumor cells; and the drug delivery system has small toxic and side effects, has the characteristic of pH responsive release, and is beneficial for reducing drug leakage of the drug delivery system and improvingthe drug delivery efficiency.

column12: Copper metal organic framework nanoparticle functionalized hydrogel, preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a copper metal organic framework nanoparticle functionalized hydrogel, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving carboxymethyl chitosan, and adding reduced glutathione and N-hydroxysuccinimide which are mixed and dissolved in deionized water; adding 1-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)-3-ethyl carbodiimide hydrochloride to prepare glutathione modified carboxymethyl chitosan; preparing copper metal organic framework nanoparticles; then mixing the copper metal organic framework nanoparticles with deionized water; and adding the glutathione modified carboxymethyl chitosan, acrylamide, polyethylene glycol diacrylate, polyethylene glycol diglycidyl ether and an initiator to prepare the copper metal organic framework functionalized hydrogel. According to the invention, the obtained hydrogel has the capabilities of slowly and controllably releasing copper ions, removing active oxygen of a wound surface, always keeping the wound surface free of hydrops and a wet 3D microenvironment, protecting the wound from external injury and promoting wound healing.

column12: Carboxymethyl chitosan microcapsule for jointly loading chemotherapeutic drug and thermal therapy sensitizer to slowly release novel embolic agent, and preparation method and application of carboxymethyl chitosan microcapsule
column13: The invention discloses a microcapsule with a chemotherapeutic drug and a thermal therapy sensitizer, and a preparation method of the microcapsule. The microcapsule with the chemotherapeutic drug and the thermal therapy sensitizer in the invention comprises the shell and a core material; the shell is carboxymethyl chitosan; the core material is wrapped in the shell; the core material comprises a photothermal sensitizer and the chemotherapeutic drug; and targeting molecules are coupled to the outer surface of the shell. The microcapsule in the invention is prepared according to the following steps: emulsification, interfacial polymerization, folic acid coupling and washing, soas to obtain a material for coating photo-thermal temperature rise and tumour embolic agents. The microcapsule prepared by the method in the invention is simple in process, good in repeatability andhigh in production efficiency; and large-scale production is easy to realize. The particle size, the size and the thickness of the microcapsule prepared by the method in the invention are controllable. The shell material contains a large amount of amino groups, so that the drug can be endowed with the functions of controlled release, antibody coupling and the like. column12: Chitosan-cellulose sulfate magnetic porous composite microsphere as well as preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of porous microspheres, and discloses a chitosan cellulose sulfate magnetic porous composite microsphere as well as preparation and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving chitosan and cellulose sulfate in an ionic liquid to obtain a mixed solution; 2) dispersing magnetic particles in the mixed solution to obtain a magnetic suspension; mixing the oil phase, an emulsifying agent and a pore-foaming agent to obtain an emulsifying system; and 3) dispersing the magnetic suspension in an emulsification system, emulsifying under a heating condition, carrying out alcohol precipitation, cooling, and carrying out subsequent treatment to obtain the chitosan cellulose sulfate magnetic porous composite microsphere. The method disclosed by the invention is simple, mild in condition, green and environment-friendly. The prepared magnetic porous composite microspheres are rich in pores, large in specific surface area, multiple in active sites and good in lipase immobilization effect. The magnetic porous composite microsphere is applied to enzyme immobilization, protein adsorption separation and protein drug delivery.

column12: Method for preparing prothioconazole sustained-release gel particles by carboxymethyl chitosan-metal ion crosslinking method
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing prothioconazole sustained-release particles by a carboxymethyl chitosan-metal ion crosslinking method and belongs to the technical field of pesticide preparations. column12: COLCHICINE LOADED NANOFIBERS: PREPARATION METHOD, CHARACTERIZATION, OPTIMIZATION AND RELATED APPLICATIONS
column13: The well-known drug colchicine with various approved therapeutic properties in systemic and topical diseases could be chosen to be formulated in a nanofiberous based drug delivery system that it may enhance the potency and also it reduces the systemic toxicity in local administrations. In this invention, colchicine loaded chitosan based nanofiberous system was formulated, optimized, fully characterized, and evaluated in ex vivo. The optimizations was analyzed via AFM and SEM based on the morphology, topology and the diameters of the nanofibers. In addition, FTIR, XRD, STA, water angle measurement, tensile evaluation, and ex vivo skin permeation were checked. column12: Aroma-Loaded Microcapsules with Antibacterial Activity for Eco-friendly Applications
column13: Fragrant and antimicrobial properties were conferred to cotton fabrics following microencapsulation using green materials. Limonene and vanillin microcapsules were produced by complex coacervation using chitosan/gum Arabic as shell materials and tannic acid as hardening agent. The effect of two emulsifiers; Span 85 and polyglycerol polyricinoleate (PGPR), on the encapsulation efficiency (EE %), microcapsule's size and morphology, and cumulative release profiles was studied. The use of Span 85 resulted in mononuclear morphology while PGPR gave rise to polynuclear structures, regardless of the core material (vanillin or limonene). The obtained microcapsules demonstrated a sustained release patter. Grafting of the produced microcapsules onto cotton fabrics through an esterification reaction using citric acid as anon-toxic cross-linker followed by thermofixation and curing, was confirmed by SEM and FTIR spectroscopy. Standard antibacterial assays conducted on both microcapsules alone and impregnated onto the fabrics indicated a sustained antibacterial activity.

column13: Compositions of hyaluronic acid (HA) conjugated with antibiotics are disclosed for a rapid release antibiotic delivery system into a closed space to achieve rapid therapeutic range within 24 hours and effective elimination of the antibiotic within 80-120 hours. In particular, this invention is directed to compositions, method of preparation, and method of treatment to prevent invention using porous and non-porous embodiments of hyaluronic acid polymer conjugated with antibiotics or other therapeutic agents for rapid therapeutic delivery and controlled reduction of therapeutic dosages of antibiotics to prevent invention and reduce antibiotic resistance. Low concentration of crosslinkers conjugated with HA as well as using porogens and functional group modifiers allow other therapeutic to be conjugated to HA such as sugars and steroids. Suspension of HA conjugates in chitosan enable additional treatment means. Anti-cancer therapeutic agents may also be conjugated for controlled release using this system.

column12: Preparation and application of chitosan-encapsulated mesoporous carbon nano herbicide
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan-encapsulated mesoporous carbon nano herbicide, which comprises the following steps: by using carboxylated mesoporous carbon nanoparticles asa carrier of the herbicide, strongly adsorbing herbicide molecules in the solution, and encapsulating the herbicide-loaded mesoporous carbon nanoparticles with chitosan in an acetic acid aqueous solution. The chitosan-encapsulated mesoporous carbon nano herbicide disclosed by the invention hardly releases obviously in an aqueous solution with a range from strong acidity to alkalinity, so that theabsorption of the herbicide in the gastrointestinal tract of a human body is greatly reduced. The mesoporous carbon nanoparticles have a good near-infrared light heat effect, wherein the encapsulatedherbicide molecules are gradually released under the condition of natural sunlight irradiation, and the nano herbicide shows an efficient weeding effect similar to that of an active component herbicide. The nano pesticide preparation disclosed by the invention is good in biocompatibility, low in cost, simple in preparation process and small in toxic and side effects on a human body, and the controlled release performance of the sunlight-responsive nano herbicide is realized.

column12: Thymalfasin preparation and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a thymalfasin preparation and a preparation method thereof. The thymalfasin preparation is a sustained release preparation which consists of the following ingredients: an aprotinin immobilized sustained release micro-capsule and a medicinal auxiliary material, wherein the aprotinin immobilized sustained release micro-capsule consists of thymalfasin, medicinal oil, emulsifying agents, co-emulsifying agents, aqueous phase solvent, chitosan, sodium alginate, glutaraldehyde and aprotinin. The invention also provides a preparation method for the aprotinin immobilized sustained release micro-capsule, i.e., a complex coacervation method for preparing a chitosan-sodium alginate micro-capsule. A capsule core is a W/ O thymalfasin micro-emulsion, and then, the micro-capsule isimmobilized with the aprotinin. The micro-capsule is an ideal medicine releasing carrier which has the characteristics that the micro-capsule can be orally taken, is slow in releasing, is stable in thermodynamics and can release medicines in a targeting way. The sustained release micro-capsule which is easily hydrolyzed and is modified by the aprotinin can perform a function of protecting main ingredients, the medicine releasing time of a water-soluble medicine can be prolonged, enzymatic degradation is reduced, medicine bioavailability and a clinical curative effect are improved, medicine administration frequency can be greatly reduced, and economic and mental burdens are lightened for patients.

column12: siNRA delivery system compound as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of gene treatment and nano targeted delivery, in particular to a siNRA delivery system compound as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps of reacting Boc-protected histidine with cholesterol to generate Boc-protected histidine cholesteryl ester, and removing BOC-released protected aminoin trifluoroacetic acid to generate histidine cholesteryl ester; then, enabling amino to react with carboxyl of carboxymethyl chitosan to modify long-chain carboxymethyl chitosan to generate carboxymethyl chitosan modified by histidine cholesteryl ester, and performing targeted labeling on carboxymethyl chitosan modified by histidine cholesteryl ester to generate a carboxymethyl chitosan high-molecular compound modified by histidine cholesteryl ester and a targeted marker together, then forming a stable spherical delivery vector through self-assembly above critical micelle concentration, andmixing the stable spherical delivery vector with siRNA (small interfering ribonucleic acid) to obtain the siNRA delivery system compound. The siNRA delivery system compound prepared by the method hasgood targeting property, environmental responsiveness and siRNA stability.

column12: Temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type nano slow-release eye drops and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release eye drops and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations. The preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying chitosan by using alginic acid to obtain modified chitosan; grafting collagen with the modified chitosan to obtain modified chitosan grafted collagen, and mixing the modified chitosan grafted collagen with water to obtain temperature-sensitive hydrogel; dissolving triamcinolone acetonide in vegetable oil to prepare an oil phase;adding an emulsifier into water to prepare a water phase; adding the oil phase into the water phase, and uniformly mixing to obtain a triamcinolone acetonide emulsion; and adding the triamcinolone acetonide emulsion, an osmotic pressure regulator, a bacteriostatic agent and an antioxidant into the temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution to prepare the temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release eye drops. According to the invention, the encapsulation efficiency, drug loading capacity and slow release effect of triamcinolone acetonide in the eye drops are improved.

column12: Method for preparing degradable nanofibers of microporous core-shell structure
column13: The invention relates to a method for preparing degradable nanofibers of a microporous core-shell structure, and belongs to the technical field of medical materials. The method for preparing the degradable nanofibers of the microporous core-shell structure comprises the following steps that (1) lauryl sodium sulfate is adopted as a modifier, and chitosan is adopted as a raw material for preparingmodified chitosan; (2) polylactic acid and the modified chitosan are dissolved in a mixed solvent of dichloromethane and dimethyl sulfoxide to obtain a mixed solution, and the mixed solution is utilized for carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain an electrostatic spinning fiber film; (3) the electrostatic spinning fiber film is placed in Tris aqueous alkali to be dissolved, and after soakingand washing and drying are carried out, the degradable nanofibers are obtained. The degradable nanofibers prepared through the method have the special microporous structure which is more beneficial to proliferation and differentiation of cells and tissue growth, and the degradable nanofibers can be applied to the fields of hernia repairing, wound dressing, hemostatic materials, support materials,drug sustained releasing and the like.

column12: Targeting nano system and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a targeting nano system. The system comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-100 parts of carboxymethyl chitosan-4-hydroxymethyl-phenylboronic acid pinacol ester, 1-20 parts of docetaxel, 1-40 parts of curcumin, and 50-100 parts of T7 polypeptide. In the system, 4-hydroxymethyl-phenylboronic acid pinacol ester (BAPE) and carboxymethyl chitosan (CMCS) are utilized to synthesize CMCS-BAPE with biological responsiveness and good biocompatibility through an amidation reaction; secondly, the targeting polypeptide T7 with high affinity with a transferrin receptor is conjugated, and thereby the enrichment of a nano-carrier at a tumor site is increased; and besides, curcumin and docetaxel are loaded, and the drug release is accurately regulated and controlled within a pH range of 5.0-7.0 according to the level of reactive oxygen species (ROS), so that the problem that chemotherapeutic drugs injure normal tissues is solved, and the lung cancer is treated in a combined mode. The nano delivery carrier can be used as an effective anti-cancer drug delivery system, has great clinical application potential, and provides a method for future multi-drug synergistic anti-cancer treatment.

column12: Metal-organic framework-based drug carrier and preparation method and application thereof to oral drug carrier
column13: The invention relates to a metal-organic framework-based drug carrier and a preparation method and application thereof to an oral drug carrier. According to the preparation method, MOFs with relatively good stability are synthesized by using a solvothermal method; 5-FU is loaded into the MOFs through a solvent evaporation method; and the outer surfaces of the MOFs are wrapped with chitosan to obtain CS&MOFs@5-FU. The prepared CS&MOFs@5-FU can increase the stability of the MOFs in an acid environment, meanwhile, the chitosan enhances adhesion behaviors to mucus through interacting with a non-covalent bond of a mucus chain to play a certain sustained-release role, the permeability of intestinal mucosa can be improved and the oral bioavailability of drugs can be improved. In addition, the chitosan also has a hole sealing effect and avoids leakage of a large number of drugs in advance. The feasibility is provided for the MOFs serving as the oral drug carrier.

column12: Drug-loaded metal nanoparticle/chitosan controlled-release hydrogel, and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a drug-loaded metal nanoparticle/chitosan controlled-release hydrogel. The preparation method comprises the following steps: under stirring, adding a drug-loaded metal nanoparticle suspension into a chitosan solution to obtain a drug-loaded metal nanoparticle/chitosan controlled-release hydrogel. The hydrogel is a nano controlled release system basedon combination of metal nanoparticles and chitosan, can maintain a humid environment at a wound interface, has cooling and relieving effects, and also has excellent biocompatibility and mechanical properties. column12: ABSORBABLE IMPLANTS FOR PLASTIC SURGERY
column13: Absorbable implants for breast surgery that conform to the breast parenchyma and surrounding chest wall have been developed. These implants support newly lifted breast parenchyma, and/or a breast implant. The implants have mechanical properties sufficient to support a reconstructed breast, and allow the in-growth of tissue into the implant as it degrades. The implants have a strength retention profile allowing the support of the breast to be transitioned from the implant to regenerated host tissue, without significant loss of support. Three-dimensional implants for use in minimally invasive mastopexy/breast reconstruction procedures are also described, that confer shape to a patient's breast. These implants are self-reinforced, can be temporarily deformed, implanted in a suitably dissected tissue plane, and resume their preformed three-dimensional shape. The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column12: Nano-emulsion drug carrier and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nano-emulsion drug carrier and a preparation method and application thereof. column12: PHOTO-CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL MATERIAL AND PREPARATION, COMPOSITION, AND APPLICATION THEREOF PHOTO-CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL
column13: This invention provides preparations, compositions, products, and applications of photo-crosslinked hydrogels. Component A—a photosensitive polymer derivative, component B—the photoinitiator, and auxiliary component C—other biocompatible polymer derivative each are respectively dissolved in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A, solution B, and solution C. The solution A, the solution B, and the optional solution C are mixed homogenously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution. The hydrogel precursor solution is subject to irradiation of the UV light for photocoupled crosslinking to form a photo-crosslinked hydrogel. The photo-crosslinked hydrogel exhibit rapid speed of photo-curing, strong tissue adhesion, excellent mechanical properties, good biocompatibility, and excellent clinical operability. In addition, this invention also provides a kit for making the photo-crosslinked hydrogel, and applications thereof in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing, and as a carrier of cell, protein, or drug.

column12: PHOTO-COUPLED SYNERGISTICALLY CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL MATERIAL AND ITS COMPOSITION, PREPARATION METHOD, USE, PRODUCT, AND PREPARATION KIT
column13: This invention provides a preparation, composition, product, and application of a photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material. The preparation includes dissolving Component A including a photosensitive polymer derivative having o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers and Component B including a polymer derivative having amine or alkene (double group) or sulfhydryl group in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A and solution B, respectively; mixing the solution A and solution B homogeneously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; initiating photo-coupled synergistic crosslinking under an irradiation of a UV light to form the hydrogel. The irradiation causes the o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers to generate an aldehyde group/keto group or a nitroso group to initiate photo-coupled synergetic crosslinking. The photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel has applications in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing and as a carrier of cell, protein or drug.

column12: Cell-structure-imitated nano material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a cell-structure-imitating nano material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out surface ion modification on a mesoporous nano material to form hydrophilic surface modification; carrying out purification treatment such as splitting decomposition and discontinuous sucrose-chitosan density gradient extraction on the target cells in sequence to obtain target membrane protein; and then quickly assembling the target membrane protein onto the surfaces of the mesoporous nanoparticles through an electrostatic adsorption principle under the guidance of ultrasonic waves to form a cell-like nanostructure consisting of the target membrane protein, the cavity and the nanomaterial wall. According tothe method, the random uncertainty and the low purity of the existing extraction of the cell membrane targeted membrane protein are overcome, the biological activity of the original membrane protein is completely reserved, and the preparation efficiency of the cell-like structure nano material is improved. The method can be applied to the biomedical fields such as separation and purification of membrane proteins of various cells, anti-tumor, anti-virus and anti-bacterial drug delivery carriers, preventive and therapeutic nano vaccine drugs or diagnosis and treatment integrated nano materials.

column12: Method for preparing composite essential oil particles based on microfluidic technology
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing composite essential oil particles based on a microfluidic technology. The method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing, heating and stirring essential oil, chitosan, Tween 40, polyvinyl alcohol and water to form a pre-emulsion; (2) in a micro-channel, adopting the pre-emulsion as an inner phase, dissolving chitosan in acetic acid and a Pluronic F127 aqueous solution to be used as an intermediate phase, and adopting an n-octyl alcohol solution containing Span80 as an outer phase; and (3) introducing the single emulsion formed in the micro-channel into a coagulating bath, carrying out solvent extraction and chemical cross-linking curing to obtain particles, washing the obtained particles with n-octane, and naturally drying. According to themethod, the particles with the diameter of 50-300 microns can be prepared, the particles have good monodispersity, the encapsulation efficiency of the essential oil reaches up to 100% in combination with molecular embedding and physical embedding modes, and the essential oil can be continuously released through a diffusion effect. The method has important significance in efficient packaging, controllable structure and controllable release of essential oil particle products.

column12: AUTOMATIC DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE
column13: The present invention provides an automatic drug delivery device. The automatic drug delivery device includes an enclosure and a first piston disposed in the enclosure. The first piston partitions the enclosure to a first drug delivery chamber and a first expansion chamber. A first through hole and a second through hole are formed in the wall of the enclosure, the first through-hole communicates with the first drug delivery chamber, and the second through-hole communicates with the first expansion chamber. A first targeted dissolution membrane covers the first through hole and the second through hole, and dissolves at a first targeted region. A drug is filled in the first drug delivery chamber, and an expandable material is included in the first expansion chamber. The expandable material in the first expansion chamber can expand after absorbing liquid.

column12: Absorbable implants for plastic surgery
column13: Absorbable implants for breast surgery that conform to the breast parenchyma and surrounding chest wall have been developed. These implants support newly lifted breast parenchyma, and/or a breast implant. The implants have mechanical properties sufficient to support a reconstructed breast, and allow the in-growth of tissue into the implant as it degrades. The implants have a strength retention profile allowing the support of the breast to be transitioned from the implant to regenerated host tissue, without significant loss of support. Three-dimensional implants for use in minimally invasive mastopexy/breast reconstruction procedures are also described, that confer shape to a patient's breast. These implants are self-reinforced, can be temporarily deformed, implanted in a suitably dissected tissue plane, and resume their preformed three-dimensional shape. The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column12: Bone fusion hydrogel scaffold and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a bone fusion hydrogel scaffold and a preparation method thereof. The bone fusion hydrogel scaffold is subjected to 3D printing under ultraviolet excitation to form a cell scaffold with a three-dimensional structure; the bone fusion hydrogel scaffold comprises a drug loading layer, a first osteogenesis mediation layer and a second osteogenesis mediation layer which are subjected to 3D printing to form a reticular disc structure; the drug loading layer, the first osteogenesis mediation layer and the second osteogenesis mediation layer are sequentially adhered and cured from top to bottom through polymer hydrogel to form the multilayer and porous hydrogel scaffold; the drug loading layer is prepared from the polymer hydrogel and rhBMP-2-loaded 2-N, 6-O-sulfated chitosan (rhBMP-2/NPs); and the first osteogenesis mediation layer and the second osteogenesis mediation layer are prepared from the polymer hydrogel and hydroxyapatite nanocrystals (nHA). The prepared bonefusion hydrogel scaffold can ensure that a bone fusion material has the high mechanical strength, the high porosity and the high precision, and also has the capability of promoting bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell and bone tissue ingrowth by microsphere controlled release of bone growth factors so as to induce bone repair.

column13: Disclosed are a brain-targeted delivery system for carrier-free nasal nano preparation modified by chitosan oligosaccharide and a preparation method therefor. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing freeze-dried nano-particle powder; and step 2, stirring the freeze-dried powder and chitosan oligosaccharide in isotonic normal saline before use to form a nasal preparation having good membrane permeability. column12: Self-repairable chitosan hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a self-repairable chitosan hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and reacting a diimidazole compound and diamine to obtain a pre-reaction solution containing a thiourea group and a urea group, further carrying out reaction with chitosan, introducing a thiourea group, a urea group and other hydrogen bond groups into a high-molecular chain segment of the chitosan hydrogel, and performing self-repairing of the material by virtue of breakage and recombination of intramolecular or intermolecular hydrogen bonds, thus endowing the chitosan hydrogel material with a relatively good self-repairing function. The self-repairable chitosan hydrogel is high in self-repairing efficiency, simple in preparation processand low in cost. The chitosan hydrogel prepared by the method provided by the invention has the advantages of low toxicity, biodegradability and the like, and can be applied to the fields of drug sustained-release materials, tissue engineering scaffolds, medical dressings, printing and dyeing wastewater treatment and the like.

column12: Preparation method of chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere and application of chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere in sustained release of metacycline hydrochloride
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere and an application of the chitosan/montmorillonite hybrid microsphere in sustained release of metacyclinehydrochloride. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing CTAB (cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide) modified montmorillonite by taking chitosan as a raw material, malonic acid asa cross-linking agent and CTAB (cetyltrimethyl ammonium bromide) modified montmorillonite as a modifier and adopting an inverse emulsion polymerization method to prepare hybrid microspheres of chitosan intercalated montmorillonite; (2) dissolving chitosan in a 5.0% malonic acid solution to enable the concentration of chitosan to be 1.0-3.0%; and (3) adding CTAB modified montmorillonite into the chitosan-malonic acid mixed solution, stirring in a water bath at 60 DEG C for 2 hours, adding liquid paraffin, span-80, tween-80 and ethyl acetate, stirring for 0.5 hour, gradually dropwise adding a catalyst solution, stirring at 75 DEG C for 4-5 hours, standing for cooling, discarding an upper oil phase, adjusting pH, performing suction filtration, washing, drying and grinding. According to the preparation method, malonic acid is used as a cross-linking agent for the first time, CTAB modified montmorillonite is used as a modifier, chitosan is stably inserted into montmorillonite interlayers by virtue of amidation reaction between carboxyl and amino, the interlayer spacing is enlarged, and a better drug slow-release effect is achieved.

column12: Biodegradable drug-loaded nanofiber medical bandage for burn department and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a biodegradable drug-loaded nanofiber medical bandage for burn department and a preparation method thereof. The medical bandage is of a double-layer structure composed of a surface supporting layer and an inner hydrophobic layer. A common gauze bandage subjected to carboxymethylation modification is used as a main body structure to serve as the surface supporting layer; a coaxial electrostatic spinning method is adopted, the surface supporting layer serves as a receiving layer of coaxial electrostatic spinning, and the inner hydrophobic layer with shell/core structure coaxial nanofibers is constructed on the fiber surface of the common gauze bandage subjected to carboxymethylation modification; in the coaxial nanofiber with the shell/core structure, a shell layer material is a mixture of gelatin and zein, and a core layer material is a mixture of chitosan and active ingredients. The medical bandage has excellent biocompatibility, degradability, hemostatic and antibacterial properties, anti-adhesion performance and drug sustained release performance. The preparation method is simple and controllable, and has huge application value.

column12: Hypoxia-sensitive nitrobenzenized chitosan and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides hypoxia-sensitive nitrobenzenized chitosan and a preparation method and application thereof. column12: PREPARATION, RAW MATERIALS, PRODUCT, AND APPLICATION OF PHOTOCROSSLINKED HYDROGEL MATERIAL
column13: This invention provides preparations, compositions, products, and applications of photo-crosslinked hydrogels. Component A - a photosensitive polymer derivative, component B - the photoinitiator, and auxiliary component C - other biocompatible polymer derivative each are respectively dissolved in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A, solution B, and solution C. The solution A, the solution B, and the optional solution C are mixed homogenously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution. The hydrogel precursor solution is subject to irradiation of the UV light for photocoupled crosslinking to form a photo-crosslinked hydrogel. The photo-crosslinked hydrogel exhibit rapid speed of photo-curing, strong tissue adhesion, excellent mechanical properties, good biocompatibility, and excellent clinical operability. In addition, this invention also provides a kit for making the photo-crosslinked hydrogel, and applications thereof in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing, and as a carrier of cell, protein, or drug.

column12: Injectable temperature-sensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to injectable temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel is composed of sulfydryl modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan, the sulfydrylmodified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan is prepared from hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan and 3-mercaptopropionic acid through a thiolation reaction, and the molar ratio of amino groups on the reactant 3-mercaptopropionic acid to amino groups on the reactant hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1: 1 to 0.5: 1. The method is mild in reaction condition, simple and safe to operateand easier to accept by researchers. The sulfydryl modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan prepared by the reaction has a thermo-sensitive sol-gel conversion behavior, and by controlling factors such as the reaction time, the molar ratio and the concentration of a thiolated acyl ethylene glycol chitosan solution, the sulfydryl modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan can present a free-flowing sol state at the room temperature and can be converted into a gel state at the body temperature. Further, the material has characteristics of high adhesion, low cytotoxicity and good biodegradability, and has potential application value in the field of injectable drug sustained-release carriers.

column12: Ultraviolet cross-linked temperature-sensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses ultraviolet cross-linked temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel is composed of double bond modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan. The hydrogel is prepared by double bond reaction of hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan and glycidyl methacrylate, the molar ratio of amino groups on the reactant glycidyl methacrylate to amino groups on the reactant hexacylated ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1: 1 to 0.5: 1, and carbon-carbon double bonds in a polymer network are further crosslinked to improve the mechanical strength through ultraviolet irradiation in the presence of a photoinitiator. According to the method, many obstacles related to development of injectable carriers are overcome, the photo-crosslinked hydrogel obtained through the reaction has better mechanical performance, the mechanical strength and degradation rate are adjusted by controlling the heat sensitivity and the crosslinking degree between carbon-carbon double bonds, so that the application field of the crosslinked hydrogel is expanded. In addition, the material has good biodegradability and temperature sensitivity, and has potential application valuein the fields of injectable drug sustained-release carriers and the like.

column12: Galactosylated chitosan coated mesoporous silica carrier and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, and relates to a galactosylated chitosan coated mesoporous silica carrier and application thereof. On the basis of a mesoporous silica carrier, combined colon cancer targeted therapy of 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) and formyl calcium tetrahydrofolate (LV) is realized in combination with galactosylated chitosan (GC). The preparation method comprises the following steps: constructing GC-coated mesoporous silica nanoparticles (5-FU@MSN-NH2/GC) loading 5-FU, synthesizing MSN-COOH by virtue of a two-step synthesis method, and constructing GC-coated mesoporous silica nanoparticles (LV@MSN-COOH/GC) loading LV. Research results show that the GC-coated mesoporous silica nano drug delivery system can utilize GC to be combined with a galectin receptor on thesurface of a colon cancer cell so as to increase the concentration of LV and 5-FU in tumor cells, and can remarkably reduce the expression level of thymidylate synthase (TS) in SW620 cells by combining the two medicines, so that the anti-colon cancer effect is improved.

column12: Decitabine nano carrier and application thereof in preparing tumor fluorescence imaging agent
column13: The invention provides a decitabine nano carrier and an application thereof in preparing a tumor fluorescence imaging agent. The decitabine nano carrier is prepared by a multiple emulsion method. Bovine hemoglobin, fluorescent dye Nile red, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and the like are adopted for emulsification, then wrapping is performed by using chitosan loaded with decitabine andchitosan modified by nitrobenzooxadiazole (NBD), and sterilizing is performed to prepare freeze-dried powder, wherein the freeze-dried powder is dissolved in a water phase for oxygen loading before being used. The decitabine nano carrier is based on 769-P and OS-RC-2 kidney cancer cell lines, and a hypoxia cell model and a tumor-bearing mouse model are constructed. The results show that CNDHNNPs can improve the hypoxia microenvironment and reduce drug efflux, and decitabine can increase uptake of chemotherapeutic drugs and increase sensitization of chemotherapy. Peroxidation of lipid is increased by catalysis, and ferroptosis therapy is combined. The invention provides a novel scheme of hypoxia and hypermethylation combined ferroptosis of targeting tumor for renal cancer treatment, provides a drug delivery system, and realizes tumor fluorescence imaging. The decitabine nano carrier is reasonable in design and high in repeatability.

column12: Synthesis method of gatifloxacin-chalcone conjugate slow release agent
column13: The invention relates to the field of medicine preparation, and in particular to a synthesis method of a gatifloxacin-chalcone conjugate slow release agent. The synthesis method comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a gatifloxacin-chalcone conjugate; S2, mixing ginkgo polyprenol and chitosan according to a molar ratio of (2-5):1, dissolving the mixture in an acetic acid solution with a concentration of 0.2-0.5mol/ L, and performing reacting for 1-2h by using Cu as a catalyst to obtain composite chitosan; S3, dissolving the gatifloxacin-chalcone conjugate obtained in the step S1 and thecomposite chitosan obtained in the step S2 in a hydrochloric acid solution with a mass fraction of 0.1-0.5% according to a mass ratio of 1:(30-50), and performing ultrasound at 50-100 Hz for 20-30 minutes; and S4, adjusting the mixed solution obtained in the step S3 to neutral and performing spray drying. The drug sustained-release agent obtained by the method has a good drug sustained-release effect and has a good inhibiting effect on cancer cells.

column12: FLOATABLE PHARMACEUTICAL MICROCAPSULE COMPOSITION
column13: Disclosed herein is a sustained release hollow core-shell microcapsule formulation for drug delivery comprising a hollow shell of one or more hydrophobic polymers, a drug containing hydrophilic or amphiphilic carrier matrix that is distributed over the inner surface of the hollow shell, a flotation agent, and an optional osmotic agent, wherein the microcapsule is capable of floating in a simulated digestive fluid for a period of from 24 to 96 hours. The microcapsules are prepared by a modified double emulsion (water/oil/water) solvent evaporation method. The microcapsule formulation may provide a sustained-release delivery system for treating chronic diseases such as Parkinson's disease, diabetes and tuberculosis, all of which require multiple drug combination therapies. The aim is to reduce dosing frequency and pill burden, thus improving patient medication compliance. In a specific embodiment, the hollow shell is formed from a mixture of Poly-L-lactide (PLLA) and poly(E-caprolactone) (PCL); and the amphiphilic carrier matrix is casein.

column12: Curcumin multilayer emulsion with colon-targeted delivery function, and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a curcumin multilayer emulsion with a colon-targeted delivery function, and a preparation method and application thereof. column12: SILICONE ADHESIVE COMPOSITIONS
Chitosan materials from carbonic acid solution
column13: The present invention comprises chitosan materials and methods of using carbonic acid for aqueous solubilization of neutralized or pre-treated chitosan gels and provides, among other things, substantially acid salt free composition native final forms without requiring subsequent acid salt elution. The invention includes chitosan-based solid and semi-solid material forms, optionally reinforced with chitosan fibers, such as powders, fibers, films, matrices, sponges, implants, scaffolds, fillers, and hydrogels. Native final forms are produced from chitosan powder solubilized in an aqueous acidic solution, processed to form a high pH hydrated chitosan gel precipitate material that is then neutralized by water washing and re-solubilized substantially to chitosan solution using carbonic acid. Chitosan materials can be mixed in solution with one or more of other hydrophilic polymers to create compositional heterogeneity and pharmaceutical agents to achieve controlled release of the agent(s) from the final forms at the site of application.

column12: Completely degradable tissue engineering skin scaffold material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a completely degradable tissue engineering skin scaffold material which comprises two parts, namely, a bacterial cellulose/chitosan nanofiber layer and a large-aperture array micron fiber scaffold. The bacterial cellulose/chitosan nanofiber layer is an upper layer, the upper part of the large-aperture array micron fiber scaffold is a lower layer, and the layers are crosslinked and combined through glutaraldehyde. The bacterial cellulose/chitosan nanofiber layer is formed by in-situ synthesis of gluconacetobacter xylinum, and cellulase is fixed on the surface of the bacterial cellulose/chitosan nanofiber layer. The large-aperture array micron fiber scaffold is a scaffold formed by arranging electrostatic spinning lactic acid/hyaluronic acid/fibroin micro-nano fibersin an orderly manner, and the surface of the large-aperture array micron fiber scaffold is modified with polylactic acid-glycolic acid growth factor sustained-release microspheres. The used raw materials are non-toxic and harmless, the fiber property is stable, and good biocompatibility is achieved. The scaffold material can be completely degraded in vivo. The pore diameter of the lower-layer scaffold is close to the cell size, and cells can enter the scaffold. Growth factors can be stably released, and skin tissue regeneration is facilitated.

column12: Sustained-release microgel ointment with high drug loading capacity and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a sustained-release microgel ointment with high drug loading capacity and a preparation method and application thereof. The concentration of the liquid medicine outside the microgel is improved throughconcentration. The drug loading capacity of the microgel can be improved. The drug which is not loaded by the microgel can inhibit the loaded drug from being released outwards from the microgel to acertain extent, and the slow release time is prolonged. The thickener can be used for preparing the drug-loaded microgel suspension into paste, so that the paste is favorably smeared on the surface ofskin, and meanwhile, the fed drug can be completely utilized. column12: Carboxymethyl chitosan modified drug-carrying vesicle, and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a carboxymethyl chitosan modified drug-carrying vesicle. The drug-carrying vesicle is characterized in that a lipid bilayer membrane of an extracellular vesicle is coated or modified by carboxymethyl chitosan. The molecular weight of the carboxymethyl chitosan is from 165 to 119000, and the deacetylation degree is more than or equal to 50%. The drug-carrying vesicle comprises one or more medicines selected from diclofenac sodium, insulin, paclitaxel, cisplatin, doxorubicin, sipeimine and the like. According to the invention, the carboxymethyl chitosan is connected to the surface of the extracellular vesicle, and modification of the carboxymethyl chitosan changes the surface property of the extracellular vesicle and has profound influence on the drug delivery mechanism of the extracellular vesicle. Compared with a common extracellular vesicle, the drug-carrying vesicle is targeted to tumor cells. A preparation prepared from the carboxymethyl chitosan modified drug-carrying vesicle has more cell vesicles under a condition of ingestion in tumors.

column12: Method of Assuring Dissolution of Degradable Tools
column13: The use of degradable components has become a more common practice in subterranean operations for such applications as temporarily isolating zones or diverting flow. A major concern of operators in using degradable tools is the ability to ensure that the tool has completely degraded and is no longer blocking or obstructing flow. This issue can be resolved through the use of degradable components that include one or more chemical additives that are released upon the partial or full dissolution of the degradable component, and which can be used to facilitate in the dissolution of the degradable component. The degradable component can optionally include tracer elements that are released upon the partial or full dissolution of the degradable component, and which can be detected at the surface to ensure the desired degradation or removal of the degradable component as well as hydraulic access to that stage.

column12: High-permeability one-way waterproof film of fruits and vegetables and preparation method thereof high-permeability one-way waterproof film
column13: The invention discloses a high-permeability one-way waterproof film of fruits and vegetables and a preparation method thereof the high-permeability one-way waterproof film. The one-way waterproof filmis composed of a hydrogel film layer and a spinning film layer. The one-way waterproof film is prepared by the following methods: preparing a carboxymethyl chitosan solution; firstly dissolving genipin into pure water in advance, further adding the genipin into the carboxymethyl chitosan solution drop by drop, performing ultrasonic treatment to uniformly disperse the genipin into the solution, allowing the solution to stand for 4-12 hours to complete cross-linking, further adding Ca(OH)2 and bacteriostatic substances, and fully dispersing the components so as to obtain a hydrogel solution; pouring the hydrogel solution into a glass plate, performing drying in a vacuum drying oven, and performing peeling so as to obtain a hydrogel film; and by taking an ethanol solution of ethyl celluloseand Tween-80 as a spinning solution, performing electrostatic spinning on the hydrogel film until the spinning film completely covers the hydrogel film, so as to obtain the one-way waterproof film. The one-way waterproof film prepared by the invention can change gas permeability according to respiration of fruits and vegetables, and has good properties of moisturizing, moisture adjustment, waterproofness, air permeability and sustained release, and is capable of effectively prolonging the shelf life of fruits and vegetables.

column13: The invention relates to a polysaccharide gel microcapsule and a preparation method. column12: Chili seedling culture method
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a chili seedling culture method. The method includes the steps of firstly, soaking chili seeds in a nutrient solution, dipping into a chitosan solution for 3-4 seconds, and placing in a shady place to dry moisture on the surfaces of the seeds; secondly, mixing field soil and bagasse, adding a compound microbial agent, evenly stirring, and piling up in an environment of 20-25 DEG C to perform fermentation to obtain a fermented substrate; thirdly, adding sustained-release fertilizer special for chili into the fermentedsubstrate, and evenly stirring to obtain a seedling culture medium; fourthly, planting the chili seeds processed in the first step into the seedling culture medium, covering with a layer of seedlingculture medium after sowing, and watering; transplanting after the seeds growth into chili seedlings. The chili seedling culture method has the advantages that seed vigor can be increased, seed germination can be promoted, contaminative microbes can be prevented, and the emergence rate of the chili seeds can be increased effectively; strong seedling culture can be promoted; by using the field soiland the bagasse as the main raw materials of the seedling culture medium, seedling culture cost is lowered greatly.

column12: Method for preparing aromatic vegetable oil microcapsules based on microfluidic technology
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing aromatic vegetable oil microcapsules based on a microfluidic technology. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) taking aromatic vegetable oil as an inner phase, a chitosan-dissolved acetic acid and PF-127 aqueous solution as an intermediate phase and a Span80-containing n-octyl alcohol solution as an outer phase in a micro-channel;and (2) introducing a multiphase emulsion formed in the micro-channel into a coagulating bath, carrying out solvent extraction and chemical cross-linking curing to obtain microcapsules, washing the microcapsules with n-octane, and naturally drying the washed microcapsules to obtain the aromatic vegetable oil microcapsules. The microcapsules with the diameter of 120-500 [mu]m can be prepared through the method, have a good monodispersity, the encapsulation rate of the aromatic vegetable oil reaches up to 100%, and the aromatic vegetable oil can be continuously released through the diffusion effect, and can be suddenly released through pH response. The method is of great significance to efficient encapsulation, controllable structure and controllable release of the aromatic vegetable oil microcapsule product.

column12: Two-Stage Microparticle-Based Therapeutic Delivery System and Method
column13: A system for delivery of a therapeutic agent to a site in mucosal tissue is provided. The system includes a porous, mucoadhesive polymeric matrix having a first and a second opposed surfaces. The matrix is formed by a composition including chitosan. The composition may also include any or all of a hydration promotor, a microparticle adhesion inhibitor, and a microparticle aggregation inhibitor. A plurality of microparticles having an average diameter between 500 nm and 2000 nm are embedded within the matrix. The microparticles contain a therapeutic agent and have a coating around the therapeutic agent. The first surface of the matrix is configured to be attached to the site in the mucosal tissue and the matrix is configured to provide controlled release of the microparticles through the first surface. The coating of the microparticles includes chitosan so as to provide controlled release of the agent from the microparticles.

column12: Bifunctional starch-based composite nanoparticle as well as preparation method and application thereof

A drug delivery formulation for treating a mental illness or a central nervous system disorder according to the present invention can slowly release a drug at a constant rate without a burst of drug release in the early stage of drug administration to maintain a constant blood drug level over a long period of time and thus enjoys the advantage of preventing excessive initial release of drug, which is a problem with the administration of conventional psychopharmaceutical agents or antidepressants, and easily obtaining a desirable sustained release behavior by single administration without necessity for multiple administrations divided at regular time intervals. In addition, a method for preparing a drug delivery formulation according to the present invention is a process simpler than conventional methods and has the advantage of reducing time and cost in preparing a sustained-release drug delivery formulation.

column12: PREPARATION FOR CHITOSAN AND PROPYLENE GLYCOL ALGINATE BLENDED MICROCAPSULE AND APPLICATION THEREOF
column13: Provided are preparation for a chitosan and propylene glycol alginate blended microcapsule and an application thereof, pertaining to the field of preparation and application of microcapsules. The preparation comprises dissolving chitosan with an acetic acid solution having a mass percentage concentration of 0.5-5%, dissolving propylene glycol alginate with water, then mixing the two solutions, introducing a 2-8% aqueous solution of NaOH in a high-voltage electrostatic field to form wet blended microcapsules, and then washing and drying the wet blended microcapsules to obtain dry blended microcapsules. The prepared chitosan and propylene glycol alginate blended microcapsule can be used as an embolic material for vascular embolization, where the embolic material is injected or fed into a target blood vessel through a catheter to occlude the blood vessel at a target position. Good expansion properties of the embolic material can avoid the migration of microcapsules in blood vessels, and the stable structure thereof can stabilize embolisms. Further, the blended microcapsule is applicable to sustained-release drugs as a carrier for a sustained-release drug, achieving the effect of desirable sustained release of the drug by combining the blended microcapsule with the drug.

column12: Finishing method of absorbent cotton gauze to achieve sustained-release bacteriostatic performance and high liquid absorption rate
column13: The present invention discloses a finishing method of absorbent cotton gauze to achieve sustained-release bacteriostatic performance and a high liquid absorption rate. The method includes the steps ofheating absorbent cotton gauze with a sodium percarbonate solution through a water bath, neutralizing the absorbent cotton gauze with a hydrochloric acid solution after oxidation treatment, and fullywashing and drying the absorbent cotton gauze to obtain the absorbent cotton gauze which is subjected to oxidation treatment; dissolving chitosan in an acetic acid solution, magnetically stirring themixture uniformly, immersing the absorbent cotton gauze which is subjected to oxidation treatment into the mixture, and then performing drying to obtain the absorbent cotton gauze treated with chitosan; after heating of Vaseline, mixing the heated Vaseline with paraffin oil and radix sophorae flavescentis seed flavonoid sustained-release pellets, performing sterilization at the high pressure, immersing the oxidized absorbent cotton gauze treated with the chitosan into the mixture, then taking out the cotton gauze for draining, and obtaining the sustained-release bacteriostatic absorbent cotton gauze through ethylene oxide treatment; uniformly mixing and heating a polyvinyl alcohol water solution, an absorbent material and oxidized-graphene-modified superabsorbent resin, immersing the sustained-release bacteriostatic absorbent cotton gauze into the mixture, then taking out the cotton gauze, putting it on a printed scraper plate, and performing drying to obtain the sustained-release bacteriostatic absorbent cotton gauze with the high liquid absorption rate after a scraper moves back and forth three times for scraping.

column12: Targeted perfluorocarbon oxygen-carrying microspheres for magnetic thermotherapy and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a targeted perfluorocarbon oxygen-carrying microsphere for magnetic hyperthermia and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises emulsifying perfluorocarbon into an emulsion, the perfluorocarbon emulsion is soluble in water and carrying oxygen, oxygenating and disinfecting the perfluorocarbon emulsion, wrapping the emulsion and magnetic nanoparticles in chitosan to form microspheres, and linking surface of the microspheres with polyethylene glycol and folic acid to improve water solubility of the microspheres and achieve a targeting function. In the preparation method, perfluorocarbon is used as an oxygen-carrying material and wrapped in chitosan together with the magnetic nanoparticles, the surface of the obtained microspheres is modified with polyethylene glycol molecules to improve the water solubility and grafted with folic acid molecules to form microspheres with a core-shell structure. The microspheres can achieve a sustained release effect of oxygen, the shell material has good biocompatibility and targeting, and the magnetic nanoparticles can exert magnetic thermotherapy in a magnetic field, thereby the ability of the microspheres to kill tumors is improved. The microspheres can alleviate hypoxia in tumor site and improve an effect of external adjuvant therapy.

column12: Scented pleated face mask
column13: A scented mask is disclosed that includes: a filter region with one or more pleats that include a mask material and a pleat fold; and one or more scented patches. Each scented patch includes a patch lid attached to the mask material before the pleat fold; a patch-impermeable layer attached to the mask material after the pleat fold; and a layer impregnated with a scent agent attached to the patch-impermeable layer. The mask is constructed to transition from a sealed configuration to an unsealed configuration when a user places the mask over her nose and mouth: the sealed configuration where the mask material before and after the pleat fold are folded on each other and the patch lid covers and seals the impregnated layer, inhibiting the vaporization of the scent agent; and the unsealed configuration where the pleat fold is opened and the patch lid is separated from the impregnated layer, allowing for the vaporization of the scent agent.

column12: Hypoxia sensitive response type chitosan-nitroimidazole graft, and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a hypoxia sensitive response type chitosan-nitroimidazole graft, and a preparation method and an application thereof. column12: Sialic acid-modified composite nano-drug delivery system and preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a sialic acid-modified composite nano-drug delivery system and preparation and application thereof. Under the stabilization action of sialic acid-modified chitosan-deoxycholic acid graft micelle, hydroxyapatite nanoparticles are prepared by a hydrothermal method, thus enhancing stability of hydroxyapatite. Through the specific binding of sialic acid on the surface of the system to highly-expressed E-selectin on the surface of vascular endothelial cells in arthritic sites, targeted delivery and high accumulation of a drug on the arthritic sites are realized. Under the condition of low pH in the arthritic sites and cells, rapid release of the drug is achieved through the degradation of hydroxyapatite, which significantly improves the inhibitory effect and tolerance ofthe drug to inflammatory reactions and reduces the toxic and side effects of the drug. By promoting the synthesis and secretion of glycosaminoglycans by chondrocytes, cartilage repair is realized, andosteoblast mineralization is promoted. With the synergism of sialic acid's own bone repair ability, osteogenic repair and regeneration function is enhanced. The sialic acid-modified composite nano-drug delivery system can be applied to preparation of rheumatoid arthritis drugs.

column12: Porous silicon/gold nanoparticle composite hydrogel preparation method and hydrogel prepared by method

According to the present invention, the temperature-sensitive porous silicon/gold nanoparticle composite hydrogel can achieve the sustained release of drugs in vivo, and has excellent biodegradability and photothermal effect.

column12: Drug-coated balloon
column13: Described here are devices, systems, and methods for treating conditions or diseases of the nose, ear, or throat with an expandable device having a drug coating. The expandable devices may be delivered to a body cavity in a low-profile configuration and expanded to contact surrounding tissue. The expandable devices may deliver or release the drug coating to the tissue. Multiple expansions of a single device may be employed during treatment. Various coating excipients and manufacturing parameters for the expandable devices may also be adjusted to enhance or slow transfer of the drug coating and/or release of the drug to the target tissue site. The drug transferred to the tissue may act as an in situ depot that enables maintenance of a therapeutic level of locally delivered drug for a desired time period after removal of the expandable devices.
