column12: Bacteriostatic material with controlled release effect, and preparation method and application of bacteriostatic material
column13: The invention discloses a bacteriostatic material with a controlled release effect, and a preparation method and an application of the bacteriostatic material. The bacteriostatic material is prepared by taking chitosan as a raw material, modifying and grafting salicylic acid, and then compounding nano zinc oxide, wherein the chitosan and salicylic acid have bacteriostasis; and a grafted product is an excellent controlled release carrier. After nano zinc oxide is compounded, the bacteriostatic material has good bacteriostasis capacity; and after the bacteriostatic material is applied, the bacteriostatic material can slowly release salicylic acid and nano zinc oxide in a long-acting manner, and can exert long-acting bacteriostasis. The prepared bacteriostatic material has long controlled release performance, and can exert the long-acting bacteriostasis; and a utilization ratio of the bacteriostatic material is increased. The prepared bacteriostatic material is wide in application scope, can be used for germ inhibition of fruits, vegetables or crops, and can also be used for bacteriostasis of environments, human bodies, other animals and the like. The prepared bacteriostatic material is modified by taking a natural material as a matrix, is easy to obtain, simple to prepare and cheap, and facilitates mass production and application.

column12: Preparation method of injectable chitosan grafted cyclodextrin compound drug-carrying hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of injectable chitosan grafted cyclodextrin compound drug-carrying hydrogel. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out amination and hydroformylation on cyclodextrin, reacting by virtue of hydroformylated cyclodextrin with chitosan so as to obtain chitosan grafted cyclodextrin, soaking molecules of obtained chitosan grafted cyclodextrin into medical liquid, uniformly stirring, filtering, carrying out freeze drying so as to obtain drug-carrying chitosan grafted cyclodextrin, adding drug-carrying chitosan grafted cyclodextrin into a chitosan water solution, adding beta-sodium glycerophosphate, so as to obtain the injectable chitosan grafted cyclodextrin compound drug-carrying hydrogel. The preparation method has the beneficial effects that reaction conditions are mild, and the operation is relatively simple and convenient; the stability of a drug concentration in a gel system of the prepared hydrogel can be maintained for a long time, and a drug can be effectively and controllably released for a long time, so that the utilization rate of the drug is increased; and the preparation method has relatively wide application prospects.

column12: Preparation method of hydroxyapatite drug-carrying microsphere with multi-stage sustained-controlled release effect

column12: Two-Stage Microparticle-Based Therapeutic Delivery System and Method
column13: A system for delivery of a therapeutic agent to a site in mucosal tissue is provided. The system includes a porous, mucoadhesive polymeric matrix having a first and a second opposed surfaces. The matrix is formed by a composition including chitosan, a hydration promoter, a microparticle adhesion inhibitor, and a microparticle aggregation inhibitor. A plurality of microparticles are embedded within the matrix. The microparticles contain a therapeutic agent and have a coating around the therapeutic agent. The first surface of the matrix is configured to be attached to the site in the mucosal tissue and the matrix is configured to provide controlled release of the microparticles through the first surface. The coating of the microparticles includes chitosan so as to provide controlled release of the agent from the microparticles.

column12: Miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel and a preparation method thereof. The miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel comprises miconazole nitrate, chitosan, polycarbophil, glycerin, glyceryl behenate, sodium benzoate, triethanolamine, an acetic acid solution with a mass fraction of 2% and injection water. The method comprises the following steps: preparation of a chitosan-acetic acid sohution; preparation of a polymer phase; preparation of an oil phase; preparation of a water phase; and preparation of a sustained-release capsule. According to the invention, good linear relation is obtained in a range of 0.050 to 0.80 mg/ml; an average recovery rate is 97.91% (wherein RSD is equal to 0.24%); within-day and day-to-day precision tests are carried out, and test results show that within-day precision and day-to-day precision are good; the prepared miconazole nitrate-chitosan sustained-release vaginal gel has accumulative release rates of 35.54%, 56.02% and 93.92% in 1 h, 2 h and 12 h, respecitively; and clinical data shows that the sustained-release vaginal gel has an effective rate of 95.83% in treatment of monilial vaginitis.

column12: Disinfectant for aquatic product and preparation method of disinfectant
column13: The invention belongs to the field of veterinary drug preparations and particularly relates to a disinfectant for an aquatic product and a preparation method of the disinfectant. The disinfectant for the aquatic product contains the main active ingredients: glutaraldehyde and benzalkonium bromide, wherein glutaraldehyde is an aldehyde disinfectant and is capable of killing a bacterial reproductive body, spores, fungi and viruses; benzalkonium bromide is a double-long-chain cationic surfactant, and quaternary ammonium cations of the benzalkonium bromide are capable of actively attracting bacteria and viruses with negative charges, covering the surfaces and inhibiting bacterial metabolism to cause a permeability change of a film; benzalkonium bromide and glutaraldehyde are combined for achieve the synergistic effect; glutaraldehyde and benzalkonium bromide are uniformly distributed in vegetable gelatin, are more stable and do not easily generate low-temperature crystal; nano-particles with excellent dispersity are prepared from a gel through a high pressure homogenizer, so that the drug release surface area is increased; and chitosan and sodium alginate are not included in the nano-particles, and have the effect of controlled release, and the anti-virus effect is prolonged. The preparation method of the disinfectant for the aquatic product is simple in operation and suitable for industrial production.

column12: Preparation method of cyclodextrin-polymer drug-loaded vesicle
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a cyclodextrin-polymer drug-loaded vesicle. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adopting chitosan-grafted cyclodextrin polymer and benzimidazole polycaprolactone as materials, respectively dissolving CS-g-CD and BM-PCL in a solvent to prepare a solution; adding drugs into the BM-PCL solution obtained in step 1), stirring and dissolving, then dripping the obtained BM-PCL solution into CS-g-CD solution under the stirring condition and at a speed of 1-2 drops/s, continuing to stir after the dripping is finished, carrying out distilled-water dialysis, and thus obtaining polymer drug-loaded vesicle. The preparation method has the advantages that the prepared polymer vesicle has strong drug-loading capability for hydrophilic and hydrophobic drugs and can realize high-efficiency loading and controlled release of the drugs; and the polymer vesicle has a hollow structure and is 100-200nm in particle size, and the size of the vesicle can be adjusted according to the proportion of two polymers, namely CS-g-CD and BM-PCL.

column12: Humic acid capsule structure nutritional anti-freezing multi-element sustained-release microelement fertilizer and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a humic acid capsule structure nutritional anti-freezing multi-element sustained-release microelement fertilizer and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan into a glacial acetic acid aqueous solution to prepare chitosan aqueous solution, sieving potassium humate, uniformly mixing the potassium humate and chitosan aqueous solution, adding urea, adjusting an acid-alkaline value and temperature, adding microbial flora, then adding a trace element solution, stirring, curing, emulsifying, reacting, washing, and drying to obtain the anti-freezing organic fertilizer containing macro and trace nutritional substances for the growth of plants. By sufficiently utilizing the chitosan cold-resistant and stress-resistant water-retaining and moisturizing performance of the chitosan, the nutritional fertilizer for crops in winter can be prepared; the humic acid is used as a preparation base material, the soil structure is improved, the netted structure and the sustained-release capacity are sufficiently played, and the internal nutritional substances can be gradually released; and by adding the microbial flora, the resource waste is reduced, and the consumption of the chemical fertilizer is reduced. The resource waste and environmental pollution caused by the traditional fertilizer can be reduced, and the environmental benefit and social benefit are good.

column12: Acid soil modifying agent
column13: The invention relates to an acid soil modifying agent. The modifying agent is prepared from plant ash, gypsum, laminaria residues, chitosan and sludge activated carbon by the following steps: putting the plant ash, gypsum, laminaria residues, chitosan and sludge activated carbon into a stirrer according to a certain proportion; adding a proper amount of water into the stirrer, stirring for 10-12 hours, and drying to obtain a mixture; and performing ball milling on the mixture for 2-3 hours through a ball mill to obtain the modifying agent. According to the acid soil modifying agent, the plant ash can react with acid soil to reduce the acidity of soil; after the plant ash and slurry activated carbon are mixed, the plant ash is adsorbed into pores of slurry activated carbon, and the plant ash can only permeate to the outside from the pores of the slurry activated carbon gradually, so that the slurry activated carbon has a sustained-release effect for the plant ash. Furthermore, the slurry activated carbon can be used for adsorbing heavy metal ions in the soil, so that the concentration of heavy metal ions in the soil can be reduced.

column12: Treatment of fragile X syndrome using glycyl-L-2-methylprolyl-L-glutamate
column13: This invention provides compounds, compositions and methods for treating Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) using glycyl-2-methylprolyl-glutamic acid (G-2-MePE) and analogs thereof. Autism Spectrum Disorders include Autism, Autistic Disorder Asperger Syndrome, Childhood Disintegrative Disorder, Pervasive Developmental Disorder—Not Otherwise Specified (PDD-NOS), Fragile X Syndrome, and Rett Syndrome. Compositions containing compounds include water-soluble formulations, water-in-oil micro-emulsions, water-in-oil coarse emulsions, water-in-oil liquid crystals, nanocapsules, tablets, and orally administered gels. The compounds and compositions of this invention can be administered intravenously, intraventricularly, parenterally, or orally, and can be effective in treating neurodegeneration, promoting neurological function, treating seizure activity and other symptoms of ASD, and can prolong life in animals including human beings having Autism Spectrum Disorders.

column12: Chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine. The preparation method of the microcapsule is characterized by comprising the following steps: at first, using a combined technology of ultrasonic extraction and microwave extraction and trichloromethane extraction to extract and separate matrine; then carrying out crosslinking and grafting between chitosan and lactic acid to obtain chitosan grafted polylactic acid; and finally preparing the sustained-release microcapsule by taking the chitosan grafted polylactic acid as the coating carrier. The provided chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine has the advantages that the technology is simple, the coating rate is high; the raw materials are all derived from plants, the microcapsule is safe and environment-friendly therefore; and the effect on killing mosquitoes and insects is good.

column12: Bioglass dressing used for promoting healing of cervix uteri wound and drug delivery device
column13: The invention discloses a bioglass dressing used for promoting the healing of the cervix uteri wound and a drug delivery device. For the bioglass dressing and the drug delivery device, the bioglass dressing comprises 45-70 % of an A component and 30-55 % of a B component, wherein the A component contains 3-20 % of bioactive glass (actimins), 55-70 % of medical liquid paraffin, and 3-10 % of polyethylene glycol; the B component contains 0.3-15 % of carboxymethyl chitosan, 0.05-3 % of sodium hyaluronate, 0.001-0.005 % of nano-silver ions, 60-80 % of purified water, and 5-15 % of polyving akohol. The A component and the B component are subjected to vacuum mixing under a specific condition to form gel, after the steps of high-temperature sterilization, disinfection and the like, the drug delivery device for the cervix uteri wound of the department of gynecology is well designed, and specifically, the gel is subjected to sterile filling; the bioactive glass is mixed with the functional components including silver ions, chitosan and the like, the scheme is applied to the medical apparatus for realizing drug delivery to the cervix uteri wound, through the manner of gel, the drug delivery is mild, the curative effects are obvious, the wound can be well covered, and the clinical problems that the powder delivery in the cavity is difficult and the powder has large irritation are solved.

column12: Oral film containing opiate enteric-release beads
column13: A control release and abuse-resistant opiate drug delivery oral wafer or edible oral film dosage to treat pain and substance abuse is provided. column12: POLYMER-BASED THERAPEUTICS FOR INDUCTIVE BROWNING OF FAT
column13: This disclosure features the methods and compositions involving development of novel polymer-based therapeutics that induce browning of white adipocytes for the treatment of obesity and its associated metabolic diseases. column12: COMPOSITIONS FOR DETERRING ABUSE OF PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS AND ALCOHOL
column13: The invention enables the formation of prescription drugs less likely to be abused. Different approaches are employed that can potentially deter abuse by reducing the efficacy of main processes utilized by abusers to speed drug absorption and enhance its effect. Pharmaceutical compositions of the invention incorporate one or more of the following elements: super water-absorbency, alcohol absorption, organic binding agents, inorganic binding agents, adsorption, and tough platforms. These compositions function by preventing the isolation and concentration of drug constituents for misuse and/or preventing excessive intake. Thus, the invention encompasses various compositions and methods for reducing abuse of pharmaceutical products and alcohol.

column12: Efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer capable of promoting growth and development of cotton plants and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer capable of promoting growth and development of cotton plants. The efficient magnetic slow controlled-release fertilizer comprises the following components: a shrimp shell meal biomass fuel, iron tailing mineral sand, Fe3O4 iron ore concentrate powder, mesoporous phosphopeptide, seaweed residues, citric acid residues, coconut meal, rubber seed meal, sodium bicarbonate, beer yeast, sodium alginate, vitamin C phosphate, phytase, tryptophan, lysine sodium, calcium citrate, methylcellulose, chitosan sodium polyacrylate hydrogel, nano magnetic liquid and the like. A coating material with effects of magnetic slow release and release promotion is adopted to wrap a fermented granular fertilizer, which is prepared from the seaweed residues, the citric acid residues, the coconut meal and the rubber seed meal in combination with a nutrient solution, so as to prepare a magnetic slow-release fertilizer. The fertilizer is rich in nutrient, and meanwhile, by virtue of a magnetic adsorption effect, the fertilizer effectively improves the dry matter quantity and the biomass of stems and roots of the cotton plants, obviously improves the plant height, increases the numbers of branches, flowers and cotton bolls of a single plant, and also increases the concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in cotton tissues at the same time.

column12: GSH (glutathione) responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a GSH (glutathione) responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation and a preparation method and application thereof. A controlled-release effective component of the pesticide formulation is a disulfide bond cross-linked carboxymethyl chitosan derivative, and the GSH responsive controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation is obtained through simultaneously dispersing the derivative and a pesticide into water, and performing ultrasonic oxidation on a sulfhydryl group. The preparation method of the pesticide formulation comprises preparation of a carboxymethyl chitosan aqueous solution, preparation of a 11-sulfhydryl undecanoic acid organic solution activated by EDC HCl and NHS, preparation of a sulfhydryl carboxymethyl chitosan derivative and preparation of the GSH responsive disulfide bond cross-linked controlled-release nano-pesticide formulation. The pesticide formulation provided by the invention can act on the surface of a plant of agriculture and forestry or in soil through spraying or sprinkling, and a pesticide is hardly released before the nano-pesticide formulation reaches a target plant or ethers into a pest; after reaching the target plant or entering into the pest, the nano-pesticide formulation responses to intracellular GSH irritation to release the pesticide.

column12: Polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel and a preparation method thereof and mainly relates to the field of high polymer materials. According to the method, chitosan and polyacrylic acid are dissolved in solvents containing KOH, LiOH*H2O and CO(NH2)2, and a chitosan solution and a polyacrylic acid solution are obtained; the two solutions are blended, a certain amount of epichlorohydrin is added, the mixture is stirred for certain time and subjected to centrifugal defoaming, a product is sucked into an injector for consolidation forming, and the polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel taking chitosan and polyacrylic acid as raw materials is prepared. The polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel has a certain swelling rate and has the highest swelling rate, the largest pH value and the highest salt sensitivity and also the highest responsiveness to a physiological solution on the whole when the ratio of the chitosan solution to the polyacrylic acid solution is 6:4. Therefore, the polyelectrolyte compound hydrogel is expected to be widely applied in the fields such as agriculture, food, tissue engineering, controlled release and the like.

column12: Fucose-containing bacterial biopolymer
column13: The presently disclosed subject matter concerns a microbial biopolymer comprising fucose in its composition. This biopolymer consists of a polysaccharide comprising fucose, which represents at least 10% of its composition. This fucose-containing polysaccharide also contains non-sugar components, namely, acyl group substituents. This disclosed subject matter also concerns the process for the production of the biopolymer, which is obtained cultivation of the bacterium Enterobacter A47 (DSM 23139), using glycerol or glycerol-rich mixtures as carbon sources. The fucose-containing biopolymer of the presently disclosed subject matter may be used in several industrial applications (e.g. pharmaceutical, cosmetics and agro-food industries) and in the treatment of industrial wastes (e.g. oil and metal recovery).

column12: Fluoropolymer Emulsions with Perhalogenated Stabilizer for the Delivery of Hydrophobic Drugs
column13: The present invention provides therapeutic formulations, including therapeutic nanoemulsions, and related methods for the in vivo delivery of hydrophobic compounds, including an important class of hydrophobic anesthetics. Formulations and methods of the invention include semifluorinated block copolymers and perhalogenated fluorous compounds, such as perfluorooctyl bromide or perfluorodecalin, capable of forming a stable nanoemulsion without the need of conventional lipid components that support bacterial and/or fungal growth (e.g., soybean oil and similar lipids). In certain embodiments, emulsion-based formulations are provided that are capable of formulating, delivering and releasing amounts of hydrophobic drugs effective for a range of clinical applications, including inducing and maintaining anesthesia in patients. In certain embodiments, emulsion-based formulations are provided that are capable of supporting controlled release, for example, over a range of rates useful for clinical applications including rapid and sustained release.

column12: Hydrogel complex based on hyaluronic acid and method for controlling phase transition and color of hydrogel using the hydrogel complex
column13: The present invention relates to a hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel composite, and to a method for adjusting color and phase transition of hydrogel by using the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to a hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel composite capable of changing color and performing phase transition according to surrounding pH conditions and to a method for changing color and transiting a phase of hydrogel by using the same, wherein the hydrogel composite includes catechol-substituted hyaluronic acid and Fe^3+ ions. According to the present invention, since the hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel composite exists in different phases in various pH regions, the hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel composite can be usefully applied to organism environments. Moreover, compared to the gelation of conventional chitosan, phase transition is possible through the substitution of a remarkably small quantity of catechol. Furthermore, a hydrogel composite accompanying a change in color according to the surrounding environment can be provided. The present invention can be widely applied to various bio fields such as regenerative medicine, tissue engineering, stem cell culturing and differentiation, and drug carriers.

column12: Nonviral targeted nanoparticle system for gene transfer and drug delivery
column13: The embodiments herein provide a nanoparticle system for targeted gene delivery or a drug delivery and a method of synthesizing the same. The nanoparticle composition for targeted gene transfer and drug delivery comprises a protein, a chitosan and a lipid. A method of synthesizing the nanoparticles involves preparing a gelatine and chitosan gel. A milky colloid solution is prepared with the gelatine, chitosan solution and a phosphatidylcholine. The milky colloid is homogenized for the self assembly of the nanoparticles. The milky colloid is subjected to high speed and high pressure homogenizer. The CHO cells are transfected with nanoparticles and lipofectamine 2000 for comparing the transfection efficiency. The nanoparticles deliver DNA, RNA, ribozyme and nucleotide sequences. The nanoparticles deliver lipophylic and hydrophilic drugs. The transfection efficiency of gene and drug is higher when the target cells are transferred with nanoparticles, compared to the cells transferred with lipofectamine 2000.

column12: Efficient magnetic slow controlled release fertilizer capable of promoting wheat photosynthesis and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an efficient magnetic slow controlled release fertilizer capable of promoting the wheat photosynthesis. The fertilizer is prepared from loofah-sponge-based biomass fuel, a polymer magnetic material, desulfurated magnesium slag, mesoporous lithium iron phosphate, kieselguhr, rhizoma fagopyri dibotryis stem leaf powder, spiral seaweed powder, schizochytrium aggregatum powder, a bacillus subtilis culture, enzyme microorganism, choline chloride, multivitamins, ovolecithin, lysine, methionine, bile acid, chitosan oligosaccharide, glutathione, calcium gluconate, zanthoxylum oil, phosphogypsum, humic acid, konjac glucomannan, amino acid cross-linked aldehyde glucan hydrogel, nanometer magnetic fluid and the like. column12: Degradable polymer core-shell microsphere loaded with protein drugs
column13: The invention provides a degradable polymer core-shell microsphere loaded with protein drugs. The core structure of the microsphere is a chemical crosslinked gel core formed by mixing and electronic injection of a hyaluronic acid derivate and a hydroxyethyl chitosan solution, and a shell is made from lactic acid-glycollic acid copolymer, or polycaprolactone or polylactic acid and used for embedding protein and polypeptide drugs, and includes bovine serum albumin, or interferon or cytochrome C. The microsphere of a dual-layer structure has the degradable polymer shell, combines the comprehensive advantages of gel pack drug microspheres and degradable polymer microspheres, and is a gel microsphere preparation which is high in drug loading amount and encapsulation efficiency and good in drug release performance. The obtained core-shell microsphere serves as a interferon long-acting controlled release preparation, has the outstanding advantages of being formed through one step, low in cost and good in drug embedding comprehensive effect, and is large in application potential.

column12: Manufacturing method of degradable medical shell fabric

column12: Ferroferric oxide/chitosan/indocyanine green composite particles and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to ferroferric oxide/chitosan/indocyanine green composite particles and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite particles are indocyanine-green-supported Fe3O4@chitosan core-shell structured nanoparticles, wherein Fe3O4 nanoparticles serve as cores, chitosan serves as shells, and indocyanine green is supported on the outer surface of the chitosan. The preparation method includes preparing the Fe3O4@chitosan core-shell structured nanoparticles through a one-step heat reduction method; dispersing the prepared Fe3O4@chitosan core-shell structured nanoparticles into a water solution of the indocyanine green, disposing the mixture at a room temperature, stirring away from light, centrifuging, washing and taking lower-layer solids into deionized water so as to obtain the ferroferric oxide/chitosan/indocyanine green composite particles. Compared with the prior art, the ferroferric oxide/chitosan/indocyanine green composite particles have the advantage that the ferroferric oxide/chitosan/indocyanine green composite particles can be used as an infrared photo-thermal therapeutic agent, a drug carrier, a nuclear magnetic resonance imaging contrast agent or a fluorescence imaging contrast agent. The preparation method has the advantages of simple technological steps, good controllability, low economic cost and suitability for large-scale production.

column12: Drug-loaded composite nanofiber membrane used for drug release, and making method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a drug-loaded composite nanofiber membrane used for drug release, and a making method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing polyamide and chitosan, dissolving the obtained mixture in formic acid to obtain a mixed solution, adding a drug to the mixed solution, stirring the drug and the mixed solution to accelerate dissolution in order to obtain a uniform and transparent spinning stock solution, and carrying out an electrostatic spinning technology to obtain the drug-loaded chitosan/polyamide composite nanofiber membrane. The produced nano-fiber membrane adopts polyamide as a main body, chitosan is added to realize a good blending effect, and drug release is regulated through swelling and degradation of chitosan, so the characteristics of good mechanical performance and the chemical stability of the polyamide and the antibacterial and anti-inflammatory property, the degradability and the good biocompatibility of the chitosan are fully shown. The drug-loaded composite nanofiber membrane has a good drug release effect and a high drug accumulative release rate as a novel composite drug slow release carrier material, and can be used in the biomedical fields of wound restoration, oral ulcer treatment and drug controlled release.

column12: Preparation method of sustained-release traditional Chinese medicine wine soaking medicine package for preventing cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a sustained-release traditional Chinese medicine wine soaking medicine package for preventing cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases and belongs to the technical field of nutrition and health care. Mulberry fruits used as raw materials are crushed, pulped, and subjected to extraction with the assistance of ultrasound by taking an ethanol solution as an extracting solution and adding cellulase; then centrifugal separation is carried out, supernatant liquid is collected, sediment is subjected to soaking extracting again, and extracts are mixed and concentrated; afterwards, by means of a high intensity pulsed electric field, irreversible damage to tissue cells is caused according to the cell membrane electroporation principle, thus, dissolving-out of mulberry anthocyanin is facilitated, the dissolving-out amount of the mulberry anthocyanin of the extracts is increased, and a secondary mulberry anthocyanin extract is prepared; and finally, a composite film made of chitosan and bacterial cellulose is loaded with the secondary mulberry anthocyanin extract and then wraps traditional Chinese medicines such as dry fructus lycii, red dates, radix salviae miltiorrhizae and radix notoginseng. The sustained-release traditional Chinese medicine wine soaking medicine package is slowly released into liquor drinks, can effectively prevent and restrain cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, and plays an important role in improving the organism immunity of humans.

column12: Gellan gum spongy-like hydrogel, its preparation and biomedical applications thereof
column13: The present application discloses cell-adhesive gellan gum spongy-like hydrogels that are able to entrap/encapsulate adherent cells, which spread within the material, maintaining their phenotype and remaining viable and proliferative. The methodology used to obtain these materials involves hydrogel preparation, freezing, freeze-drying and re-hydration with a saline solution with cells and with/without bioactive molecules. No pre and/or post functionalization of the spongy-like hydrogels with cell adhesive features, as used for other hydrogels, is used. The cell adhesive character of these materials, not observed in hydrogels, is in part explained by their physical properties, between sponges and hydrogels, dissimilar from the precursor hydrogels. The physical properties that are mainly different are the morphology, microstructure, water content, and mechanical performance. Gellan gum spongy-like hydrogels physical properties and biological performance can be tuned by manipulating the parameters involved in spongy-like hydrogel formation. Bioactive molecules can also be entrapped with or without cells to modify the biological performance of the spongy-like hydrogels. These materials can be applied in the context of bioengineering, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine and biomedical applications.

The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding nZnO to a water solution of carboxymethyl chitosan, conducting ultrasonic oscillation so that the nZnO is uniformly dispersed, and conducting standing by so as to obtain a mixed suspension of the carboxymethyl chitosan and the nZnO; and spray-drying the suspension by virtue of a spray-dryer, so that the carboxymethyl chitosan/nano zinc oxide composite microsphere is obtained. The carboxymethyl chitosan/nano zinc oxide composite microsphere provided by the invention is small in grain size and obvious in antibacterial activity, and an antibacterial rate on staphylococcus aureus and escherichia coli reaches 80% or above; and the carboxymethyl chitosan/nano zinc oxide composite microsphere is low in biotoxicity, and the survival rate of NIH-3T3 cells within 24h is higher than 90% when the concentration of the composite microsphere is less than or equal to 125mg/mL; therefore, the carboxymethyl chitosan/nano zinc oxide composite microsphere can be applied to wound repair materials, food/drug packaging materials and drug carrier materials.

column12: Biocompatible cross-linking micro-nano material for drug encapsulation and sustained release and preparation technology of biocompatible cross-linking micro-nano material for drug encapsulation and sustained release

column12: Preparation method of clindamycin loaded chitosan sustained-release microspheres
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of clindamycin loaded chitosan sustained-release microspheres. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dissolving clindamycin hydrochloride in a 0.9% sodium chloride water solution, and adding medical chitosan to obtain a water phase; (2) taking Tween 80, adding liquid paraffin, and stirring in a reaction bulb while heating to obtain an oil phase; and (3) adding the water phase prepared in the step (1) into the oil phase prepared in the step (2), adding 25% glutaric dialdehyde, reacting, sequentially washing respectively with petroleum ether and anhydrous acetone five times, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the clindamycin loaded chitosan sustained-release microspheres. The clindamycin loaded chitosan sustained-release microspheres prepared by the emulsifying crosslinking process have the advantages of favorable sphericity and favorable dispersity. The drug-loaded sustained-release microspheres have favorable sustained-release effects, and still have obvious bacteriostatic actions three days after drug release.

column12: Chitosan-grafted resistant starch carrier material and its preparation method and use
column13: The invention discloses a chitosan-grafted resistant starch carrier material and its preparation method and use. The preparation method comprises dissolving acetate resistant starch with a substitution degree of 0.1-3.0 in an organic solvent at a temperature of 40-60 DEG C for 20-40min, adding chitosan in the solution along with stirring, orderly adding an initiator, an activator and a cross-linking agent into the mixed solution, carrying out a kneading reaction process at a temperature of 40-80 DEG C for 15-50min, cooling the products, depositing the products through ethanol and carrying out drying to obtain the chitosan-grafted resistant starch carrier material. Through appropriate control of carrier material coating thickness, an accumulative releasing rate of a functional factor in an upper digestive tract is less than or equal to 30% and a releasing rate of the functional factor in a simulative colon environment is 50% or more. The chitosan-grafted resistant starch carrier material realizes storage stability of the functional factor in a liquid food system and colon targeting controlled-release characteristics of the functional factor in the human digestive tract environment.

column12: Tannin-chitosan composites
column13: The invention provides a composition comprising a matrix of chitosan and a tannin wherein the chitosan is electrostatically bonded to the tannin to form a chitosan-tannin composite material. column12: Preparation method of slow controlled release fertilizer for flowering peach
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a slow controlled release fertilizer for flowering peach. The method includes the steps of adding urea, sodium citrate and humic acid to water, adjusting pH to 8.0-9.0, adding a formaldehyde solution, adding oxidized starch and hydrogenated vegetable oil, adjusting pH to 4.0-5.0, adjusting pH to 6.0-7.0 to obtain a mixture A, adding sodium alginate and gelatin to water, adding potassium nitrate, diammonium hydrogen phosphate, magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, vitamin B, nicotinamide, amino acid, corn flour, chitosan and lecithin to be mixed to obtain a mixture B, adding the mixture B to the mixture A to be dispersed, adding glutaraldehyde, raising the temperature to 45-55 DEG C, keeping the temperature for 2-4 h, lowering the temperature to 0-5 DEG C, and conducting filtering to obtain the slow controlled release fertilizer. The slow controlled release fertilizer can effectively increase the flowering number of flowering peach, is small in consumption, saves fertilizer applying cost, and improves the ornamental economic benefits of flowering peach.

column12: Preparation method of chitosan-based composite nanoparticles for enzyme touch response controlled release doxorubicin hydrochloride
column13: The invention discloses a preparation technology of nanoparticles for delivering hydrophilic antitumor drugs, namely, a preparation method of chitosan-based composite nanoparticles for enzyme touch response controlled release doxorubicin hydrochloride. The method comprises the steps of firstly, mixing a chitosan-quercetin succinate-6-phosphogluconate solution and a doxorubicin hydrochloride solution, then carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the mixed solution, and dripping carboxymethyl chitosan into the mixed solution for carrying out polymer agglomeration to obtain chitosan-quercetin succinate-6-gphosphogluconate carboxymethyl chitosan composite nanoparticles for encapsulating doxorubicin hydrochloride, wherein the average particle size of the formed composite nanoparticles is 114-515nm, the electric potential of Zeta is -27.4 to -7.9mV, and the encapsulation efficiency and the entrapment efficiency for the doxorubicin hydrochloride are respectively 71.45-93.32% and 14.1-20.2%. The product is capable of effectively reducing the cytotoxicity of the doxorubicin hydrochloride and increasing the cancer inhibition efficiency of the doxorubicin hydrochloride, remarkably improves the use safety and convenience of the doxorubicin hydrochloride, can be used as a medical biomaterial and a drug carrier, and has good research, development and application prospects.

column12: Aquaculture nutrition sustained release agent and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an aquaculture nutrition sustained release agent and a preparation method thereof. The problems of decrease of existing seawater pH values and culture environment deterioration are mainly to be solved. The preparation method includes subjecting oyster shells or/and scallop shells to cleaning pretreatment, crushing, calcinating, cooling, grinding to obtain activated shell powder, selecting the shell powder, adding magnesium oxide, trace elements, sodium alginate, chitosan, adhesives and an appropriate quantity of water into the shell powder, mixing evenly, forming, drying and sorting to obtain different grades of aquaculture nutrition sustained release agents. The aquaculture nutrition sustained release agent is capable of increasing seawater carbonate saturability effectively, increasing the shell calcification rate remarkably, improving fatness of the shells and culture water quality, promoting shell growth and increasing a water body pH value and the culture organism survival rate. The preparation method is reasonable in preparation technology, feasible to operate and easy to achieve large-scale production.

column12: DERIVATIVES OF SULFATED POLYSACCHARIDES, METHOD OF PREPARATION, MODIFICATION AND USE THEREOF
column13: The invention relates to the preparation and the use of α,β-unsaturated aldehydes in the structure of sulfated polysaccharides. It concerns the derivatives with a conjugated double bond in the 4th and 5th positions of the galactopyranose part situated in the 6th position with respect to the aldehyde, according to the general structural formula (I) or its hydrated form according to the general structural formula (II). The preparation of these derivatives derives from sulfated polysaccharides containing a galactopyranose ring sulfated in the 4th position that is bound in the polymer chain via α(1→3) or β(1→3) O-glycosidic bond. In the described solution, the sulfated polysaccharides undergo a regio- and chemoselective oxidation to form C6-saturated aldehyde, which, via a direct elimination of the sulfate group, provides the α,β- unsaturated derivative according to the general formula (I) or (II). The described solution is technically advantageous, because it leads directly to α,β-unsaturated aldehydes, without any elimination agents, higher temperature, or isolation of intermediates during the synthesis. The conjugation in the structure of α,β-unsaturated aldehyde allows, under physiological conditions, to bind a wide variety of biocompatible amines in the structure of the sulfated polysaccharides. The proposed method allows to prepare materials suitable for pH-responsive drug delivery systems, or for the preparation of scaffolds in tissue engineering or regenerative medicine. column12: Hydroxyethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid dual-network hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a hydroxyethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid dual-network hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: separately modifying hydroxyethyl chitosan and hyaluronic acid by using glycidyl methacrylate so as to obtain hydroxyethyl chitosan-grafted glycidyl methacrylate and hyaluronic acid-grafted glycidyl methacrylate; subjecting hydroxyethyl chitosan-grafted glycidyl methacrylate to photochemical polymerization so as to obtain a first network hydroxyethyl chitosan hydrogel; subjecting the first network hydroxyethyl chitosan hydrogel to freeze-drying and then to impregnation in an aqueous solution of hyaluronic acid-grafted glycidyl methacrylate and a photoinitiator and carrying out photochemical polymerization so as to obtain a second network hydroxyethyl chitosan hydrogel, thereby obtaining the hydroxyethyl chitosan/hyaluronic acid dual-network hydrogel. The hydrogel has adjustable mechanical and swelling performance; and hydrogel is fast in formation speed, simple in process and good in structural stability and can be used for construction of an in-vitro 3D tumor model, drug delivery, tissue regeneration, etc.

column12: Enhanced targeted drug delivery system via chitosan hydrogel and chlorotoxin
column13: Specific drug delivery to tumor cells without affecting normal cells is a major challenge in cancer treatment. The present invention incorporates embedding nonionic surfactant vesicles (niosomes) containing an anti-cancer therapeutic agent with chlorotoxin into a thermosensitive chitosan hydrogel network. Chitosan has mucoadhesive property which can be used in the targeting of the tumor cells with the mucin over expression. Chlorotoxin is a 36 amino acid peptide obtained from Leiurus quinquestriatus scorpion venom which binds preferentially to tumor cells of neuroectodermal origin but not to normal cells. The incorporation of chlorotoxin along with niosomes in the chitosan hydrogel is used as the second targeting strategy to further improve the specific delivery of drugs to tumor cells such as glioma.

column12: CHITOSAN NANOFIBRES CONTAINING BIOACTIVE COMPOUNDS
column13: The invention relates to self-assembled nanofibres of chitosan and bioactive compounds, which can be used as nutraceuticals or drugs. The bioactive compounds suitable for the nanofibres of the invention are molecules of a low molecular size with acid or lactone groups, aromatic rings and hydroxyls, such as small polyphenols and mixtures thereof. The nanofibres of the invention are absorbed, without degradation, at the level of the small intestine, containing and protecting the bioactive compounds until they reach the various target organs. The nanofibres also cross the blood-brain barrier, allowing the compounds to reach the brain where they act as a controlled release system. If the bioactive compounds are neuroprotectors, such as antioxidants, the nanofibres of the invention can be used to treat or prevent neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), as well as she strokes and other diseases related to aging or associated with oxidative stress. The invention also relates to the method for obtaining the nanofibres, which comprises mixing chitosan with the bioactive compounds and allowing self-assembly. The invention further relates to the dosage form containing the nanofibres of the invention, particularly for oral administration, such as tablets, coated tablets, powders, capsules, syrups, or others.

column12: Preparation method of nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere. The nano-hydroxyapatite chitosan composite microsphere is prepared from chitosan, calcium salt and phosphate by the following steps: adding the prepared phosphate/chitosan acetic acid solution into surfactant-containing liquid paraffin and stirring uniformly to form a water-in-oil emulsion; adding a cross-linking agent dropwise to perform cross linking; adding an alkaline solution to adjust pH, adding the calcium salt and stirring uniformly; and washing and drying to obtain the composite microsphere. column12: Chitosan materials from carbonic acid solution
column13: The present invention comprises chitosan materials and methods of using carbonic acid for aqueous solubilization of neutralized or pre-treated chitosan gels and provides, among other things, substantially acid salt free composition native final forms without requiring subsequent acid salt elution. The invention includes chitosan-based solid and semi-solid material forms, optionally reinforced with chitosan fibers, such as powders, fibers, films, matrices, sponges, implants, scaffolds, fillers, and hydrogels. Native final forms are produced from chitosan powder solubilized in an aqueous acidic solution, processed to form a high pH hydrated chitosan gel precipitate material that is then neutralized by water washing and re-solubilized substantially to chitosan solution using carbonic acid. Chitosan materials can be mixed in solution with one or more of other hydrophilic polymers to create compositional heterogeneity and pharmaceutical agents to achieve controlled release of the agent(s) from the final forms at the site of application.

column12: Vascular stent coating with drug sustained-release function and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a vascular stent coating with a drug sustained-release function, which is prepared from the following raw materials: polycaprolactone, chitosan, collagen, medicine, nano magnesium, nano titanium dioxide, dendrobium polysaccharide, tea polyphenol, dopamine, gelatin, nano zirconia, hirudin, and ethanol. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the vascular stent coating with the drug sustained-release function. The binding strength of the vascular stent coating and a substrate is 4.8 to 5.9 MPa, the binding strength of the vascular stent coating and the stent substrate is high, the degradation time of the vascular stent coating is 68 to 86 days, the vascular stent coating can be completely degraded after 90 days, the large-area shedding and swelling phenomena do not occur in the degradation process, the stability and biocompatibility are good, no cell toxicity, coagulation and thrombosis are formed, and no inflammatory response is generated.

column12: Preparation method of chitosan-polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether block copolymer polymer point with fluorescent tracing performance
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan-polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether block copolymer polymer point with fluorescent tracing performance. The preparation method is characterized by comprising the following steps of taking N-citrated chitosan-g-polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether, anhydrous citric acid and N-2-hydroxyl ethylenediamine; uniformly dispersing the substances into a mixed solution of polyethylene glycol 400 and deionized water, and reacting; dialyzing a product after reaction with water, and then drying to obtain an N-citrated chitosan-g-polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether polymer point. The chitosan polymer point prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention has the fluorescent tracing performance, is better in water solubility, is suitable for fluorescence imaging, and is particularly suitable for a drug carrier material.

column12: Coated controlled release polymer particles as efficient oral delivery vehicles for biopharmaceuticals
column13: A composition for delivering an active agent to a patient. The composition includes a polymer core encapsulating the active agent and a mucoadhesive coating disposed about the core. The polymer may include covalently linked poly(ethylene glycol) chains, and the mucoadhesive coating may be selected to facilitate transfer of the particle through the intestinal mucosa. A molecular weight and cross-link density of the polymer may be selected such that the polymer core will decompose in a predetermined time interval. The fraction of the dose of the drug entering the system at circulation during the predetermined time interval may be between about 0.25% and about 25%. The composition may be formulated as a plurality of nanoparticles or microparticles that are combined with a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier to produce an edible or inhalable drug product.

column12: GELLAN GUM SPONGY-LIKE HYDROGEL, ITS PREPARATION AND BIOMEDICAL APPLICATIONS THEREOF
column13: The present application discloses cell-adhesive gellan gum spongy-like hydrogels that are able to entrap/encapsulate adherent cells, which spread within the material, maintaining their phenotype and remaining viable and proliferative. The methodology used to obtain these materials involves hydrogel preparation, freezing, freeze-drying and re-hydration with a saline solution with cells and with/without bioactive molecules. No pre and/or post functionalization of the spongy-like hydrogels with cell adhesive features, as used for other hydrogels, is used. The cell adhesive character of these materials, not observed in hydrogels, is in part explained by their physical properties, between sponges and hydrogels, dissimilar from the precursor hydrogels. The physical properties that are mainly different are the morphology, microstructure, water content, and mechanical performance. Gellan gum spongy-like hydrogels physical properties and biological performance can be tuned by manipulating the parameters involved in spongy-like hydrogel formation. Bioactive molecules can also be entrapped with or without cells to modify the biological performance of the spongy-like hydrogels. These materials can be applied in the context of bioengineering, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine and biomedical applications.

column12: Azoxystrobin microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides azoxystrobin microsphere and preparation method thereof. The azoxystrobin microsphere is composed of pesticide active component azoxystrobin and chitosan/gelatin microsphere as a drug carrier. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing a water phase; 2) preparing an oil phase; and 3) mixing the water phase in the step 1) and the oil phase in the step 2) with a certain volume ratio, continuously stirring a mixture and emulsifying the mixture, transferring all reactants to a centrifugation kettle, washing the precipitates after centrifugation by using absolute ethyl alcohol, washing by petroleum ether, and finally performing vacuum drying to constant weight to obtain the azoxystrobin microsphere. The entrapment rate of the azoxystrobin microsphere is 80% and above, and the accumulative releasing ratio of azoxystrobin in 30 days can reach 80% and above. The provided method has good control effect on a plurality of insect diseases on fruits and vegetables.

column12: Semi-interpenetrating network nano hybrid hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a semi-interpenetrating network nano hybrid hydrogel and a preparation method and an application thereof. Firstly, chitosan is modified to prepare water soluble carboxymethyl chitosan (CMCS); then N-isopropylacrylamide (NIPAM), CMCS and (carboxyl functionalized) carbon nanotubes are subjected to in-situ free radical crosslinking polymerization reaction, and the semi-interpenetrating network nano hybrid hydrogel with different composition ratios of NIPAM, CMCS and the nanotubes is obtained. The prepared novel nano hybrid hydrogel has relatively high swelling rate, appropriate volume phase transition temperature and pH phase transition point, and high drug loading amount and continuous controllable drug release behavior. The hydrogel pharmaceutical preparation can be used as a promising hydrophilic oral drug carrier, is used for targeted release of oral vaccines, polypeptides, proteins and anticancer drugs, has low toxicity, and can be used for long-term treatment of colon cancer and the like.

column12: Dehydrated hydrogel inclusion complex of a bioactive agent with flowable drug delivery system
column13: The invention provides a controlled release biodegradable polymer formulation adapted for administering bioactive agents such as therapeutic proteins to a patient through implantation of a bolus that forms a depot within the patient's body tissues. The formulation includes a dehydrated inclusion complex of the bioactive agent within a hydrogel, wherein the hydrogel can comprise a polymerized polyalkyleneglycolyl diacrylate, and, optionally, polyalkyleneglycolyl monoacrylates, including methacrylates. Alternatively, the hydrogel can comprise hyaluronic acid, chitosan, agarose, polyvinylacetate, polyvinylpyrrolide, or polyvinylalcohol nanoparticles. The bioactive agent can be a macromolecular material, such as a protein. A method of forming the inventive formulation is also provided, as well as a method for using the formulation in the treatment of a malcondition in a patient in need thereof.

column12: MANGANESE ION COATED NANOPARTICLES FOR DELIVERY OF COMPOSITIONS INTO THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM BY NASAL INSUFFLATION
column13: The compositions and methods of the disclosure particularly target the divalent metal transporter expressed on olfactory nerve terminals to transport divalent cation-coated or cation-containing nanoparticles to all regions of brain. It has been found that such divalent cation-containing nanoparticles, including those nanoparticles comprising manganese have affinity for the metal transport receptor proteins. Although this receptor has particular affinity for manganese, it is contemplated that other divalent ions, including magnesium, calcium, and the like may also be bound to such receptors leading to transport of the nanoparticles into the intracellular cytoplasm. Nanoparticles have been developed, therefore, as vehicles for parenteral delivery of genes, proteins and drugs. The present disclosure encompasses embodiments of nanoparticle-based compositions and methods for the use thereof for the delivery of genes, oligonucleotides, including but not limited to small interfering RNA, and other small molecule drugs, into the brain by nasal insufflation.

column12: MISUSE PREVENTATIVE, CONTROLLED RELEASE FORMULATION
column13: Disclosed is a misuse preventative, controlled release composition in the form of a multilayered oral dosage form. A first layer contains a plurality of controlled release microparticles having a pharmaceutically active agent (for example, an opioid analgesic) disposed therein. The second layer, which can be adjacent the first layer comprises a pharmaceutically active agent that can be the same or different from the pharmaceutically active agent in the microparticles in the first layer. The composition further comprises a superabsorbent material (for example, polycarbophil) disposed within the first layer, the second layer, or both the first layer and the second layer. When intact, the pharmaceutically active agent is released from the second layer faster than the pharmaceutically active agent in the first layer. When crushed, either intentionally or accidentally, and exposed to an aqueous medium, the superabsorbent material present swells to encapsulate the microparticles, which remain substantially intact thereby retarding the release of the pharmaceutically active agent from the composition. Also disclosed is a method of using the misuse preventative, controlled release composition to deliver at least one pharmaceutically active agent to a mammal, for example, a human, in need thereof.

column12: pH-response chitosan gene carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a pH-response chitosan gene carrier as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the method, based on chitosan oligosaccharide, pH-sensitive acylhydrazone crosslinked chitosan (HCCS) is synthesized. A covalent grafting method is used for carrying out polyethylene imine and polyethylene glycol grafting on HCCS so as to obtain a pH-sensitive HCCS-g-PEI-g-PEG polymer. The prepared HCCS-g-PEI-g-PEG polymer has the performance of stimulating response to acid environment so as to control release genes. The invention also provides application of the HCCS-g-PEI-g-PEG polymer obtained by the method as a gene carrier in gene transfection. The polymer shows good biocompatibility and high gene transfection efficiency, is a good carrier for gene transfection, and has wide application prospects.

column12: Drug delivery controlled-release system having tumor induced targeting capacity and preparation method of drug delivery controlled-release system
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and in particular relates to a drug delivery controlled-release system having a tumor induced targeting capacity and a preparation method of the drug delivery controlled-release system. The drug delivery controlled-release system has three layers of core-shell structures, wherein the inner layer is drug-loaded meso-porous silicon nanoparticles, the middle layer is folic acid modified azidation chitosan and the outer layer is polyethylene glycol. The preparation method of the drug delivery controlled-release system comprises the following steps: preparing the thiol functional meso-porous silicon nanoparticles; conducting double-sulfur functionalization; conducting alkynyl modification; removing a template; preparing the folic acid modified azidation chitosan; covering the chitosan; conducting PEG (polyethylene glycol) modification, and the like. Compared with the prior art, the drug delivery controlled-release system, which takes the chitosan as a 'valve' material, is cheap and easily available in material and is good in biocompatibility; and the PEG is grafted to the surface of CHI by virtue of a pH-sensitive imine bond, so that the drug delivery controlled-release system can become 'invisible' in normal blood circulation, and the PEG is removed and a targeting ligand, namely folic acid, is exposed on a tumor part, so that the active targeting capacity of the system on cancer cells is 'activated'.

column12: Preparation method of amycin controlled-release chitosan nano particles with pH/oxido-reduction dual response
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of amycin controlled-release chitosan nano particles with pH/oxido-reduction dual response. Thiolated chitosan, carboxymethyl chitosan, sodium tripolyphosphate, doxorubicin hydrochloride and hydrogen peroxide are taken as raw materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a thiolated chitosans solution with a doxorubicin hydrochloride solution so as to obtain a solution I; mixing a carboxymethyl chitosan solution with a sodium tripolyphosphate solution so as to obtain a mixed solution II; dropwise adding the mixed solution I into the mixed solution II while stirring, controlling the dosage of carboxymethyl chitosan and thiolated chitosan, regulating the ph value of the solution to 6-8, performing ultrasonic blending, performing ion crosslinking and polymer condensing, then dropwise adding hydrogen peroxide into the system so as to finish oxidization crosslinking, performing room-temperature stirring reaction, separating products, and drying the products to obtain the amycin controlled-release chitosan nano particles with pH/oxido-reduction dual response. The amycin controlled-release chitosan nano particles with pH/oxido-reduction dual response is capable of escaping away from tumor cell endosome/lysosome, is capable of automatically regulating and controlling to realize cytoplast release based on unique microenvironments of tumor cells, improving the amycin medicine delivery efficiency and the medical effect, and has a favorable research and development application background in multiple aspects such as medicine and medical materials.

column12: Preparation method for antibacterial nanomaterial
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method for an antibacterial nanomaterial, belonging to the technical field of material preparation. The antibacterial nanomaterial is prepared by mixing a nanomaterial and metal ions, such as Ag<+>. After a metal material is released, the antibacterial function of a material disappears, and therefore the material is ineffective; meanwhile, the release of metal ions can cause the problem of environmental pollution. According to the preparation method disclosed by the invention, bentonite which serves as a carrier medium is subjected to sodium treatment with sodium oxalate and is modified by adding N-hydroxyl succinimide as a difunctional crosslinking agent under the assistance of ultrasonic oscillation; antibacterial substances in shells of bamboo shoots are extracted and are then crosslinked with the modified bentonite to increase the antibacterial property; then, the surface of the bentonite is modified again with octadecyldimethyl benzyl ammonium chloride to increase the binding capability between the surface and chitosan. Therefore, the antibacterial material which is free of metal ions, does not require sustained release and has high antibacterial efficiency and no pollution to the environment is prepared.

column12: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ALLEVIATING JOINT PAIN
column13: A system for providing a drug-eluting resorbable hydrogel for treating chronic pain, the system including carboxymethyl chitosan and oxidized carboxymethyl cellulose solutions, which together with one or more bioactive agents, can be mixed and delivered at the time of use in order to gel in situ within a joint space. column12: Application of chitosan reduction-sensitive system as gene drug delivery carrier
column13: The invention relates to a reduction-sensitive anti-tumor chitosan derivative gene carrier, which is characterized in that a compound, which is rich in amino groups, is introduced to a chitosan skeleton by virtue of a specifically degradable truss arm which contains a disulfide bond; under the action of electrostatic adsorption, negatively charged siRNA is tightly compressed, so that nanoparticles are formed, and the nanoparticles can escape from the interior of an endosome through a proton sponge effect; and after the nanoparticles reach cytoplasm, the disulfide bond truss arm can be specifically degraded by a high-concentration reducing substance, namely glutathione, in focus cells, and the loaded siRNA is rapidly released and acts on a target, so that the silencing effect of a gene medicine is obviously improved. The adjuvant material, when applied to such administration modes as intravascular injection, intramuscular injection, external application, oral administration and the like as the gene carrier, is high in safety. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple and mature in process, and the preparation method is suitable for continuous large-scale production.

column12: Novel sustained-release oxygen fertilizer
column13: Disclosed is a novel sustained-release oxygen fertilizer with a water retention function. The novel sustained-release oxygen fertilizer with the water retention function is prepared by embedding urea and ammonium zinc phosphate into attapulgite clay to serve as a fertilizer kernel and taking cellulose acetate butyrate as an inner coating material and a CMCS-g-PAA/APT (carboxymethyl chitosan-g-polyacrylic acid/attapulgite clay) water-retaining agent as an outer coating material. Content of nitrogen (N) and content of zinc (Zn) in a fertilizer sample are 27.1% and 0.72% respectively. The novel sustained-release oxygen fertilizer with the water retention function has the advantages that during preparation of a water-retaining agent material, modified natural polymer carboxymethyl chitosan and a degradable cross-linking agent N-maleoyl chitosan are introduced, so that degradability of the outer coating material can be improved remarkably, and secondary pollution of outer coating material residues in soil to the environment is avoided while water retention capacity of the soil is improved.

column12: Composition, preparation, and use of chitosan shards for biomedical applications
column13: A thin chitosan-based material can be used for biomedical applications. The chitosan has been treated in a nitrogen field by applying energy to ionize nitrogen in and around the chitosan material. A single or multiple such treatments may be employed. For example, the chitosan material may be irradiated under nitrogen using γ-irradiation, treated under a nitrogen plasma, or both. A thin chitosan material can be readily treated by surface modifying treatments such as irradiating under nitrogen using γ-irradiation, treating under a nitrogen plasma, or both.

column12: Selenium-supported chitosan microsphere controllably sustained-releasing selenium negative ions and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a selenium-supported chitosan microsphere controllably sustained-releasing selenium negative ions and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method includes the following steps: 1) dissolving Na2SeO3 in acetic acid solution to prepare a selenium acetic acid solution; 2) adding chitosan to prepare a water-phase matrix; 3) weighing span-80 and adding the span-80 to liquid paraffin to prepare an oil-phase matrix; 4) slowly adding dropwisely the water-phase matrix to the oil-phase matrix with stirring, slowly adding dropwisely a crosslinker, continuously stirring the mixture, allowing the mixture to stand for layering, removing the upper-layer liquid phase and collecting a precipitate; and 5) performing suction filtration and washing respectively with petroleum ether and anhydrous alcohol until the filtrate is clear, adding dropwisely acetone, and drying the filtrate in a drying box at 45 DEG C. The selenium-supported chitosan microsphere has good spherical degree, is 27.54-75.82% in encapsulation rate, is 1.45-9.01% in drug carrying quantity, is 50-600 [mu]m in particle size and can reach 116 days in effective sustained-releasing time, so that selenium supplement quantity is controllable. In the invention, a sustained-releasing system is established for the anti-cancer medicine, SeO3<2-> ion, wherein selenium is released through a model medicine, thereby broadening drug delivery methods. The microsphere can be used in common or targeted therapy and increases bioavailability of the drug.

column12: ESSENTIAL OIL LOADED MUCOADHESIVE NANOCOMPOSITE DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR GASTROINTESTINAL SYSTEM
column13: Current treatments for H. pylori infection are not efficient enough due to poor diffusion of antibiotics to mucus layer, low stability, side effects and insufficient residence time of antibiotics in gut, antibiotic resistance of H. pylori and allergy of patients against antibiotics. Therefore, alternative therapies including new drugs and therapeutic approaches with enhanced action and reduced side effects are needed to achieve high eradication rate of the bacteria. This invention is related with eradication and/or prevention therapy of H.pylori that provides better diffusion to mucus layer and stabilization in gastric conditions. column12: Preparation method and application for double-response bi-crosslinked injectable hydrogel used for fine-controlled release of insulin
column13: The invention relates to preparation and applications for double-response bi-crosslinked injectable hydrogel used for fine-controlled release of insulin. A chitosan derivative having excellent biocompatibility, biodegradability and antibacterial property is employed as a basic high molecule, and two dynamic bonds comprising imine bond and phenylboronate are employed for preparing pH/glucose bi-sensitive injectable hydrogel, and meanwhile bio-active molecules, such as glucose oxidase and the like, are introduced into the gel substrate through a disulfide bond and the like dynamic bonds to form a double glucose response system. Through the two glucose response factors, phenylboronate and the glucose oxidase, the concentration change of glucose in external environment can be sensed at the same time, thereby causing reversible reaction of the imine bond and phenylboronate in the system, so that the bi-crosslinked network structure of the hydrogel is changed greatly to release the medicines. High sensitivity and quick response to concentration change of glucose are achieved through double sensing units (the glucose oxidase and the phenylboronic acid group) and double accepting units (the imine and phenylboronate).

column12: Manganese ion coated nanoparticles for delivery of compositions into the central nervous system by nasal insufflation
column13: The compositions and methods of the disclosure particularly target the divalent metal transporter expressed on olfactory nerve terminals to transport divalent cation-coated or cation-containing nanoparticles to all regions of brain. It has been found that such divalent cation-containing nanoparticles, including those nanoparticles comprising manganese have affinity for the metal transport receptor proteins. Although this receptor has particular affinity for manganese, it is contemplated that other divalent ions, including magnesium, calcium, and the like may also be bound to such receptors leading to transport of the nanoparticles into the intracellular cytoplasm. Nanoparticles have been developed, therefore, as vehicles for parenteral delivery of genes, proteins and drugs. The present disclosure encompasses embodiments of nanoparticle-based compositions and methods for the use thereof for the delivery of genes, oligonucleotides, including but not limited to small interfering RNA, and other small molecule drugs, into the brain by nasal insufflation.

column12: Long-acting injection type gel composition sustainedly releasing drugs and preparation method thereof
column13: The present invention provides a gel composition and a preparation method thereof. The gel composition comprises a plurality of chitosan balls, alkaline chitosan structure stabilizing agents, chitosan decomposing enzymes and drugs. The chitosan balls are formed by self assembly of chitosan. The alkaline chitosan structure stabilizing agents connect the chitosan balls with each other to form a gel body. column12: Method and system for synthesizing nanocarrier based long acting drug delivery system for buprenorphine
column13: The embodiments herein provide a nano-carrier system for delivering a long-acting injectable drug of buprenorphine and a method of synthesizing the same. The buprenorphine entrapped nanoparticles are prepared using a lipid/phospholipid core which is coated by a polymer. The lipid and phospholipid are dissolved in organic solvent. This solution is transferred into an aqueous phase consisting of distilled water or a buffer. A solution of polymer is added drop wise. The drug entrapped nanoparticle formation is achieved by diffusion of the organic solvent within the aqueous solvent to obtain the nanoparticles. The drug gets entrapped within the nanoparticles via the anti-solvency effect of the aqueous matrix. The resulting drug nanocarriers are capable of releasing the drug in a slow rate upon injection. The synthesized drug carrying nanoparticles are cryopreserved stored for future administration. For better storage, the nanodispersion is dried to form a powder.

column12: Cation adsorption and controlled fertilizer release double-function biochar microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The present invention discloses a cation adsorption and controlled fertilizer release double-function biochar microsphere and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method is as follows: (1) preparing two carboxymethyl chitosan solutions, wherein one carboxymethyl chitosan solution is used as a shell layer solution, humic acid, dimethyl sulfoxide and potassium nitrate are added into the other carboxymethyl chitosan solution for stirring evenly, and the carboxymethyl chitosan solution with the humic acid, dimethyl sulfoxide and potassium nitrate is used as a core layer solution; (2) respectively injecting the shell layer solution and the core layer solution into an outer layer and an inner layer of a coaxial needle, using a high pressure electrostatic spinning device for injecting the shell layer solution and the core layer solution into an epichlorohydrin solution, stirring, filtering and drying to obtain a core-shell structure cross-linked carboxymethyl chitosan microsphere; and (3) putting the cross-linked carboxymethyl chitosan microsphere into a tube furnace, and introducing nitrogen for protection and roasting to prepare the biochar microsphere. The biochar microsphere prepared by the method not only can be used as a controlled-release fertilizer, improves fertilizer use efficiency, and provides ecological restoration power for plants; and the material itself can be widely used in adsorption of uranyl ions, lead ions and other cation and wastewater treatment in chemical and environmental protection and other areas.

The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing drug-loaded chitosan nanoparticles: adding an antineoplastic drug solution to a chitosan solution and stirring; and adding a sodium tripolyphosphate solution and stirring, so as to obtain the drug-loaded chitosan nanoparticles; and preparing the dual-lymphatic targeting antineoplastic drug carrier: dispersing the drug-loaded chitosan nanoparticles in water, adding a cross-linking agent, sodium hyaluronate and LyP-1 and stirring so as to obtain the dual-lymphatic targeting antineoplastic drug carrier. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in process, and the method is capable of achieving massive preparation in one time with a high drug-loading capacity. The prepared antineoplastic drug carrier is stable in physical and chemical properties and is capable of keeping a uniform morphology for a long time without agglomeration. The antineoplastic drug carrier is high in tumor targeting rate, and is capable of accurately positioning and retaining in lymphatic metastatic tumor and releasing antineoplastic drugs therein.

column12: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR REDUCING OVERDOSE
column13: Drug delivery formulations useful to prevent or reduce purposeful or accidental overdose of a drug, and methods of making the same are provided. The formulations comprise either an alkalinizing coat in an amount sufficient to raise the pH of the stomach, or an acidifying coat in an amount sufficient to lower the pH of the duodenum, such that dissolution of an underlying acid or base labile coat is inhibited when excess dosage forms are ingested, thereby reducing or inhibiting the release of the drug contained therein.

column12: Folic acid modified chitosan micro-capsule with reducing responsiveness and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a folic acid modified chitosan micro-capsule with reducing responsiveness and a preparation method thereof. The capsule wall is modified by folic acid and provided with a disulfide bond structure with reducing responsiveness, a chitosan crosslinking film modified by folic acid and compounds with sulfydryl or biomolecules is adopted as the capsule wall, and the oil phase loaded with hydrophobic drugs is adopted as a core material. Firstly, chitosan is modified by folic acid and the compounds with sulfydryl or the biomolecules, ultrasonic radiation is conducted on the oil phase loaded with the hydrophobic drugs and a chitosan water solution modified by the compounds with sulfydryl or the biomolecules, and the chitosan drug-loaded micro-capsule with the capsule wall provided with folic acid and the disulfide bond structure is obtained. The preparation method is rapid, easy and convenient, efficient, environmentally friendly and wide in material source, the product is pure and free of toxins, the drug loading capacity is large, the micro-capsule can be widely applied to covering the hydrophobic drugs, targeted conveyance of drugs is achieved through the targeting of folic acid, controllable release of the drugs is achieved through the reducing responsiveness of disulfide bonds, and good application prospects are achieved.

column12: Composition, preparation, and use of chitosan shards for biomedical applications
column13: A thin chitosan-based material can be used for biomedical applications. The chitosan has been treated in a nitrogen field by applying energy to ionize nitrogen in and around the chitosan material. A single or multiple such treatments may be employed. For example, the chitosan material may be irradiated under nitrogen using γ-irradiation, treated under a nitrogen plasma, or both. A thin chitosan material can be readily treated by surface modifying treatments such as irradiating under nitrogen using γ-irradiation, treating under a nitrogen plasma, or both.
